articleTitle: Broken Railway Fastener Detection Based on Adaboost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The detection of broken railway fastener is important to ensure the safety of the railway transport. This paper proposes an efficient method to detect and recognize the broken fastener with complex ballast railway images. Firstly, a from-coarse-to-fine strategy according to the sleeper region's gray and gradient characteristics is used to position the fastener, then the Haar-like feature set according to the fastener's geometrical characteristics is introduced. Finally, the fastener state is recognized by the AdaBoost-based algorithm. The method can detect fastener effectively and automatically with high positioning and recognizing accuracy and need not manual intervention. The experiment showed that the detection rate is satisfactory.

articleTitle: A Lane Detection Method for Lane Departure Warning System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The vision based Lane Departure Warning System (LDWS)is a effective way to prevent Single Vehicle Road Departure accident. In practice, a variety of complex noise make it very difficult to detect lanes fast and accurately, so to establish a set of image processing method which can give results fast and accurately in the non-ideal conditions is the primary work. In this paper, a lane detection method for Lane Departure Warning System is proposed. The Canny algorithm is determined as the edge detection method according to the experiment comparison, and Hough transform is selected as the efficient way to detect the beeline. To meet the real-time requirement, the region of interest (ROI) is defined to reduce noise for rising accurately, and to enhance the processing speed. At last, experiment results indicate that this lane detection method can extract lane information from road images acquired efficiently and accurately.

articleTitle: A Simple Method of Tempered Glass Insulator Recognition from Airborne Image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, a method of tempered glass insulator recognition based on intensity in HSI modal from airborne image by helicopter on power grid is proposed. Morphology, extraction of connected components and threshold value segmentation by mean are applied to this method. The intensity of image contains the important information of insulator image, which is the base of insulator image segmentation. According to the feature of intensity in image, it is helpful that intensity image become binary image. Because there are some noises in the binary image, it is necessary that the binary image should be preprocessed to reduce noise. The erode process in morphology is used here. After above preprocessing, extraction of connected components can mark every 1 area in binary image, which includes the part of insulator and noise. Then setting threshold value range with mean in the number of every connected component is the threshold in classifying these components to insulator or not. Experimental results indicate that the method can classify insulator in image with little mistake.

articleTitle: A Study on Lead Acid Battery and Ultra-capacitor Hybrid Energy Storage System for Hybrid City Bus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Electrochemical energy storage, especially lead acid system alone seems not to be able to meet the demand of the hybrid vehicle propulsion system due to the power density and cycle life. Ultra-capacitor pack has been introduced in the design of energy storage system to the HEV power-train, which is often combined with battery packs to form a hybrid energy system. In these kind of applications, ultra-capacitor could either be paralleled directly with battery pack or connected with battery pack through a active energy converter like DC/DC. This paper describes two kinds of hybridization of the energy storage system with ultra-capacitor and lead acid battery. By founding the model of each component in the hybrid system and with the simulation, the power enhancement and life extension of the hybrid system compared to the pure lead acid system is analyzed. Testing results show that no matter what kind of hybridization the system is, power is enhanced with a factor β, and due to the power enhancement, current demand to the battery system is lowered, which extend the batteries' cycle life.

articleTitle: Fatigue Driving Detection System Design Based on Driving Behavior
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Fatigue driving is an important cause of traffic accidents, the key to avoid fatigue driving is to detect the driver's fatigue condition in real time. Driving behaviors such as accelerate, brake, shift and steer, continuous change when drivers become more and more fatigue. By detecting and analyzing the changing signals of them, it can show whether the driver is fatigue or not. This fatigue driving detection system is composed of driving simulator, data acquisition system, PC serial communication System and fatigue identification model.

articleTitle: A Simplified 3D Gaze Tracking Technology with Stereo Vision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A simplified 3D gaze tracking technology with stereo vision has been developed in this paper. A pair of stereo cameras and two point light sources are used to estimate 3D gaze of user's eye. Compared with other 3D systems, there are two improvements to simplify the whole system in this paper: First, 3D gaze is estimated as the line linking 3D cornea center and the virtual image of pupil center using the first Purkinje images of two LEDs, and no any user-dependent parameters are used in our paper, which require a complicated calibration procedure for each user. Second, to compute the gaze point on screen by intersecting the estimated 3D gaze, the positions of LEDs and the monitor need to be calibrated in advance. By introducing a planar mirror, two LEDs and the monitor are calibrated using a simple method without any other devices. Experimental results show that our gaze tracking system achieves an average estimation error of about 3 degree.

articleTitle: Review of Bio-oil Upgrading Technologies and Experimental Study on Emulsification of Bio-oil and Diesel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Pyrolysis oil (also called bio-oils) produced from biomass is a promising substitute for fossil fuels. However, bio-oil has many shortcomings, such as high viscosity, high oxygenate content, low stability and low heating value. Therefore, it is hard for direct high-grade fuel utilization before upgrading. In this paper, bio-oil upgrading techniques, such as catalytic hydrogenation, catalytic cracking, catalytic steam reforming, catalytic esterification and emulsification, were first reviewed. Then, emulsification experiment between whole components bio-oil and 0# diesel was carried out. Bio-oil was obtained from Shabili timber on a fluidized fast pyrolysis reactor. Span and Tween series surfactants were used as emulsifiers. It was found that the optimal value of hydrophile and lipophile balance (HLB) value for bio-oil and diesel emulsification was approximate 6.

articleTitle: A Speckle Reduction and Characteristic Enhancement Algorithm to Ultrasonic Image Based on Wavelet Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The inherent characteristic of ultrasonic and the application environment make ultrasonic image have some defects: image with speckle noise, edge blur and low contrast. In order to reduce the speckle noise and enhance the image characteristics, a speckle reduction and characteristic enhancement anisotropic diffusion algorithm is proposed based on the wavelet technology in this paper. The algorithm and parameters choice and algorithm realization steps had been analyzed and illuminated particularly. A compare research experiment for real ultrasonic image has been done using the algorithm and other traditional methods. The experimental result indicates that the proposed algorithm has strong speckle reduction and enhancement image ability. The purpose of removing speckle noise and enhancing image characteristics at same time has been reached.

articleTitle: A Multifunction Snapshot ROIC Design for Low and High Background Application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A snapshot infrared read out circuit (ROIC) with multifunction and very wide dynamic range was presented in the paper. The merits of the ROIC include small layout area, CTIA (capacitive transimpedance amplifier) integrator, selectable integration capacitors, adjustable operation bandwidth and anti-blooming. Through the snapshot mode and adjustable integration time from 1µs to 33ms (calculated by 30Hz frame frequency), the dynamic range can be extended efficiently, which provides high and low background operation abilities to the whole system. Based on the Gray code theory, random window access, dynamic image transposition, and 1, 2, 4 selectable channel outputs, can be realized by digital control circuits of the ROIC. The 32×32 array with pixel area of 30×30µm2 was successfully manufactured by 0.35µmCMOS process of HHNEC. The design also can be used in large format infrared focal plane array (IRFPA), such as 320×240, 640×480, etc.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Quantity of Off-Broad Charger for Whole Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: With technology development of Electric Vehicles (EVs), whole vehicle charging will be the main method of EVs adding energy in the future. The whole vehicle charging station provides charging services by off-broad chargers for EVs, According to characteristics of whole vehicle charging station, this paper presents a mathematical model based on the queue theory of operations research to optimize the quantity of off-broad charger in the station. And then it gives an example to prove that the model can be used as a basic theory of optimizing the quantity of off-broad charger for whole vehicle charging station.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Support Vector Machine for Imbalanced Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The usual fuzzy support vector machines are often affected by the number and distribution of data samples. In order to solve the existing problems, a fuzzy membership is proposed and then a new fuzzy support vector machine was constructed, which is suitable for imbalanced number and distribution data sets. The results show that for welding defects data set welding1, the proposed algorithm under different parameters is superior to the traditional algorithms of SVM and FSVM, whose classification error rate and bias are lower and less affected by parameters; for usual data sets sonar, diabetes, parkinsons, the proposed algorithm has better performances on the classification balance and stability, and its training time is acceptable, which shows this algorithm has good versatility.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Control of Tunnel Lighting System Based on LED
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The LED is used for the tunnel lighting. And a tunnel lighting system is presented based on 485 bus. While a variant illumination curve is constructed through inference rules of expert system according to the out illumination of the tunnel, car flow in traffic and car speed. And the tunnel illumination is controlled by the given illumination curve. Under the control of the method, the illumination in tunnel made the bright and dark adaptation process more natural and safeguarded the driving in tunnel. Also the variant curve based on the real illumination of the out of a tunnel, car flow and car speed, meets the real driving demand. Finally, a feedforward and feedback control strategy based on the relationship between light flux and brightness in tunnel is presented. As well as the power energy of tunnel lighting system is saved.

articleTitle: Test and Improvement of Ventilation Cooling System for High-Speed Train
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to solve the poor ventilation for EMU (electric multiple units) after the train speed increasing, the air pressure, air flux and temperature of the inlets and outlets for important equipments were measured through full-scale train test, and some corresponding improvements were made. The test results show that equipments work normally in the beginning and the air flux and temperature are in the design value. After the train running a period of time, the inlets are jammed, cooling air flux is insufficient and the temperature of outlets increases with the rubbish entering the inlets of equipments. The rubbish jammed in the inlets includes catkin, wastepaper and dust, entering the equipment storage mainly through the observing holes, technological holes and the gaps. The key way to solve the problem is to seal the holes and gaps mentioned above, and to improve the filtration net so as to prolong the period of cleaning up and replacing and reduce the workload.

articleTitle: Crucial Issues in Logistic Planning for Electric Vehicle Battery Application Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on a brief introduction of typical battery features, several crucial issues in logistic planning for Electric Vehicle (EV) battery applications are discussed in this paper. The obvious issues include the access of battery charging stations, the accessibility of emergence swapping, and the monitoring of batteries at charging stations on network. Standardization of the battery and energy exchange technology would accelerate the popularity and market penetration of EVs. Some barriers to widespread EVs include issues related to battery recycling and environmental protection. Furthermore, training and certification are required to prepare the workforce for EV battery service. Finally a battery management information system is systematically a very important factor for supporting battery manufacturing, battery supply chains, battery charging services, battery swapping services, recycling regulations, safety of transportation, and insurance markets.

articleTitle: Research on Using of Digital Signage in Museum Visiting Navigation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to design and specify new application models tailored to four situations in museums by applying late-model digital signage whose functions synthesize the requirements of customers and museums. These four main situations are introduced in time sequence including: before visiting, arrival, during the visit and the end. The new model of digital signage applied in museums concentrates on functions including interactive application, explanation, guidance which indicates the intellectualization, humanization and personalization trends of museum industry in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Driver Reaction Time of Safety Distance Model on Highway Based on Fuzzy Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Various parameters of the model are set based on the minimal vertical safety distance model on highway. Where the range of driver reaction time is large. The impact of the driver reaction time on the safety distance is analyzed. The driver reaction time is affected by driving experience, adaptability, sex, psychological and physical conditions and other factors. In the scope of driver reaction time allowance, the driver reaction time is determined based on the theory of fuzzy mathematics considering various main factors. The application of the method is illustrated through specific examples. The result shows that the method has practical value and can improve the accuracy of the model effectively.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Non-thermal Plasma Injection System Converting NOx in Simulated Diesel Emissions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to study the removal effect of non-thermal plasma (NTP) after-treatment system on diesel engine harmful emissions, a dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) plasma reactor is designed, and the NOx removal effect is studied under the conditions of different NTP injected gas flow rates and simulated diesel engine exhaust gas temperatures using a NTP injection system which is located outside the diesel engine exhaust pipe. The results show that the injection system can play an effective role in dealing with the harmful emissions of diesel engines; in NTP environment, conversion of NO to NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is the main reaction; with increasing the peak-to-peak applied voltage, NO conversion rate first rises and then falls; correspondingly, when the flow rates of simulated diesel engine exhaust gas are different, the flow rates of NTP injected gas are various, there is an optimum value which lead to the maximum conversion rate of NO; high temperature goes against the NO conversion.

articleTitle: Location Optimization of Urban Passenger Transportation Terminal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: There are a lot of relevant researches about location of urban passenger transportation terminal at home and abroad, but the traditional location models are often rarely considered the influence which urban transportation terminal location to bus-sharing ratio and generalized cost of transportation terminal sitting. The paper, basing on user equilibrium theory, studies the interaction between the traffic flow of private cars and that of buses in super-network, gets the optimize the traffic flows of the two transportation modes above when choosing different location of transportation terminal in city, and makes the bus-sharing ratio to maximize. Meanwhile, basing on getting the traffic flow of private cars and buses, the paper considers that the total travel cost in urban transportation network is made up three parts, which are the travel cost of private cars and the travel cost of buses, combines the total travel cost with the land cost of transportation terminal and the passenger transfer cost, and then constructs two-tier location model that bases on the ultimate goal that the total travel cost and land cost all achieve optimization. Finally, the paper brings out an example to examine the two-tier location model.

articleTitle: AHP Application in the Selection of Routes for Hazardous Materials Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Hazardous materials are used in many processes in the industry all over the world. Transportation activity of hazardous materials inherits many risks. In order to avoid the risks turning into real events, it is necessary to mitigate risks in the transport management, and the route is the key. The selection of routes under different factors is not easily achieved when considering economic and safety perspective. This article aims to develop a method for the selection of routes for the transport of hazardous materials taking into account economic and risk factors, A model of optimum transportation route is established by AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process), and an example is shown to demonstrate the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: A Video Tracking System for Limb Motion Measurement in Small Animals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Motion analysis can provide useful information for biomedical researches. In this paper, we have presented a video tracking system for limb motion measurement in small animals. A consumer-grade video camera is used to capture the image sequences on the rat motion in the low-cost planar motion capture system. The tracking software consists of matching, prediction and mismatch detection. The matching is used to find the correspondence between the reference template and the search area in the analyzed frame. The prediction is important to limit the region of processing, thus reducing the execution time. The mismatch detection is applied to enable a motion tracking with high accuracy and reliability. For different contrast levels between markers and background, two matching algorithms, i.e. intensity-based and color-based algorithms, are used to find the positions of tracked markers. Moreover, based on the polynomial fitting and improved Kalman filtering algorithms, a new algorithm is presented to predict the joint positions in order to limit the matching region. Finally, some results of the 2-D motion tracking in sagittal plane for rats are presented.

articleTitle: Velocity Analysis for UHF RFID Vehicle License Plate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Ultra-high-frequency radio frequency identification (RFID UHF) vehicle license plate is a promising technology for traffic management because of its special advantages. In practical applications, the reading effect is closely related to the vehicle velocity. This paper analyzed the effective vehicle velocity for the steadily reading of the UHF RFID vehicle license plate. The smallest time for one single tag to be effectively read, the relationship between the tags reads and the vehicle velocity, the maximum vehicle velocity to be effective read, are analyzed and measured. Measurement results were in good agreement with the theoretical analysis. Studies have shown that the reading stability of the UHF RFID vehicle license plate is closely related to the effective read range of RFID tags, readers reading cycle and the vehicle velocity. In general vehicle velocity, UHF RFID vehicle license can be effectively read.

articleTitle: Suspension Employing Inerter and Optimization Based on Vibration Isolation Theory on Electrical-Mechanical Analogies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on electrical-mechanical analogies, a principle of vibration isolation was presented, and a new vehicle suspension employing inerter, which can ease conflicts among individual performance measures for conventional suspension and improve on passenger comfort, was designed. After a quarter-car model was established, parameters of the suspension were optimized, and performance benefits in the suspension were also analyzed in comparison with a conventional suspension by application of mechanical impedance in the frequency domain. The results of simulation show that passenger comfort is remarkably improved on the suspension employing inerter without dynamic tire load and suspension working space rising. It laid the theoretical foundation for engineering application of the suspension employing inerter.

articleTitle: Modelling of Petrol Engine Power Using Incremental Least-Square Support Vector Machines for ECU Calibration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Modern automotive petrol engine power performance usually refers to output power and torque, and they are significantly affected by the setup of control parameters in the electronic control unit (ECU). ECU calibration is done empirically through tests on the dynamometer (dyno) because no exact mathematical engine model is yet available. With an emerging nonlinear function estimation technique of Least squares support vector machines (LS-SVM), the approximate power performance model of a petrol engine can be determined by training the sample data acquired from the dyno. A novel incremental algorithm based on typical LS-SVM is proposed in this paper, so the power performance models built from the incremental LS-SVM can be updated whenever new training data arrives. With updating the models, the model accuracies can be continuously increased. The predicted results using the estimated models from the incremental LS-SVM are good agreement with the actual test results and with the almost same average accuracy of retraining the models from scratch, but the incremental algorithm can significantly shorten the model construction time when new training data arrives.

articleTitle: A Hand Shape Recognition Method Research Based on Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper advanced a hand geometry recognition method based on Gaussian mixture model (GMM), which used One-dimensional centroid distance series to describe 2-dimensional hand geometry. Each departed finger obtained one centroid distance series, which was used to build a Gaussian mixture model and applied to hand geometry recognition. At last, the results of experiment verified that this method was effective.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation WEEE Reverse Logistics Network in Guangxi
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: With the rapid development of electronics industry, more and more scholars focus on how to recycle and dispose waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE) effectively. The reverse logistics network system construction is a key in the process of e-waste resource utilization. In this paper, we proposed an e-waste reverse logistics network model of Guangxi, and used Lingo software to calculate it. Then we reached that the e-waste recycling network should be established transit warehouses in Nanning, Guigang and Liuzhou. Considering the particularity of cities, we used Flexsim simulation software to simulate the reverse logistics network, constructed the Guangxi e-waste reverse logistics network. The research result in this paper provides a decision support for Guangxi e-waste reverse logistics network design.

articleTitle: Robust and Fast Localization Algorithm for Data Matrix Barcode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Data Matrix barcode is one of the most extensively used 2D barcodes. During the flow process of Data Matrix barcode decoding, barcode localization is the first and non-trivial step for the latter steps, like affine transformation adjustment, fine-level foreground region extraction etc. In this paper, an innovative method for Data Matrix barcode localization based on boundary tracking and Radon transform was proposed. The superiority of the proposed method lies in three-folds: 1) it is independent of geometrical constrains of the shape of the barcode region; 2) boundary tracking is performed hierarchically with heuristic rules without complicated predicting method; 3) the points for operating Random transform can be initiated after edge tracking to save computational complexity. Experimental results showed the accuracy, robustness, and efficiency of the proposed method for Data Matrix barcode localization.

articleTitle: Internet-Based Advanced Traveler Information Service: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The application of Advanced Traveler Information Service is limited as a result of its high cost and low accuracy. The rapid development of Internet technologies has brought out a promising solution to this problem. An Internet-based traveler information service system has been proposed and designed on basis of the discussion on the developing philosophy of the Internet, and the development of new Internet technologies. The potential defects and solution are also discussed.

articleTitle: RFID Technology Applied in Highway Traffic Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: RFID is non-contact automatic identification technology which could be applied to various industries extensively. Accessing the vehicle speed range in freeway, we could use RFID technology to manage vehicles. Then we could determine whether the vehicles are overspeed. Therefore, the use of RFID technology can effectively reduce speeding violations and enhance traffic safety. Its toll is paid by credit card automatically through computer network. Therefore, realize the non-stop automatic toll collection. Contrarily, punish the illegal vehicle by monitor network.

articleTitle: The Optimal Routes and Modes Selection in Container Multimodal Transportation Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the characteristic of the container multimodal transportation to choose a variety of transportation models and routes, a model for multimodal transportation organization was constructed to minimize the total cost under the consideration of the transport costs between nodes, transfer costs and average delay costs for mode change. An appropriate algorithm was given to solve the model. An example was also given to verify the model and the algorithm.

articleTitle: An Optimal Torque Controller Based on Iterative Learning Control for Switched Reluctance Motors for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The switched reluctance motor (SRM) is a strong candidate for electric/hybrid vehicle applications primarily because of its low-cost construction and constant power profile, but the torque ripple limited its application. This paper presents an optimal torque controller that is composed of an optimal torque sharing function (TSF) and a current controller. The TSF can optimize the profiles of torque and current to minimize the torque ripple with variable loads. To implement the TSF, a current controller based on iterative learning control (ILC) is presented which considers the mutual inductance with simultaneous two-phase excitation. The results of experiment prove that this optimal torque controller could minimize the torque ripple effectively.

articleTitle: A Modified SUSAN Corner Detection Algorithm Based on Adaptive Gradient Threshold for Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Remote Sensing image registration plays an important role in image processing. The exact corner detection is vital to image registration. A modified SUSAN corner detection algorithm based on adaptive gradient threshold is presented. Ensuring the gray threshold automatically is the key of the new algorithm. First, the Traditional SUSAN principle and the new algorithm are discussed carefully. Then, testing the two methods that have been mentioned with the software of MATLAB 7.0 using the ASTER remote sensing data. Experimental result indicates that the proposed algorithm is more adaptable and has better applicable value.

articleTitle: Non-destructive Testing of Pipeline Liquids Using Ultrasonic Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Liaohe Oil Field is a low permeability reservoir, formation oil poor, so far taken the field is ongoing recovery process, but the time of really pumping oil doesn’t account for 20% of running time, most of the time pumping machines have "empty pumping" phenomenon, it results in energy loss, increasing the mechanical wear, reducing the mechanical life and increasing the oil production cost. Aiming at the status of Liaohe oil field, I will develop an economical and effective way to achieve remote monitoring of the pumping unit. The method uses a time difference ultrasonic measurement techniques, the following is my brief description of measurement methods.

articleTitle: Development of a Single Wheel Test Bench for Anti-lock Brake System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The basic ideas about the development and application of a new type single wheel ABS (antilock brake system) test bench were presented. Without any unfavorable affection to the original brake dynamometer, a roller and a transmission set were added and modified to meet ABS testing requirements. The system was used to test the antilock braking system for a single wheel with data acquisition, results analysis. The control method and parameter can be easily changed or adjusted to try different settings; therefore it can assist ABS development process.

articleTitle: Characterization of Smoke Particles Using Polarization Modulated Scattering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A technique for characterization of smoke particles is described. The technique was established through measurements using a polarization modulated angular scanning scatterometer to completely characterize the intensity and polarization of the scattered light. The physical and optical properties of the particles were extracted from the measured data by combining light scattering modeling. Preliminary results with water droplets and soot aggregates were presented.

articleTitle: First Engineering Practice of Traffic Calming in Zhaitang Town in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The concept, Traffic Calming, was introduced to China nearly more than 10 years ago. However, no engineering practice emerges for a long time. As a typical small rural town for tour in Beijing, Zhaitang Town requires more attention on the beautiful site and pedestrian safety. In 2008, Beijing Mentougou Highway Sub-bureau decided to change the reconstruction of Zhaitang Avenue into a pilot engineering project of traffic calming. According with the research results of the traffic features in Zhaitang, the combination of mainly physical measures that reduce the negative effects of motor vehicle use, alter driver behavior and improve conditions for non-motorized street users were applied, such as Speed Humps, Raised Crosswalks, Raised Intersections, Speed Cushions, Roundabouts, Chicanes, Neckdowns, Center Island Narrowings, Lateral Shifts, Median Diverters, Boom Barrier, Pedestrian Refuges, and so on. After a half year observation, the before-and-after data of the first traffic calming engineering project has been achieved. The principles, methods, techniques to set traffic calming facilities resulted from the project and the outcome evaluation are described in the paper.

articleTitle: Realistic 3D Face Reconstruction Based on VTK and MFC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Nowadays VTK is a visualization development tool widely used in the visualization area, and MFC is a popular interface development tool in Windows platform. This paper analyzes the inner mechanism of VTK, gives both the methods of integrating VTK into MFC and accomplishing interactive computation and display of multi-windows. Finally, based on the construction of a visualization software platform, 3D reconstruction of realistic face model with VTK interfaces is also introduced.

articleTitle: Pedestrian and Bicycle Detection and Tracking in Range Images
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper presents a real-time algorithm for detecting and tracking bicyclists or pedestrians using a laser device. By processing the sequence of the range images, the algorithm outputs trajectory and speed of each object during the period when he is in the detection region. The whole algorithm consists of two parts, which are the object detection and the object tracking. In the former, the multi-level thresholding method is combined with the Iterative Selforganizing Data Analysis Techniques Algorithm (ISODATA) to implement object segmentation. In the latter, Kalman Filter is applied to recognize and track moving objects. Experimental results demonstrated this algorithm is effective in object recognition and tracking, as well as robust in the applications.

articleTitle: Research on Preprocessing Algorithm for PET-CT Image Registration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: PET and CT image registration is an important tool of clinical diagnosis of diseases. For PET and CT images, a preprocessing algorithm of medical image registration is proposed in this paper. The algorithm process includes image normalization, CT image adaptive threshold adjustment and automatic extraction of tissues based on morphology, edge detection and statistical analysis theory, and improved PET image interpolation based on physical spacing of pixels. The experiment results indicate that the preprocessing methods proposed in this paper have a great effect on PET and CT image registration research because of the exclusion of redundant information and the improvement of the registration algorithm efficiency.

articleTitle: A Kind of Energy Consumption Modeling Method for Heat-Setting Machines
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: An energy consumption modeling method for heat-setting machines is proposed. First, technics of ironing oven in heat-setting machines is introduced. Then on basis of Newton's law of cooling, heat transfer formula in unit time is proposed. Third, by considering three kinds of conditions in production locale, three temperature differential equations are introduced respectively, and then heat power transfer from hot air to fabric is proposed. It shows mean and variance between modeling data and practice data are less than 2% by considering energy loss.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Urban Traffic Congestion Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the massive floating car data and traffic flow detector data of intelligent movement platform, the average travel speed, the average delay per unit distance and the saturation of road sections are selected to build traffic congestion evaluation system. The accuracy of floating car data is validated with field observations of the typical roads in Guangzhou, the validation result shows that the accuracy of floating car data is more than 86%, which shows that the floating car data may reflect the road traffic information well. The evaluation criteria of three indexes are determined by the regression analysis of floating car data. Because the weight decided by traditional fuzzy evaluation method is random, in order to make the conclusion more objective, the principal components analysis method is applied to define the weigh which is based on the monitoring sample information, and the expert scoring method is supplemented to do some amendments. The multi-ingredient assessment is transformed into the single-object decision by the improved fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, and the traffic congestion index concept is proposed. Finally, the traffic congestion evaluation system is conducted on the traffic improvement planning in Tianhe district.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Acetabular Transverse Fracture Reconstruction Treated with Different Internal Fixation Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This article established the pelvis models with aeolotropic material property, and made modeling and mechanical analysis of the acetabular transverse fracture models treated with different internal fixation methods. The mechanical indexes we interested in are as follows, the maximal displacement, the maximum equivalent stress and the maximum stress around the fracture line. Through the compare of these indexes, we found the biomechanical properties differences of the two groups of fixation methods. The first group is including the posterior column long plate (NPL) and the posterior column short plate (NPS) fixations. The second group is composed of the following three double-column fixation methods, the double-column lag screws (SSG), the anterior column lag screw and posterior plate (SPG) fixation and the double-column plates (PPG) methods. All these analyses are during the double-leg stand position. The conclusions are as follows: NPL is much better than NPS. SSG is better than SPG, while SPG is better than PPG.

articleTitle: Integrated Capacity Evaluation Method on Terminal Area Capacity Based on the Controller Workload Statistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The air traffic flow of terminal airspace is the bottleneck of the whole airspace’s traffic flow. It is important that the scientific method of airspace’s capacity evaluation is established. A method is presented which evaluates terminal area’s capacity based on integrated capacity evaluation. Firstly, a standard of quantifying about controller’s workload is analyzed and confirmed which important condition of terminal area’s capacity evaluation is. Secondly, theoretical models are worked out by the statistic of the data in theoretical evaluation. Regarding complicated traffic system of terminal area as the whole, the airspace and airport of terminal area is integrated air???ground simulated in simulative evaluation. Finally, this method is validated by the KUNMING Terminal Area’s capacity evaluation.

articleTitle: The Obstacle Avoidance and Navigation Based on Stereo Vision for Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, an overview of stereo vision, stereo image processing is introduced as well as a method of obstacle avoidance and navigation based on stereo vision for mobile robot is provided. Making use of 3-d stereo reconstruction, the recognition of visible terrain in front of the mobile robot is solved for successive obstacle avoidance. The area-based stereo reconstruction algorithm which combines the pyramidal data structure and dynamic programming technique has been used for the recognition of the local environment. The vision system can thus be used to identify, locate and approach mechanical objects autonomously.

articleTitle: Interior Noise Prediction of Subway Cab Caused by Track Irregularities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to predict the interior noises of subway cab caused by track irregularities, the vehicle-track coupling dynamics analysis was applied to compute the excited loads, which play a role as the cab noise sources. The acoustical boundary element method was employed to estimate interior cab noise, and the distribution characters of the interior cab noise were ascertained and reached the following conclusion. When the train runs with 60km/h, the noises in cab change in the range of 79.28-84.95 dB. At the frequency of 30Hz, 120Hz, 190Hz, the sound pressure level (SPL) in cab is greater. To reduce the biggest noise in cab, measures must be adopted at 30Hz, 120Hz, 190Hz.

articleTitle: Study on LPG-Electric Hybrid Bicycle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) - electric hybrid bicycle is designed in this paper. In accordance with the different traffic conditions, the hybrid system, which contains a hub motor and a LPG engine, can work at engine-mode, battery-mode, and hybrid-mode, separately or in cooperation. The switching of these modes is electrically controlled. Thus the internal combustion engine can work in high efficiency and the bicycle has better dynamic and economic performance. It is worth to mention that, when LPG is used as the fuel, the system's emission performance will be reduced considerably. At the same time, the noise performance will be further improved too. The storage battery works only at the stage of start and at the low-speed condition. Once the speed of bicycle is up, the LPG engine starts automatically and charges up the battery, which will prolong both the service life of the battery and the maximal travel mileage. As a result, the requirements of the battery's capacity and weight can be significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Measuring Control Delay at Signalized Intersections Based on Vehicle Infrastructure Integration System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Measuring control delay at signalized intersections accurately is very important for designing and operating traffic control systems. At present, we usually maintain control delay through observing on the spot or model calculating. However, the control delays obtained by these methods are not accurately and in real time. In the recent years, the development of vehicle infrastructure integration system provides us a truly integrated transportation system. In this system, every moving vehicle equipped with onboard equipment is also a moving sensor, which can collect traffic information and transmit traffic information to road-side equipments in real time. Using this information, this paper advances a new method of control delay measuring based on vehicle infrastructure integration system and also confirm the effectiveness of the measuring method through traffic simulation.

articleTitle: Evaluation Emergency Transport Performances in Response for Hazardous Materials Road Transportation Accident Based on SPN: A Case of Jiangsu
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Hazardous materials road transportation accidents often cause serious deaths and injuries and huge property losses. It is essential to improve the capabilities in response for hazardous materials road transportation accidents. Governments in China began to establish Emergency Response System (ERS) to deal with various kinds of accidents. Emergency Transport Response System (ETRS) is subsystem of ERS to provide transportation support to reduce further damage caused by the accidents. A method to evaluate ETRS performances based on stochastic Petri net (SPN) and Markov Chain (MC) to model and analyze the main procedure of ETRS was proposed. Firstly, the operational characteristics of ETRS were identified, and then the model of ETRS were designed and simulated by using of SPN. In addition, through isomorphic MC of the SPN model, the performance of ETRS was analyzed. Finally, a real case was given to illustrate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Image Segmentation Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Exact segmentation of fingerprint image is very important for fingerprint singular points and minutiae features extraction. In this paper, a method for fingerprint image segmentation is proposed based on Support Vector Machine (SVM). The fingerprint image is broken into 16*16 prospects blocks and background blocks. The block average gray, block gray variance, block contrast and the largest peak of non-DC amplitude are used as the feature inputs. An optimization filtering method is used to obtain the kernel function parameters and the error penalty factor. With less training samples, a classifier with good generalization performance is gained. After post-processing using morphological method, the algorithm is simulated with the FVC2002DB-4B fingerprint database. The result of the simulation shows that the correct rate increase to 99%. Both the theoretical analysis and the experimental results indicate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Electronic Control Unit Development for Unit Pump Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Electronic unit pump (EUP) fuel injection system has prospective application in medium or heavy diesel engine. Developing an ECU of EUP diesel engine is necessary to meet emission regulations and economic requirements. The structure and working principle of EUP fuel injection system was studied. An ECU was developed, which consists of digital circuit, power supply module, driving circuit and sensor signal processing circuit. A diesel engine management system named micro real time kernel was also designed to run the control program. The control strategies of injection timing and injection quantity were put forward. Experimental research on diesel engine verified the availability of the ECU system.

articleTitle: Modeling the Generation and Organization of Household Non-work Activity: A Case Study of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Using the data collected in Beijing, this paper investigates trip chaining, especially focusing on the generation and organization of non-work activity stops at a household level. According to activity-based approach, travel is a derived demand from the need to pursue activities distributed in space. So a binary logit model of the propensity for households to participate in non-work activities is first estimated. Then based on the presence of work activities and the number of intermediate activity stops in a chain, three chain types are defined, namely complex work chains, simple nonwork chains, and complex non-work chains. And the fractional logit modeling methodology is applied to model household's allocation of non-work activity stops among the three alternative chain types. Empirical results indicate that the propensity to participate in nonwork activities and the arrangement of non-work activity stops to form simple or complex chains vary among households with different structure, socio-demographic and travel characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Multidimensional Scaling Localization Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks, which are energy limited, low hardware configuration and proneness to invalidation, puts a high demand on the positioning algorithm. Therefore the improved multidimensional scaling (IMDS) algorithm is proposed. In IMDS, firstly, local positioning areas (LPA) are established by an adaptive search algorithm. So the centralized multidimensional scaling algorithm is changed into a distributed algorithm. Then the shortest path distances between nodes on LPA are corrected with the geometric correction method (GCM) and adjusting weight correction method (AWCM). The distances between nodes become more accurate. Finally, with information of the public nodes of LPA and anchor nodes, we get the wireless sensor nodes coordinates through coordinate transformation by the SMACOF algorithm and the classical multidimensional scaling algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimizing Retrieval Sequencing in Container Yards
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper presents a mixed-integer programming (MIP) model of retrieval sequencing in container yards. Exact penalty function methods are proposed to find the exact solution. The optimization goal is to minimize the weighted sum of the number of container movements and the total working time of the crane.

articleTitle: Research of Gamma, Color Temperature and Brightness of the Display Effect
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the display's calibration and characterization, Gamma value, color temperature and brightness parameters of the display colors have tremendous influence. The results of experiments: With the Gamma value increases, the color tristimulus values and luminance L values are increasing, and the rate of increase varies, adjust the display image of the bright part of the level will show better, the contrary is also true, so choose appropriate gamma value to improve the image display; the color temperature of more than gamma, color temperature value selected according to the monitor to determine the specific work environment; brightness almost no effect, select the brightness you can choose based on the observed conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Controller for Energy-Efficient and Wide-Speed-Range Drive for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on the Interconnection and Damping Assignment Passivity Based Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper designs a novel control method for energy efficient and wide speed range drive of the PMSM. The proposed method includes several parts: (1) using a PI speed controller to create a signed current norm value as input of the command converter. (2)The command converter can simply and accurately generate an analytical current command according to the current control standard satisfying the maximizing/current ratio or voltage limitations. (3) Take output current commands of the command converter as the system equilibrium points and apply the interconnection and damping assignment passivity based control (IDA-PBC) to make the system stable. (4) A sliding mode observer is designed and applied to estimate the rotor speed. (5) Simulation results show the system provides a better performance in accurately tracking the variable rotor speed and being robust to the load torque disturbance.

articleTitle: A Study of Distributed Traffic Information Acquisition Based on Clustered VANET
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Inter-Vehicle Communication (IVC), which combines traditional traffic theory and network technology together, has drawn increasing research interests in recent years. This paper proposes a prototype of distributed traffic information acquisition based on IVC. Here, equipped vehicles act as moving sensors and form a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) which takes charge of traffic information acquisition, sharing and fusion. Road-side stations as local access points can collect distributed real-time traffic information and upload it to superior network Traffic Management Centers (TMC). In this paper, a complete analysis and comparison on traffic information acquisition based on clustered VANET and common multi-hop VANET is studied, including the total network load, routing methods etc. And we also establish a simulation platform to realize and validate all these methods or systems. Finally, a clustered network structure is recommended because of its more utilization of network resource and better communication quality.

articleTitle: Research of Power Optimizing Technique for Solar Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Under the conditions of partial shadow, there will be multi-peak phenomenon in the characteristic curve of photovoltaic array, which will greatly influence the control and tracking of the maximum power. A Simscape simulation model of a photovoltaic array is described in the article. It is used for the research of the electrical and optical characteristic curve under the conditions of the partial shadow. Uniform shadow and gradient shadow are simulated to analyze the maximum output power of local, global and distributed peak-value tracking algorithms. The result of simulation demonstrates that the power output can be greatly increased by the distributed peak-value tracking algorithms when the contrast of the shadow is relatively big.

articleTitle: Modeling and Animation of Realistic 3D Virtual Human Using Inertial-sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In virtual human simulations, there is no unified 3D human model standard. We propose a method of constructing layered virtual human motion model. This method is to use position information and angle information provided by sensors to construct skeleton model of virtual human. The skin model is formed by triangular mesh. The joints of virtual human are categorized according to the motion characteristics. Angle data from sensor are used to control virtual human animation and reconstruct the human body motion. The experiments have shown that the proposed model is suitable for using sensor data to construct skeleton model of virtual human and drive virtual-human in real time animation.

articleTitle: Situations and Tendency of Intelligent Transportation System in Europe
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: With the worsening traffic situation in major cities around the world, intelligent transportation system (ITS) has been developed rapidly for alleviation of urban traffic congestion, environmental pollution and traffic safety all over the world. However, the development of ITS is unbalanced in different countries and areas because of difference levels of economy, science and technology, and differences of traffic policy and political cultural background. Therefore, the general situation and tendency of ITS development in Europe have been discussed in this study to be used as references for the development of ITS in China.

articleTitle: Study on Coordination Control with Bandwidth Optimization for Signalized Intersections in Arterial Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Signal controlled intersection is critical to the urban traffic network, signal timing optimization is important to reduce traffic delays, relieve congestion, and improve the operation of urban traffic network. This study proposed a phase sequence optimization model for coordination control based on NEMA phase. After establishing the experimental network, VISSIM was adopted for testifying the effectiveness of the optimization model under 15 difference groups of scenarios. The simulation results show that the optimized scheme reduces the intersection delay by 2% ~ 29%, also reduces the number of stops by 14% ~ 28% and travel time by 1% ~ 9%, which has greatly improved the operation condition of urban road network. To better understand and further analyze the characteristics of the optimization model and using frequencies of each phasing sequence, the authors developed a computer simulation program to derive optimal solutions for arterial coordination control. Based on simulation result, it was concluded that Leading and Lagging left turn phasing were more likely to be involved in progression bandwidth solution of signal systems with randomly distributed spacing. While Lead-Lag and Lag-Lead phasing found more applications in equally distributed signal systems.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of the Questionnaire for Light Pollution at Sea with SPSS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to find out the scope and extent of the impact on ship navigation safety at night by light pollution at sea, a questionnaire was carried out and the reliability and validity of the questionnaire were checked with statistical analysis software SPSS (edition 17.0), based on a brief introduction to the design and implementation of the questionnaire for light pollution at sea. Statistical analysis was carried out on 191 valid questionnaires concerning the general opinion on the impact of light pollution at sea on ship navigation safety at night, as well as feelings of navigators with different age and positions about light pollution at sea. Detailed analysis was given to the relation between ship navigation safety at night and the impact by light pollution at sea on human visual ergonomics and identifiability of signal lights. As a result, the linear regression equation of their impact on ship navigation safety at night was obtained.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Monitoring System for Ship-Hull Status Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Aiming at the weakness of currently ship-hull status monitoring, such as poor integration capacity, relatively closed system, limited coverage and so on, this paper designs a intelligent monitoring system for ship-hull status(IMSSS for short) based on CAN bus, and describes in detail the system framework and its hardware and software design. Taking the Philips ARM microprocessor as the core, the system forms a variety of sensors and equipments into a network based on CAN bus technology. The system can implement intelligent integration of the detection on status information such as temperature and humidity of cargo hold, water or oil tank level, ballast tank level, ship draft, hull structure shape, and the control on some equipments such as oil pumps, water pumps, ventilators, dehumidifiers, etc. This work promotes ship-hull status monitoring toward the direction of digitization, networking and intelligence, and has a broad market prospect.

articleTitle: Automotive Supply Chain Management Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: According to statistical analysis, the first half of 2009 once China surpassed the United States became the world's first automobile-producing country, while China's auto consumption, the proportion of total world consumption has reached 12%. In the trend of development of modern logistics, automobile enterprises must be based on the survival of the entire supply chain's competitive edge relies on strengthening the supply chain, logistics costmanagement for enterprises increasingly become a priority project. In this paper, the use of supply chain management and logistics cost management theoretical knowledge, from the overall situation of China's automotive industry in the supply chain, logistics cost control on the status and development trend of research, further to improve the program, reduce supply chain logistics costs and improve economic efficiency for automotive enterprises to provide decision-making.

articleTitle: Real-Time Georobot Automatic Monitoring During Shield Under-crossing Existing Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: During under-crossing shield, the monitoring of the existing tunnel has been done by the improved Georobot automatic deformation monitoring system. Results show the iron rails of existing tunnel have some regular settlement, difference settlement and lateral deformation. The vertical and lateral compressive and tensile deformation also exist in the structure of the tunnel section. The automatic deformation monitoring system based on Georobot owns a series of advantages such as comprehensive deformation information acquisition, high-precision, easy-installation, reusable.

articleTitle: The Design of Monitoring System for Unmanned Marine Engine Room Based on FameView
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Marine engine room's unmanned monitoring is the basic requirement for modern ship steering and control. The definition, developmental trend and the monitoring requirements of unmanned marine engine room are introduced. Take a practical application in the marine engine room as an example; the components of the unmanned monitoring system are analyzed. The design procedure and key technology of monitoring software for the design of upper computer monitoring system based on FameView are studied emphatically. The functions of realtime monitoring and malfunction alarm as well as the stability of this system have been approved practically by on-board operation.

articleTitle: Seismic Analysis on Long-Span Steel-Truss Arch Bridge with Continuous Rigid-frame
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Take Xinguang Bridge of Guangzhou city in China as an example, the paper is focused on the following study: The free vibration on long-span steel-truss arch bridge with continuous rigid-frame is carried out to obtain the natural frequencies and mode shapes. Furthermore under the condition of two steps and two levels probability, this paper examines the different internal forces that are produced in key members of the bridge by subjecting the bridge to earthquakes excitation in transverse direction, longitudinal direction, combined transverse and vertical directions, and combined longitudinal and vertical directions, while considering synchronous seismic time-history excitation and traveling wave seismic time-history excitation. It is found that traveling wave effect and shear wave speed of ground has great influence to the seismic response of large span continuous rigid-framed and steel-truss arch bridge. The conclusion of the paper provides a practical reference for large-span steel-truss arch bridge with continuous rigid frame arch bridge design practice.

Author Keywords: Steel-truss arch bridge with continuous rigid frame

articleTitle: Analysis the Impact of the RFID Technology on Reducing Inventory Shrinkage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: We provide a Newsvendor model to analyze how to reduce inventory shrinkage problems by deploying the RFID. We propose a comparison between two scenarios based on whether to deploy RFID, and analyze the affect of order fulfillment rate, RFID improvement rate, and the tag price, respectively, the results show that the decision of deploying the RFID depends on the order fulfillment rate, when the order fulfillment rate below the critical value, the retailer gains a higher profit under deploying the RFID. We also propose an analytical critical tag cost which makes the deployment of RFID cost effective.

articleTitle: Creep Monitoring for Subway Station Structure by Fiber Bragg Grating Sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Using the double-power law for concrete creep, the strain of septi-slab is calculated. Experiment data measured by fiber Bragg grating sensors agree well with the calculated results, and the calculated results taking into account the earlyage creep are better in agreement with the measured data. Creep has very important effects on earlyage concrete, and the creep of earlyage concrete should be considered in the structural design and crack control. Based on the B3 model for concrete creep, the longterm creep of new impervious concrete structures is analyzed. The data measured by the sensors agree well with the data computed with B3 model.

articleTitle: A Study on Pedestrian Injuries Based on Minivan and Sedan Real-World Accidents
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The current paper aims to study the correlation between pedestrian injuries and impact speed in the accidents involved minivan and sedan and the relationship of pedestrian head injuries and calculated physical parameters. The logistic regression models of the risks for pedestrian AIS 3+ injuries and fatalities were developed in terms of vehicle impact speed by analyzing the minivan-pedestrian and sedan-pedestrian accidents in the statistical sample selected from the database of In-depth Investigation Accident of Changsha (IVAC). Eighteen accident cases from the sample were selected to reconstruct using mathematical models of pedestrians and vehicles in MADYMO environment. The logistic regression models of the risks for pedestrian head AIS 3+ injuries were developed in terms of HIC, head linear acceleration, head angle acceleration and angle velocity. The results show that there is a significant correlation among the impact speed and the severity of pedestrian injuries. The minivan poses greater risk to pedestrian than sedan at the same impact speed. There is a significant correlation among pedestrian head AIS 3+ injuries and injury parameters (HIC, head linear acceleration, head angle acceleration, angle velocity). The results provided background knowledge for the development of pedestrian protection countermeasures for the vehicle with high profile of frontal structures.

articleTitle: CDGPS-Based Calibration of Odometer's Scale Factor with Temperature for Vehicle Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper discusses the calibration of odometer’s scale factor with tire temperature, which is a critical parameter for dead reckoning in vehicle navigation system especially when GPS is not available. In this work, we propose an INS/Odometer/CDGPS calibration approach to off-line estimate the scale factor. By combining CDGPS measurements and odometer’s outputs, the scale factor with tire temperature can be precisely identified using kalman filter. Experimental results show that the relation of odometer’s scale factor and tire operation temperature is approximate linear, the model has good applicability and the accuracy of vehicle navigation system can be remarkably improved.

articleTitle: The Application of Nerve Net Algorithm to Reduce Vehicle Weigh in Motion System Error
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to improve the Vehicle Weigh in Motion System with precision, the paper introduces Nerve Net Algorithm to error analysis. The article sets up a neural network model by determining the neural network input and output variables. Then, the function is defined by net training on MATLAB software. Finally through the experimental verification of Nerve Net Algorithm improving Weigh in Motion System accuracy is feasible.

articleTitle: Study on Green Logistics and Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the ecological environment and sustainable development, Green logistics , has been an important part sustainable development of today's economy. To fully implement it, governments, enterprises and consumers should take joint action, developing green logistics, economizing logistics resources, reducing logistics cost and decreasing pollution during the process of logistics are the dominate strategies to achieve triple win effects for enterprises, society and governments.

articleTitle: An Effective Method of Automatic Image Mosaic for Remote Video Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Current remote video monitoring system in substation can not fully play the role it is supposed to have in real-time active supervision. In order to improve the effect of remote video monitoring system, image mosaic technology is introduced firstly. Then an automatic image mosaic SIFT-based method for remote video monitoring system is proposed. The steps of this method are described in detail, and the implementation process of image mosaic is demonstrated by an example. The experimental results show that the proposed method can perform well, and meet the requirement of real project, which is beneficial to improve the safety and reliability of substation operation.

articleTitle: Applied Research on the Impedance Matching Balance Transformer of Three-Phase to Four-Phase Used in AT Traction Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, the wiring scheme of three-phase to four-phase impedance matching balance transformer used in AT power supply system be presented based on the principle and its electromagnetic properties. At the same time, the simulation model be constructed and the characteristic of electromagnetic properties has been analyzed when the threephase to four-phase impedance matching transformer used in AT power supply system. The results show that the transformer used in AT power supply system has a more superior electrical performance and has a broad prospect for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Embedded Data Acquisition System for Mobile Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The article presents a FPGA based novel embedded automobile data acquisition system, which records vehicle's, environment's and driver's operation information intuitively. The data acquisition system is useful in the fields of traffic accident analyze and accident responsibility confirmation. The core of system is Altera's Nios II processor in FPGA. According to the trigger conditions set by users, the processor controls peripherals to acquire and storage variety information such as sounds, videos, velocity, position, angular rate,acceleration, impact and so on. Wireless communication methods like Wi-Fi and 3G are used so that the information saved can be easily accessed locally or remotely. Novel intelligent data acquisition system has more advantages than traditional data acquisition system on user privacy, sorts of information recorded, data export speed and information visibility. Experiments in different traffic accident occasions have taken, and the results verified that the system archived the design demands.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Bus Occupant Restraint System in Emergency Brake
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The bus occupant constraint system model is established based on software called MADYMO for front impact simulation, the system consists of bus body, safety belts and a dummy. After adjusting the model, occupant head and chest injury curves and injury values such as HIC, T3MS and Thpc are got, which are close to test ones contrasted with the vehicle impact test. Then the injury estimate system of bus occupant in emergency brake is established and the model is used to compute the simulation of bus emergency brake with the assumption of assumptive approximate decelerate speed. Then different types of safety belts and cushion angles related to injury values are got. Simulation analyzing reveals that three-point safety belts can protect occupant better and augmenting the cushion angle can reduce occupants' injury values.

articleTitle: Full-Field Displacement and Strain Measurements for Debonding Test of SMPM Laminates Using ESPI
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper presents the full-field displacement and strain measurements in the debonding tests of steel stranded wire mesh and polymer mortar (SMPM) laminates bonded to concrete, in which the electronic speckle pattern interferometry (ESPI) with four-phase shifting technique is used. The in-plane displacements of SMPM laminates are obtained by measuring the changes in phase patterns due to deformation. Derivation of displacements resulted in strains. The propagation of interference fringes and the characteristic of strain distributions are recorded and analyzed. It is concluded that the ESPI, being a whole-field non-contacting optical method, is suitable for the study of debonding mechanism of composites. However, the rigid body motions of test specimens should be strictly restrained. The strain distribution on the surface of SMPM laminates is different from that of the well-used fiber reinforced polymer (FRP) laminates, and the position of transversal stranded wires has a significant influence on the strain distribution and the debonding load. Results of this study can be used for developing the interfacial bond-slip relationship of SMPM laminates bonded to concrete.

articleTitle: The Study on L-STBC-OFDM in HF Communication System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is a promising technology to enhance capacity and robustness of the link by the presence of multiple transmit antennas and multiple receive antennas in the communication link. The use of multiple antennas at both ends of a wireless link promises significant improvements in terms of spectral efficiency and link reliability. The HF system adopted MIMO and OFDM(Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) will improve the quality of HF communications. Among coding approach in MIMO system, the ability of combating fading of STBC is better than that of LSTC, the spectrum and the code rate of LSTC is higher than that of STBC, L-STBC is a coding approach combining STBC and LSTC. In this paper, L-STBC-OFDM system scheme was proposed and simulation was done in HF channel. The result confirmed that the performance of combating fading of L-STBC-OFDM system is better than that of LSTC-OFDM system and the performance of transmitting is better than that of STBC-OFDM system.

articleTitle: The Research of a Distributed Simulation Method of Information Sharing in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to support analyzing bullwhip effect and information sharing in supply chain, this paper proposed a HLA distributed simulation method (WS-HLA) which combined Web Service technologies. This method took each supply chain node as a simulation federal, and wrapped these federals as web services that could be run under controlled by RTI. About the structure of WS-HLA, some key issues of implementation techniques were described. And then this paper took the Bear Game as case study and built a model to verify the feasibility of the WS-HLA-based simulation method.

articleTitle: Double-Coupler Fiber Ring Resonator Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A new type of resonator fiber-optic gyroscope (RFOG), i.e., the double-coupler fiber ring resonator gyroscope (DCFRRG), is discussed. Detailed analyses show that the DCFRRG may solve two important problems (light source cost and coherent noises) confronted by traditional RFOGs effectively.

articleTitle: The Research Progress of Genetic Algorithm in the Large Warehouse System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The structural features and research contents of the automated storage / retrieve system are briefly described in this paper, which it comprehensively analyzed the application research of genetic algorithm in the large warehouse system and research trends at home and abroad in recent years. At the same time, the applied research of genetic algorithm in AS/RS stacker picking path optimization, slotting optimization, goods delivery and etc. were general reviewed.
