articleTitle: Safety Evaluation and Countermeasure Research on the Passenger Transportation in Chongqing Mountainous Rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Along with the continual improvement of rural residents' living conditions, the passenger transport demand grows increasingly. However, the present backward vehicles, the traffic mode, the supervision system and the rural residents' consciousness of traffic safe can not adapt to the realistic demand of safe transportation under the current rural road condition; which makes traffic accidents show a growing tendency in rural areas, especially the accidents of mass injuries and death. Therefore, this paper analyzes and evaluates the traits of the traffic accidents in rural areas, and analyzes the existent main problems of passenger transport security from multiple perspectives, such as from the angles of the construction of rural road, the running way, the management mode and the supervision system and so on. Finally, this paper also advances some pertinence countermeasures for the passenger transport safety in mountainous rural areas.

Author Keywords: passenger transport safety in rural area

articleTitle: The Length Definition of the Expressway Tunnel Based on Driving Safety and Comfort
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The road tunnel which has advantages of improving the alignment criterion, educing travel distance, protecting the natural environment is increased used in China. At present, the related domestic and foreign researches are mainly based on the design scale, lining type, construction methods and difficulty, use and so on. There is little about the length definition of road tunnel based on the drivers' driving safety and comfort. The driver is client of tunnel. The driving environment of tunnel is different from the outside and tunnel length has impact on the driving safety and comfort. So this paper defines the length of the tunnel based on driving safety and comfort in order that the related scholars who concern and study the tunnel treat them differently. By analyzing the safety and comfort test data of 62 tunnels, we get the shortest tunnel whose length is 450m based on the evaluation index of driving safety and comfort-workload. When the length is less than 450m, the drivers' workload is low and stable, such tunnels have no significant impact on the driving safety and comfort; When the length is greater than (or equal to) 450m, the drivers' workload becomes a apparent and consistent law that it increases at the entrance of the tunnel, shows no significant change in the tunnel, it increases again until the tunnel exit. The increased workload is with a certain lead or lag. Because this has a large influence on the driving safety and comfort, we need to consider some safe measures.

articleTitle: The Algorithm Research of Terrain Parameter Estimation Based on Lunar Rover's Traveling Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Future lunar exploration requires rovers to understand lunar environment and terrain characteristic. In order to assess the traction traversability of a lunar rover, it is necessary to make terrain parameter estimation with lunar rover's traveling information. The online estimation methods of terrain parameter attract increasing attention because of its rapidness and effectiveness. Taking full account of wheel lug effect and stress distribution between wheel and lunar soil, the original wheel-soil interaction model of rigid wheel was modified and further simplified in this paper. Two typical algorithms, the linear-least squares method and the nonlinear iterative method, were introduced and analyzed according to the improved model. Experimental data of wheel-soil interaction were combined to verify these two algorithms. The verification result indicates that two algorithms are accurate and effective. By comparison, the algorithm based on the linear-least squares method shows good stability and feasibility, which allows a lunar rover for online mechanical parameters estimation of lunar soil.

articleTitle: Color Watermarking Algorithm Based on Modified QFFT and DCT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A new color watermarking algorithm of colored images based on modified quaternion fast Fourier transform (QFFT) and discrete cosine transform (DCT) is presented. By modifying the image vector μ, the real part and imaginary part of the carrier image after QFFT are symmetrical. Then, the DCT is applied to the colored watermark, and after multiplying a factor, the RGB components of the watermark are embedded into the corresponding part of the carrier image lossless and spread into the whole image, hence enhancing the intangibility. The experimental result shows that the presented algorithm improves peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by 10 dB compared with color watermarking algorithm based on traditional QFFT.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Algorithm for Forest Fire Detection Based on MODIS Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The theory and methods of MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) data in fire detection are introduced. Experience with high quality data from MODIS has suggested several improvements to the original active fire detection. An enhanced algorithm using variance between-class and smoke plume mask is described. The brightness temperature threshold of potential fire pixels was adjusted to be 305K. Based on the variance between-class of thermal infrared spectral channels, hot fire spots and cool fire spots can be separated from the background respectively. Smolder spots of low temperature were distinguished with algorithm of smoke plume mask. It has been used in forest fire detection happened at Fujian province and Blagoveshchensk of Russian. It satisfy with different environments and suit to identify high-temperature fire points and low-temperature smolder points accurately.

articleTitle: Optic-fiber Sensor Based on Fluorescence Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A kind of fluorescence optic-fiber thermometer is devised based on the solid-state ruby fluorescence material. The characteristic of fluorescence material absorption and emission is analysised, and the optic-fiber temperature measurement probe based on ruby is developed. This system is particularly adapt to the temperature measurement in the rang of 20°C to 600°C. During the cause of experimentation, this temperature measurement method is proved to be effective and useful for its highly resolution and precision.

articleTitle: The Effect of RF Power, Argon Pressure on Argon Spectral Lines Intensity Excited by Micro-ICP Source
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper briefly described the structure and experimental test device of micro inductively coupled plasma (micro-ICP) excitation source. Micro-ICP excitation source excited low-pressure argon and obtained plasma light source. Spectrometer detected atomic emission spectrometry (AES) spectrum of argon in scope of 690~860 nm. Experimental research on relationship between argon spectral lines intensity and radio frequency (RF) power, argon pressure of micro-ICP excitation source has been done. Experimental results show that argon spectral lines intensity enhanced markedly when RF power raised from 3 watt (W) to 10 W, the increasing trend weakened within 10~20 W, at 20~23 W achieved the maximum, above 23 W decreased and the discharge was unstable. The argon spectral lines intensity appeared two peaks, at 60 Pascal (Pa) and 230 Pa when the argon pressure increased from 10 Pa to 250 Pa, but the discharge was unstable above 160 Pa. We concluded the best working parameters scope of micro-ICP excitation source for exciting argon: RF power 10~20 W, working argon pressure 50~70 Pa after comprehensive analysis.

articleTitle: The Measurement of Micro Platform's Position and Pose Based on Monocular Visual
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper put forward an algorithm to measure the position and pose of the six degrees of freedom micro-platform based on monocular visual. Firstly, the micro-platform is abstracted for the Cuboid. We solid the Cuboid which knows its initial position and pose with the world coordinate system together, and select vertices and edges as the feature elements from the Cuboid. The feature elements can be traced by the fixed single camera in 3D space. According to the relationship between working micro-platform and camera model, we can get the position and pose of micro-platform in three-dimensional coordinate.

articleTitle: Analysis of Spatial-temporal Coupling for Urban Travel Demand and Land Use
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The relationship of reciprocity between travel demand and land use is an eternal focus for the development of a city. The Spatial-temporal feature of urban system decides the multidimensional feature of the reciprocity between these two issues. Exploring multidimensional-coupling relationship between travel demand and land use has of importance meaning to understanding and handling the trend and rule of transport development as well as formulating logical and rational urban transport development strategy. This assignment synthetically considers the features of urban land use and the Spatial-temporal feature of travel demand, along with the network features of several transport components. Case study is used in this assignment to find out the extent of association among different factors and the intensity of motivation towards coupling system via establishing coupling evaluation model and GIS spatial analysis technique, in order to present the general rule of Spatial-temporal coupling between urban travel demand and land use.

articleTitle: A Robust EGR Control System for Gasoline Engine Using PID
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A PID control is developed for robust control of EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation) system in a gasoline engine. First a GT-power model of the gasoline engine with EGR system was built and verified. Then a PID controller was built using Simulink/Matlab and coupled with the GT-power engine model. A suitable tuning strategy for the PID controllers is also developed. Its response characteristics and performance are investigated in details. The results show that this PID control system is robust, fast and have good anti-interference performance, which make it very suitable for the variable complicated work condition of gasoline engine.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting High-temperature Stability of Asphalt Mixture Based on Grey Relation Entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Grey relation entropy method was utilized to analyze the influence dgree of factors affecting high-temperature stability of asphalt mixture, and the influences of pressure and air void (compaction degree) were researched further. The results indicated that: 1) the sequence of influnece dgree (from important to unimportant) is pressure → temperature→air void→passing percentage of 4.75mm sized aggregate → filler-asphalt ratio → asphalt content → nominal maximum size of aggregate; 2) deficient compaction and heavy load lower the rut-resistance of asphalt pavement, and the influence of pressure is more conspicuous when compaction degree further reduces; 3) the high-temperature stability is overrated by dynamic stability of asphalt mixture with 100% compaction degree in laboratory.

articleTitle: A Decoupling Control Method Based on Backstepping Control and ESO Compensation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: For a class of nonlinear MIMO system, a novel decoupling control method was proposed. Firstly, equivalent input of each subsystem was designed using backstepping method. Then, the total uncertainties including coupling effect, external disturbance and parameter time-varying of each subsystem was estimated via an ESO, and the estimated value was introduced into the backstepping controller to compensate. At last, decoupling and control were achieved. The convergence of the new method was proved via Lyapunov stability theory. Simulation result showed the method can achieved fast response, good decoupling effect and good robustness.

articleTitle: A Modified Segmentation Algorithm for Infrared Image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to fill the internal holes in the infrared image segmentation, based on the features of infrared image object, a modified segmentation algorithm for infrared image is proposed. The algorithm , Firstly, the aircraft image is segmented by Ostu method. Then, the contour of object is extracted by contour tracking. Finally, the whole region of object is filled by scan line filling algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can the effective extraction of the object region.

articleTitle: Study on Three-Dimensional Interactive Integration Road Safety Route Selection CAD System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Base on the interactive operating speed design idea, the road plane, vertical, cross section and operating speed interactive linkage is realized by using the multi-window linkage technology. Safety audit and route selection are integrated in this paper. Safety audit is done by using operating speed calculation model that recommended by “Guidelines for Safety Audit of Highway” while designing the road plane, vertical and cross section. The operating speed of vehicle running in the design alignment is simulated by using three-dimensional simulation in order to check the road safety. Driving simulation can also be done by using joystick or keyboard and its data can be record and used for further road safety analysis, pavement damage analysis, and so on. A system based on above techniques and methods is developed and successfully applied to road design.

articleTitle: Effects of Higher Order Mode Waves on Muffler Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The existence of higher order mode waves (HOMW) in expansion mufflers is proved theoretically. The 3 - D finite element method is used to obtain the four-pole parameters of a muffler which are in turn used to calculate the transmission loss. With this method, the distribution of sound pressure in a muffler is obtained, the effects of HOMW on the muffler performance are investigated and a technique to improve the muffler performance is put forward. It shows that, because of HOMW, the sound wave in expansion chamber is not in plane form; HOMW can decrease the capability of muffler; and the positions of inlet and outlet are important to the performance of mufflers.

articleTitle: Research on Inventory Optimization Model of Spare Parts under Zero-Out-of-Stock Constraint
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In some manufacture, process, the out-of-service of equipments could cause great economic loss or even industrial accidents, therefore, the critical spare parts of equipments must be managed through the constraint of zero-out-of-stock. Based on the inventory management of critical spare parts of manufacturing equipments, this paper builds the inventory optimization model of critical spare parts of manufacturing equipments under zero-out-of-stock constraint, and algorithm to solve optimum relation in the concept of backward induction is showed and then an optimal acquisition strategy is solved by this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Edge Detection Based on Mathematical Morphology Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper reviews the connection between mathematical morphology and rough set theory. To verify the validity of the new method, some of applications of mathematical morphology based on rough sets for image processing such as edge detection are presented. Simulation examples show that the mathematical morphology based on rough sets possesses precision properties. The performance of the mathematical morphology based on rough sets is much better than the traditional mathematical morphology.

articleTitle: Tire-Imprints Image Enhancement Algorithm Based on Wavelet Transformation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To improve utilization rate of tire-imprints, a Wavelet-based algorithm for the tire-imprints image enhancement is proposed on the basis of wavelet's theory in this paper. First, the high frequency (HF) coefficients are distinguished due to signal from those due to noise with the correlation between wavelet levels, then, increases the wavelet coefficient due to signal and suppresses those of noise. Experiment results show that the algorithm can achieve an excellent balance between the enhancement of subtle tire-imprint image detail and the avoidance of noise amplification compared with traditional image enhancement algorithm.

articleTitle: Tracking Maneuvering Target on Airport Surface Based on IMM-UKF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Aiming at tracking maneuvering target of SMR (Surface Movement Radar), this paper establishes a constant acceleration motion model, constant turn motion model and constant velocity motion model according to the actual movement of aircraft. On the base of these models, the IMM-UKF filter tracking algorithm is designed by introducing Unscented Kalman filter (UKF) into the interacting multiple model (IMM) algorithm. And IMM-UKF is compared with IMM-EKF (extended Kalman filter) algorithms. Simulation results show that IMM-UKF algorithm has good stability, and it overcomes the divergence problem of the EKF filter. The tracking accuracy and the model of transition speed are better than IMM-EKF algorithm.

articleTitle: Real-Time Reliability Optimization of CAN Control Network Based on RMA for Independent Drive Electric Vehicle's Powertrain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: According to work principle of controller area network (CAN) protocol, the use of CAN in time-critical and safety-critical control applications such as independent drived electric vehicle's powertrains presented designers with new special problems on the determination of real-time reliability rather than real-time capability. In this paper, real-time reliability analysis of the native event-triggered CAN for a 2-motor independent drive electric vehicle (IDEV) was researched and real-time reliability optimization based on rate monotonic algorithm (RMA) was discussed contrastively. The parameters including real-time capability, maximum response time, maximum bandwidth utilization, maximum periods jitter and jitter margin were evaluated respectively. The calculation results demonstrated that real-time reliability of the CAN based on RMA is better than the native CAN as underlying control network of IDEV's powertrains. The result indicates real-time reliability analysis and optimization can improve the reliability of IDEV's distributed control systems, provides a theory analysis foundation for the engineering design and application of IDEV.

articleTitle: The Development Strategy of Modern Logistics in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to promote the economic growth pattern's transformation, adjust the economic and industrial structure, and improve the capability and level of service to central economic zone, the problems of modern logistics development in Henan Province were analyzed. Taking resources and products advantages into consideration, the eight categories of logistics, namely grain, coal, etc., was proposed as the focus of logistics development. Through OD survey and by means of linear regression, time series method, the total logistics demands in Henan Province were studied. Then the overall spatial layout logistics was identified, and the modern logistics network supported by regional logistics hub, integrated logistics park and professional logistics center was established as well. By analyzing the development condition of the 3PL(Third-Party Logistics), the method of demonstration analysis was applied to analyze the specific strategies for reasonable development of 3PL in Henan Province. Eventually, the big logistics system, which takes Zhengzhou as the development core, covers the whole Henan province and radiates to surrounding areas, was determined. Research indicates that the new logistics system can adapt to the needs of the logistics market, accelerate the pace of informational effectively, optimize the allocation of resources, and promote the overall competitiveness of modern logistics in Henan Province.

articleTitle: Optimization of Configuration for Retro-reflective Sheeting in Guide Signs Based on Dynamic Intervention Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on psychological theories, the paper analyzed the relationship between the acuity and the brightness ratio of the letter and background in guide signs. Because the luminance values for the five grades of the retro-reflective sheeting were constant and the gap was wide in the GB5768-1999 Traffic Signs and Markings on the roads, the luminance values of the background were adjusted dynamically by adding declining sheeting onto it. By field experiments, the impact of the grade of retro-reflective sheeting on the visibility was studied, and the relationship between the luminance values and visibility distance was established. The results show that there exists a certain brightness ratio which can optimize visibility, and we get the best configuration for the retroreflective sheeting grade of letter and background when the luminance value of the letter is 600 cd·lx<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>, that of the background is 92.5 cd·lx<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> with a visibility distance of 141.9m,which indicate that the current grade of the signs is high, and should be lowered.

articleTitle: Compositive Assessment Model of Flame Combustion Stability Based on Grey Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The assessment of flame combustion stability play a vital role in the safe, economic, environment protection operation of the large capacity pulverized coal boilers. In this paper, the flame radiation intensity signal is acquired by a low-cost flame detection device. Fast Fourier transform is used to exact power spectrum of frequency domain and phase domain from time domain signals based upon wavelet de-noising methodology. The characteristic parameters the variance of the intensity value, the flicker frequency and the average phase, which reflect time domain, frequency domain and phase domain respectively, are extracted. A compositive assessment model for the stability of flame combustion using the grey theory is proposed which is based on the extraction of flame radiation characteristic parameters from measured data, and a stability index system for the assessment of flame combustion established. The assessment results demonstrate this method is feasible and efficient. As a result, a promising approach is introduced for the diagnose of the flame stability.

articleTitle: On the Basis of AHP Strategic Alliance Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Strategic alliance is one of the most important strategic activities in the present business environment. Alliance stability remains a big challenge both from academic and managerial perspectives. With the development of modern logistics and big demand for steel in China, the author use Analytic Hierarchy Process to investigates factors influencing strategic alliance between steel company and logistics service provider. Then, Delphi method is used and alliance stability score is calculated. Finally, suggestions for alliance stability are discussed and recommended.

articleTitle: Application of Steel Banded Reinforcement Technique in Rural Road and Bridge Rebuilding
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Epoxy steel slab bended reinforcement is using epoxy series agglomerant bend steel slab or box iron at the weak position of steel concrete constructures. Steel slab or box iron and steel concrete constitutes a whole body. It can replace reinforcement steel, increase carrying power of structures. On the base of strengthening medium and little span bridges in rural road and bridge rebuilding, providing epoxy steel slab banded reinforcement technique. By analyzing the nature and usage of epoxy steel slab, detailed introducing the construction technology and the key problems of epoxy steel slab banded reinforcing bridges and providing reference for bridge maintenance and reinforcement. The technique of Epoxy steel slab bended reinforcement not only can be used in strengthening main arch of arch bridges, but also can be used in strengthening beam of beam bridges. When using the technique of Epoxy steel slab bended reinforcement, communication can’t be broken and the old bridge can’t be demolished. The technique of Epoxy steel slab bended reinforcement can save fundandit can reduce erection time.

articleTitle: Research on the Cooperation Model Between Traffic Guidance and Traffic Control Based on Intelligent and Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper analyzes the significance of cooperation and summarizes the related researches. Then, this paper puts forward the aims and some problems of cooperation. Under the director of these aims, this paper constructs a cooperation architecture on the basis of intelligent and cooperative information technique and establishes a series of cooperation models with different objective functions. After that, it makes a description of the test road network and the simulation environment. Some simulation results are brought out to prove the feasibility of the whole cooperation architecture and compare different models. Finally, a best cooperation model is advised to be applied in practice.

Author Keywords: Cooperation Between Traffic Guidance & Traffic Control

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of C3H6 on NO Conversion Rate in a NTP Reactor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to study the NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> plasma chemistry reaction mechanisms in NO/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> and NO/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> mixture gases, a coaxial tubular plasma reactor based on dielectric barrier discharge was designed, the effects of the C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> initial concentration on NO oxidation and reduction reactions were observed. The results showed that NO reduction reaction was very low and energy consumption was very high in NO/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture gases, however, when C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> was added, NO conversion rate significantly increased. In NO/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture gases, NO oxidation and reduction reactions simultaneously occurred and the oxidation of NO to NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was the main reactions, when C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> was added to the mixture gases, NO conversion rate significantly increased and the energy consumption largely reduced.

articleTitle: Parametric Spectral Properties of Optical Parametric Amplification Based on Broadband Pump
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The spectral properties of nonlinear optical parametric amplification(OPA) based on collinear broadband pump are investigated theoretically. Taking into account the monochromatic pump parametric bandwidth(BW) and the derivative of pump wavelength varying with parametric wavelength, we present a method to determine the parametric spectral BW based on broadband pump source. Mathematical expression to describe the parametric spectral BW based on broadband pump is achieved. Results show good accordance with simulations and experiments published. It is helpful for optimal design of OPAs and optical parametric oscillators(OPOs), especially for ultra-fast optical frequency conversion.

articleTitle: The unbiased filtering for uncertainty systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: An <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</sup>∞ filer on uncertainty discrete time system is studied in this paper. Through the way of linear matrix inequality, an <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</sup>∞ filer designing for uncertainty system is transformed a question for settling optimization. In this paper the exist condition of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</sup>∞ is deduced. The method reduced calculated amount and easily separate Lyapunov matrix from parameter of system by importing an additional variable of matrix. Numerical example is provided to demonstrate the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Land Economical Use for Expressway Construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the light of the scarcity of the land resource of China, the research on economical use of land for expressway construction has great practical significance. This paper firstly defines the concept and connotation of land economical use on micro-level, then constructs a set of evaluation index system for expressway land economical use with regard to the quantity of the covered land, the structure, function and efficiency of land use. This paper further determines the standard value and practical value of each index by taking the actual situation of HengShui-DaMing section in DaQing-GuangZhou expressway into consideration, then carries out non-dimensional treatment to the index and builds a comprehensive index model by employing the multi-factor evaluation method on the basis of entropy-weighted technique. The result of the evaluation shows that the land use of HengShui-DaMing section in DaQing-GuangZhou expressway meets the standard of land economical use.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Image Enlargement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this study, a novel split method was proposed to enlarge low resolution image. Instead of maintaining the grey levels of original pixels and estimating the grey levels for newly added pixels, the proposed approach split the original pixel, into new pixels. Two approaches are proposed to estimate grey levels for the new pixels, namely zero order split approach and 2nd order split approach. Degraded images and low resolution images were used to test the proposed approach. Results show that the proposed zero order split approach had much better results than other approaches tested for bi-color images such as license plate image. For general images, the image enlarged by the second order split approach had higher contrast than that enlarged by the bicubic interpolation method.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Vehicle Traffic Accidents Rescue
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: At present, as a serious social problem, traffic accidents are categorized as minor accidents, general accidents, major accidents and serious incidents, and more attention is paid to the statistics and analysis of traffic accidents rather than the rescue work. In this paper, a new category of vehicle traffic accidents based on vehicle rescue is proposed to immediately dispose traffic accidents. For lack of specialized vehicle recovery equipment, a novel vehicle recovery equipment is designed. And then, the integrated vehicle rescue equipment, which is capable of towing, lifting, and vehicle recovery, is proposed. The virtual prototype model of the integrated vehicle rescue equipment is built by using CATIA, and its main features are presented in detail. Finally, the necessity and the method to form the operation standard and to carry out the training are introduced.

articleTitle: The Application of VISSIM in the Intersection at Grade of Urban Road Nanshaomen Intersection for Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The intersection at grade of urban road is an important part in road system, once the intersection appears traffic jam, the traffic effective operation can be affected. How to improve the capacity of the intersection means very important. Traffic simulation is an effective way to solve traffic problems. It utilizes modern computer technology to realize practical traffic system specialty, analyzes traffic system's probable action in sorts of limited condition. In this paper, regarding Nanshaomen intersection as studying target, the existing problems in present intersection are found and the reasonable signal timing scheme and traffic lane divider scheme in intersection are put forward with the help of VISSIM, on the basis of investigation the present traffic quantity in peak time, signal timing scheme and traffic lane function divider. The improved scheme is evaluated on motor vehicles travel time, speed, line up length. The result indicates the scheme can reduce the vehicle delay and improve the capacity of the intersection effectively, and the application of VISSIM in the intersection at grade of urban road can get to good effect. It provides the effective reference to solve increasingly serious traffic jam in the intersection at grade of urban road.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on Dynamic Response of Highway Roadbed Slope
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: As the transfer channel and tie of modern material flow, energy flow and information flow, highway plays an important role in the whole economic development. The dynamic response characteristics of highway roadbed slope under the action of seismic dynamic loading are analyzed in this paper. Furthermore, the dynamic response rules under the cohesion influence of roadbed soil are analyzed in detail. Finally, the amplification coefficient distribution of acceleration, velocity, displacement and relative displacement are comprehensively analyzed under various cohesions. And the final plastic zone is gained.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence Factors of Common Rail System's Injection Mass
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The injection mass of common rail system is determined by rail pressure and injector energizing time. Under different rail pressure, single injection experiments have been performed; under the same rail pressure two injections (preinjection and main injection) tests with various intervals have been carried out. According to the analysis of the results, find that at the start-up and stop stages the injection rate becomes faster with increasing rail pressure and the injection characteristics for common-rail system tends to rectangular jet. When the rail pressure is low, the needle valve has slow response, and the effective flow area of the injector greatly influences the jet law. When the rail pressure is improved, the valve's response speed will be increased remarkably and the injection rate is mainly affected by the rail pressure. During multiple injections the needle valve lift has affected on the mass of the main injection more than the rail pressure fluctuations caused by pre-injection.

articleTitle: Adaptive Video Coding Scheme Based on Spatial Resolution Regulation on Low Bit-Rate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper describes a novel video coding scheme based on spatial resolution regulation. By comparing the R-D performance of spatially down-sampling coding scheme with standard coding schemes, the proposed coding scheme begins with coding the low-resolution edition of video sequence and subsequently coding difference video sequence when the bit-rate exceeds a threshold. The new scheme can be easily integrated into many current video codec with only slight change and improve both the coding performance and the computing complexity significantly on low bit-rate. At the same time, it allows for the flexibly spatial and rate scalability thanks to its progressive coding structure. Experimental results show that the proposed video coding scheme has better subjective and objective quality in the relatively wide range of low bit-rate.

articleTitle: A New Method To Predict Fatigue Crack Growth Life for the Armored Hull
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on theories of dynamics of multi-body systems and linear elastic fracture mechanics, by using virtual prototyping technique, the model of tracked vehicle is established, and stress spectrums of the armored hull's weak points are tested by virtual experiments. Considering the size of the crack and the fracture characteristic of the material, the life of the crack growing from initial size to a certain size is predicted, and a new practicable technique to predict the fatigue crack growth life is developed in this paper.

articleTitle: Logistics Countermeasures for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises and Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this article, taking the cluster of small and medium-sized enterprises in Guangdong as an example, we try to figure out a solution to the problem of how to improve the competitiveness and the general sustainable development potential of the cluster. We also analyze the relation between the development of the cluster and modern logistics from the angle of industrial cluster. In this way, we focus on the current situation of logistics in cluster and try to find out the problems of the cluster and the enterprises inside, and finally give countermeasure for improving the logistics level of the enterprises and optimizing the operation of logistics.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy On-ramp Metering and Simulation in Urban Expressway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: As the uncertain characteristics of traffic flow in urban expressway, fuzzy control can be used as an effectual way to solve traffic problem. A fuzzy logic approach is proposed to adjust the number of vehicles entering a mainline of urban expressway via entrance ramp during rush traffic times. The fuzzy logic onramp controller of urban expressway is designed based on such traffic information as the speed downstream mainline at the on-ramp, time occupancy upstream mainline at the on-ramp, and on-ramp queue length at the Surface Street. Simulation research based on MATLAB toolbox is carried out and the results show that the fuzzy ramp metering controller has a better performance for the traffic flow of urban expressway and it can avoid traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Offset, Bisector and Medial Axis Construction on NURBS Surface Based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Operation such as offset, bisector and Medial Axis(MA) construction on NURBS surface is an important issue in the CAD/CAM application. One of the most difficulty problems in the computation of offset curve, offset MA and bisector construction is a directly subsequent removal of self-intersection loop. Many literatures have been reported by different technology such as geometry, snake and so on. But they are complex and not efficient. We put forward to a new approach to NURBS surface operation using the graphics hardware Based on GPU. By the offset data (offset surface) on boundary curve on the NURBS surface, the detection and removal of self-intersection are achieved through a GPU program process using the graphics hardware. This new approach technology has been used in our boundary conformed and spiral toolpath generation program.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of the Cycle and Critical Phase on Signal Control Intersection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Signal timing optimization is one of the most important methods that improve the intersection serve level. The paper studies the signal optimization method that the phases have overlapped phase, the bi-level optimization method is used to solve the questions. Firstly, the critical phase is introduced in detail. Then the cycle optimization method TRRL and ARRB is described. Based on the cycle optimization method, the critical phase optimization method is given. Through an example, it is tested that intersection’s average delay is decreased by 21.37%, the average vehicle queue is decreased 10 pcu/c, the intersection capacity is increased 0.93% and the saturation of the intersection is reduce from 1.38 to 0.93. It is proved that the method given in this paper can make the signal time more effectively and the intersection has better serve level.

articleTitle: Research on Chaos Characters of Velocity in Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the NS Model, a mixed traffic flow on single lane is simulated in the paper, which includes two-classification vehicles owing the different max-velocity, and a chaos recognition algorithm based on composite feature is advanced. How the traffic flow is changed for different density and different discrete degree and which channel is the right way to chaos is researched. And the influence of the density of traffic flow and the discrete of following-velocity on the chaos of traffic flow is analyzed in different values named approximate entropy and statistical complexity, which are changed as the mixed proportionality factor.

articleTitle: Performance-Based Fire Protection Design Method for Large Cross-Section Road Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Under the background of performance-based code for fire protection design of building, and on the basis of the state-of-the-art of fire safety engineering as well as prescriptive-based code for fire protection design of road tunnel, this paper outlines the framework of performance-based fire protection analysis and design method for large cross-section road tunnel. The framework provide a preliminary guidance on the application of scientific and engineering principles to the protection of such road tunnels from the unwanted effects of fire.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Light-Weight Aggregate Concrete Boards in the Renovation of Bridges
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Dynamic performance is compared and studied between normal concrete and light-weight aggregate concrete hollow board in the renovation of bridges under the same intension. Based on the theory and experiment, together with practical project, performance and destructive features of light-weight aggregate concrete hollow board are analyzed, and the bearing ability of the board is defined. Light-weight aggregate concrete hollow board has a relatively small remnant distortion, and an approximately linear relationship between load and flexibility exists. But light-weight aggregate concrete hollow board has a small cracking load, and its crack appears earlier and splits quicker than that of the normal concretes under the same condition. Therefore, attention should be paid to the calculation of the maximum width of the crack in design. The test analysis will be helpful for the application of light-weight aggregate concrete in the building of bridges.

articleTitle: The Study on Energy Loss Distribution Law for Energy System of Oil Depot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The Grey box models of pipeline subsystem and oil depot total system have been set up in accordance with practical production process of a certain oil depot in Daqing Oilfield by applying thermodynamic analysis method of energy system. Analysis criteria of energy loss are put forward on the basis of energy using models and energy balance equations. According to operating parameters during production, energy loss distribution in each part of the system has been worked out. Then, the forming reasons of relatively large energy loss are analyzed, so that improvement direction of energy saving measures can be pointed out in order to provide theory foundation for enhancing energy using levels of the oil depot system.

articleTitle: A Robust Cooperative Collision Warning Algorithm for Unreliable Wireless Communication Channel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In vehicular ad hoc networks (VANET), Inter-Vehicle real-time information access and transfer is the key problem to solving or reducing traffic accidents. It is possible to locate and track a vehicle based on its transmissions, during communication with other vehicles or the road-side infrastructure. On the basis of vehicle active safety technology, this paper proposed a new message broadcast mechanism based on inter-vehicle communication which replaces the original model using ranging sensors to judge the safety of vehicles, by real-time information collection and transmission to inform other vehicles the state of the vehicle neighborhood, and to make risk judgments and warning drivers to effectively prevent accidents.

articleTitle: Impact of Flights Delays on Productivity of Yangtze River Delta Airports
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper discusses productivity of 10 airports around Yangtze River Delta in 2007. This study differs from previous work in that both desirable and undesirable outputs (i.e., number of delays flights) are considered. A nonparametric directional output distance function, rather than the traditional Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA), was applied. For comparison purposes, a DEA model without consideration of undesirable outputs was also estimated. The results show that after flights delays are taken into assessment, many small, less congested airports are found more efficient, which even on the efficient frontier. Overall, the evaluation results should be more comprehensive and fairer in sense. They indicate that there may be a balance between quantity and quality of outputs in the achievement of efficient outcomes.

articleTitle: CFD Simulation of Vault Temperature for Vehicle Fire in Large Cross-Section Road Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: On the basis of CFD models, the simulation analysis of a lorry and car fire in large cross-section road tunnel was carried out in this paper. The vault temperature was simulated and compared with the value calculated by correlative empirical equation. The corresponding results would be contributed to provide effective technique for the fire protection measures of themajor structure of road tunnel.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Image Denoising Based on Gauss Curvature and Gradient
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The Gauss curvature-driven diffusion model for image denoising, which have been proposed by S H Lee and J K Seo, can preserve important structures of image. It uses the Gauss curvature as the conductance function that determines the amount of diffusion. However, the influence of image's gradient is not considered in the process of denoising. Therefore, the Gauss curvature-driven diffusion model would inevitably blur the edges where there are both high gradient and nonzero Gauss curvature. In this paper, we propose an improved method for image denoising by using a combination of the gradient and the Gauss curvature as the diffusion conductance. Some experiments show that the improved model outperforms the Gauss curvature-driven diffusion model in terms of both mean square error (MSE) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR).

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Video Compression System Based on H.264
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper introduces a new method of video-compress based on H.264. The coding algorithm adopts 3-D wavelet transformation and Shape Coding. In hardware implement, DSP chips and FPGA chips is adopted, FPGA completes the task of multiply clock periods operate, while DSP chips accomplishes the function of both the single clock period operate and the control of FPGA relocated calculation. Experimental result indicates the design can improve coding efficiency and get a good tradeoff between bit-rate and distortion. The method is shown to be simple, efficient and suitable for hardware implementation.

articleTitle: Inverse Characteristics of Magnetically Controlled Shape Memory Alloy under External Force
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Magnetically controlled shape memory alloy (MSMA) is a class of smart material that changes shape when it is exposed to a moderate magnetic field, which provides a new way to produce motion and force. The MSMA material has also another property: the MSMA material can change its magnetic property when it is subjected to external force, which is known as inverse characteristics of MSMA. In this paper, a testing device which is used to testing inverse characteristics of MSM material is presented, the larger variation of magnetic flux density is caused when the MSMA material is mechanically compressed with static force, the larger induced voltage is output under impact force, the change laws of induced voltage peak-peak are studied under different input conditions of exciting force. The experimental results lay a foundation for sensor application.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics System and Critical Path Optimization of Wood-Based Panel Enterprise: A View Based on Circular Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: With the development of economy and the improvement of living standards, returned products in production and consumption have increased. In terms of circular economy, this paper constructs the structure of reverse logistics system of wood-based panel enterprises, according to the character of the reverse flow of wooden material. Then, based on system composition, this paper analyzes and verifies the determination and the optimization of critical path.

articleTitle: Vehicles' Motion Parameters Detection in Intersection Based on Videos of Low View Angle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: By taking Visual C++ and OpenCV as tools and processing video image sequences gathered by one camera under low view angle, suitable foreground detection method of intersection was selected. Through improving blob tracking system provided by OpenCV, the program was developed to detect motion parameters of vehicles in intersection. The motion parameters were smoothed by Kalman filter. It made the data more reliably. The research could be applied in detections of the traffic conflict and traffic information.

articleTitle: A New Identification Technique Based on Binocular Visual System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the principle of parallax of binocular visual system, three-dimensional of target is acquired by a lot of images. One identification technique for three-dimensional (3D) target is proposed in this paper. The characteristic information of target is extracted and reconstructed after images which are collected in OpenCV are pre-processed; Finally, based on Support Vector Machine package, the target system is distinguished by comparing characteristic and template.

articleTitle: Luminescence and Energy Transfer of Ce3+, Dy3+ in YAB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The YAl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>:Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sub>, Dy<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sub> phosphor was synthesized by high temperature solid state reaction. The luminescence properties and the energy transfer between Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Dy<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> were investigated. The emission bands of this phosphor peaked at 419 nm, 483 nm, 575 nm and 667 nm were originated from 5d→4f transition of Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and 4F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9/2</sub>→6H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15/2</sub>, 4F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9/2</sub>→6H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13/2</sub>, 4F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9/2</sub>→6H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11/2</sub> transition of Dy<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> respectively. With the increasing of Dy<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> concentration, the intensity of fixed concentration Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> decreased and the intensity of Dy<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> was simultaneously increased. It suggests that there is an energy transfer from Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> to Dy<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> in YAl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> host. According to the Dexter's energy transfer formula of multipolar interaction, the energy transfer between Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Dy<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> is due to the dipole-dipole interaction of the resonance transfer.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Tunnel Geological Prediction Online Consultation Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To improve the accuracy of tunnel geological prediction, based on the modern network information technology, a online consultation platform about tunnel geological prediction was made up by PHP and MySQL. The platform relies on the State Key Laboratory of Geohazard Prevention & Geoenvironment Protection, together with lots of well-known experts and professors at inland and abroad, and based on their intellectual support, comprehensively analyze the field geological data and geophysical survey results through online submission of clients such as construction units, and feedback suggestion to clients in time. Consultation platform is easy to operate and fast, through it, construction units are available to gain a reliable advanced geological prediction result, and timely feedback to guide the construction and improve the construction safety of tunnel.

articleTitle: Implementation of Shallow Sea Depth Remote Sensing Module Based on ENVI Redevelopment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Water depth mapping plays an important role in water conservancy, shipping, offshore project and so on. This paper considers a high-resolution IKONOS satellite image as the research object, bases on double-band ratio method, accomplishes shallow sea depth remote sensing module on ENVI(The Environment for Visualizing Images) software platform. The paper is organized as follows: Firstly, it introduces the characteristic of IDL (Interactive Data Language) and ENVI which is professional software for remote sensing, and also discusses the approaches to expansion and customization. Subsequently, software module development process is elaborated. Finally, the good result demonstrates that the proposed approach possesses considerable suitability and applicability. The research depicted in this thesis provides a software platform solution, which brings the technology of RS-Fathoming into practical applications. As mentioned above, the proposed approach will contribute to both military and economy.

articleTitle: The Research of the Cycle Slips' Detection Method in GPS Navigation and Positioning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Overview the reason of causing GPS cycle slips and the importance of detecting cycle slips, and summarize the methods which are used to detection, emphatically discuss the thought that use the wavelet analysis to examine the cycle slips. And though practical engineering example, we prove that this method is feasibility and availability.

articleTitle: Logistic Planning and Decision under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The article analyzes the empty container reposition (ECR) issue with uncertain conditions which commonly encountered in realistic situation, and establishes an opportunity restriction ECR model based on the random demand of the inland reposition system. Also it discusses the resolution of the ECR model in which the objective function contains random parameters, and consequently provides two-Phase Stochastic Simulation GA to calculate the reposition model. Meanwhile with the sample analysis and comparison with ECR under a certain condition, it is proved that the model is feasible and also in accordance with realistic situation, by which a new idea is offered to investigate the topic of random inland ECR.

articleTitle: Optimization of Longitudinal Section Design of Railway Coal Logistics Yard in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Coal transportation from Xinjiang to the hinterland china is a strategic program to ensure energy safety. As the most important mode of coal transportation, the railways should adapt itself to the gale weather especially in Xinjiang. New approaches to the optimization of yard longitudinal section design are based on evaluating the performance in respect of construction and operation. In gale weather the indexes of gradient and length of slope are especially essential as a variable in yard design in Xinjiang coal logistics. 4 models are established, combined with the major car types - C64 gondola car to calculate gradients and lengths of slope according to various wind speed under different operational conditions, which offers a recommendable solution for prevent gale damage of stopping cars in yards, especially economical and flexible in existing ones.

articleTitle: Port Withdrawal Mechanism in China Based on a Low-Carbon Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Low-carbon development is the inevitable trend of national economic development, and as one of the main pollution sources towards urban environment, it is advisable for port to implement a low-carbon withdrawal mechanism, which has become a realistic choice in sustainable development of port city. The necessity of port low-carbon withdrawal mechanism is firstly explained in the paper, and then four operation modes of port low-carbon withdrawal mechanism suitable for Chinese ports are summarized, namely housing & habitation mode, business & office mode, culture & entertainment mode and environment-protection mode. Finally the coordination development degree is used as the implementation condition of port low-carbon withdrawal mechanism, in order to provide a new idea for realizing the sustainable development of ports in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Competence Evolvement Mechanism of the Civil Aviation Transport Industry Based on the System Cooperation Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The competition in the international civil aviation transport market is becoming more and more drastic. Chinese civil aviation transport industry must strengthen its competence in order to survive and develop in the international competition and to accelerate Chinese economy development and society advancement. This paper has firstly defined the competence of civil aviation transport industry clearly and analyzed the industry system. Then, the evolvement mechanism of t he civil aviation transport industry competence was analyzed deeply from both inner and outer angles. Based it, the evolvement mechanism was studied from three aspects: Environment Effect, Dimension Effect and Structure Effect. Then the cooperation relationship was studied especially as the main representation of Structure Effect. Finally, the cooperation degree analysis model of civil aviation transport industry competence was put forward.

articleTitle: Image Processing Algorithms of Calibration at the Accident Scene
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Two steps were taken to extract image feature points. One is to use some image processing technology to improve image quality, namely the image preprocessing, second is the accurate extraction of the characteristic point and lines. An improved Harris corner detection operator and sub-pixel corner detection feature extraction were implemented for the accident scene calibration object to improve the detection accuracy of the image feature points.

articleTitle: Driver Factor Characteristics of Traffic Safety on the Low Traffic Volume Qinghai-Tibet Highway in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Traffic safety on low traffic volume highway is one of the hidden threats against road traffic safety and the characteristic of driver factor is an important factor which cannot be neglected among various accident causes in China. The present study conducts a test on driver factor of 25 drivers. It chooses the Geermu-Kunlun Mountain Entrance road section of the low traffic volume Qinghai-Tibet Highway as its trial section. The instruments concluding dynamic GPS, dynamic electrocardiogram and eye tracker are proposed as real-time measurement of subject drivers' driving speed, vision point, driving workload, and other parameters and indexes. This study analyzes the human factor which vehicle running speed and track characteristics of driving behavior, eye movement and driver behavior of driver characteristics based on the dynamic interaction among driver, vehicle, road, and environment. Compared with traffic accident on low traffic volume highway in plateau area, experimental research conclusion indicates that driver factor is the key factor of traffic accident. The conclusions provide an important reference for traffic safety technology and management on low traffic volume highway in plateau area.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Research on Fluid Fields of the Refrigerated Truck
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: With the aid of computational Fluid Dynamics technique, the K-ε turbulence model is adopted to simulate the three-dimensional static airflow and temperature distribution inside the refrigerated truck on the platform of FLUNET, and the reliability of the simulation was certificated with the experiments. The result shows that the temperature of compartment entrance is lowest and while behind the body is the highest. Besides, it also shows that proliferation of the heat flow in vertical direction is obvious quicker than in horizontal direction and the gradient of temperature change is quite obvious near the side of bodywork.

articleTitle: A Study on the Evaluation Method of the Freeway Traffic Accidents Forewarning System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Evaluation method is a core technology in the freeway traffic accidents forewarning system. This paper used the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model based on Analytic Hierarchy Process which integrated the advantages of both Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation and AHP. Based on the Fuzzy Theory, some evaluation factors that are difficult to quantify and whose boundaries are unclear have been quantified. In actual evaluations, Delphi Method is used to quantify the qualitative factors. The establishment of the criteria weight sets uses AHP. According to the principal of the forewarning system, the evaluation criteria system was established. Finally, an illustration is given to show how this method works. The result shows that Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation based on AHP is an effective method to evaluate the safety condition of a freeway system in the freeway traffic accidents forewarning system.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Shaft Area on Alleviating Tunnel Aerodynamic Effects Through Dynamic Model Test
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Series of compression waves and expansion waves caused by EMUs entering tennels at high speed will give rise to a series of tunnel aerodynamic effects: excessive pressure change will not only has effect on the fatigue life of EMU bodies and subsidiary structures in tunnels but also endangers the riding comfort of passengers. In addition, tunnel micro-pressure waves can even cause noise which effect the surrounding environment. Installing ventilation shafts inside tunnels is helpful to alleviate tunnel aerodynamic effects and the area of ventilation shaft is an important parameter. Dynamic model test system in Central South University was used in this paper to test and analyze the compression waves and expansion waves caused by trains entering tunnels and micro-pressure waves formed at tunnel exit, and to compare the influence of shaft with different area on the pressure change inside tunnel, the pressure change on train surface and the micro-pressure wave amplitudes. Test results show that the pressure changes inside tunnel and on train surface can be reduced effectively when the shaft area is 10% of the tunnel area; The larger the shaft area is, the smaller the tunnel micro-pressure amplitude will be.

articleTitle: Maneuvering Characteristics Study in Steady State of Human-Ship System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: According to the ship maneuvering control system block diagram of artificial. the paper does the analysis for factors of steady state of ship, and establishes their own transfer function, and does the simulation, and proposes indicators of various aspects, from the people, ships and ship systems. Finally, simulation is done for the optimal control of ship steady state and a strategy to maintain a smooth sailing ship is proposed.

articleTitle: Discussion on Section Construction Techniques for Continuous Bridge of Large-Span Concrete
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: During constructing bridges, it is very important to select a correct method. According to the natural environment, construction conditions and social environment, selecting a reasonable job practice will bring about yield good economic returns for constructing bridges. Combining with the characteristic of big span continuous concrete bridge, this paper proposes four sorts of methods on section construction technique of big span continuous concrete bridge. They are cantilever construction method, span by span construction method, bit by bit construction method and propulsion construction method. Each method has its characteristic. On the basis of detailed discussing these four methods, the paper compares their advantages and disadvantages and their scope of application, draws some useful conclusions. Such as, the cantilever construction method can’t use bear frame. So, it can often be used where road crosses channel or other highway. Span by span construction method can locate prestressed reinforcement at the suitable site and can save high-strength material, etc. This paper supplies some useful reference for bridge construction and design.

articleTitle: A Review of Some Available Human Neck Finite Element Models in Vehicle Crash Conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This study reviewed some available FE human neck models developed by some researchers used for human neck injury biomechanics, neck responses and injury predicting. The different ways of anatomical modeling, the material properties and model validation approaches in the models are summarized and compared for better understanding the FE human neck modeling. An advanced FE human neck model developed at Hunan University was introduced and showed good biofidelity in low speed frontal, rear-end and side impact. It could be used to study the head-neck kinematics and valuable in the research on neck injury mechanisms.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Long-Term Down Deflection from the Long-Span Concrete Girder Bridge on the Structure Stress
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This thesis wages a study on the characteristic of long-term down deflection deriving from the large-span concrete continuous girder bridge, introducing the equivalent bending moment instead of mid-span deflection, both of which can produce an effect on the structure stress, building the relational expression between equivalent bending moment and mid-span deflection with equal stiffness principle and mechanics of materials axiom employed, and hereby gaining the calculation expression of the stress increment triggered by the deflection. Basing on a pre-stressed concrete continuous girder bridge with it's span combination of 70m+110m+70m and a pre-stressed concrete continuous rigid-frame bridge with it's span combination of 75m+130m+75m, this thesis calculates the stress increment triggered by mid-span deflection, with the results showing that the mid-span deflection has a bigger influence on the structure stress. When the deflect value is bigger, beam will crack and there exists a close connection between deflection and crack.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Silver Structures Fabricated by Two-Photon Femtolaser
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: For the feasibility discussion of metal ion reduction induced by the femtosecond laser two-photon absorption of organic polymer materials, the experiments are taken in silver nitrate and polyvinylpyrrolidone(PVP) film which mixed by the molar ratio of 1:1. In the developed two-photon fabrication system, a single line with the width of 25 μm and a 4 mm × 0.4 mm plate were fabricated. The X-ray photoelectron spectrum reveals that the main element in the product is silver, and the range of resistivity from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> Ωm is calculated by measuring the resistance. The result shows that using two-photon induced reduction of metal ions, the reaction region can be controlled well, and it is helpful for the conductive metallic microstructure fabrication.

articleTitle: Research on Protection Technology of Foundation Pit Excavation Adjacent to Existing Railway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Traffic safety in existing railway has strict demands to the subgrade deformation, and the subgrade deformation caused by foundation pit excavation should be under the limit value. In this paper, steel sheet pile cofferdam supporting system is introduced, as well as its construction process. 2D numerical simulation is adopted to simulate the construction process, the deformation of subgrade at different cases are discussed. At last, the field monitoring data is provided to verify the validity of supporting system and numerical simulation results. Research results indicate that steel sheet pile cofferdam supporting method can well control the subgrade deformation, and can be took as a precedence technique in similar engineering. To ensure the traffic safety, it's necessary to prevent the trains crossing near the excavation, and the train speed should be limited.

articleTitle: Marine Salvage Management Information System Based on Google Earth/GPS Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Using LEOs data communications technology of Orbcomm, the data communications machine which can realize point to point data or message transmission between satellite and control center has been developed. Then the paper describes a marine salvage management information system that is based on Web Service technology and Google Earth. The system consists of serval modules, such as satellite data communications module, GPS location module, embedded subsystem and Internet communication module. The system can provide effective services that include ocean-going ships command and dispatch, emergency communications, disaster information reporting and information sharing.

articleTitle: The Research of Classification Method for Significant Risk of Hazardous Chemical Tanker which in Transit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Accounting to the present situation of China's road transport for dangerous chemicals, governments at all levels has no specific classification methods of major hazard source for hazardous chemicals tanker in transit. In this paper, we use fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method as the theoretical basis, combined with cases of accident and research materials using the fuzzy statistical method to construct the membership, and to get a reasonable classification according to the principle of maximum degree of membership. In selecting evaluation factors we take into account the cause of the accident during transport, process control and consequences of the accident, divide hazard chemical tankers in transit into four grades through applying the method to the practice, and the classification results accord with the actual situation.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Using Self-Adapting Mean Shift Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
