abstract: This paper presents a self-adapting algorithm based on Mean Shift model to track the target in video sequences. Firstly, two-dimensional histogram is used to represent the target instead of one-dimensional histogram, so as to better distinguish the target from background. Secondly, algorithm has been improved by adding self-adapting progress to remove errors caused by local maximum. Experiments on several video sequences showed that the proposed algorithm performs of high accuracy and good robustness to handle target tracking where background objects are similar to target, and can be applied on a real-time system.

articleTitle: Exploiting the Symmetrical Characteristic of Faces to Classify Face Images
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, we propose to exploit the symmetrical characteristic of the face to represent and classify face images. The proposed method first partitions each face image into two halves, i.e. the left part and the right part of the face image. The method then uses a linear combination of the left parts of all the training samples to represent the left part of the testing sample. Also, this method employs a linear combination of the right parts of all the training samples to represent the right part of the testing sample. Finally, the method combines the two representation result to classify the testing sample. The conducted face recognition experiments show that the proposed method can produce a lower error rate than the comparison method.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for the Distortion Modification of Camera Lens
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Lens distortion is one of the main factors affecting camera calibration. To improve the accuracy of calibrating camera, a new approach to modify the lens distortion is proposed. Based on Brown model and pinhole imaging principle, the measurement model of the incident angle is built. The sensibilities of different distortion coefficients in the expression of incident angle are analyzed using Monte Carlo method. According to the analytical results, all the coefficients are united into one vector with different proportion, which greatly simplifies the least squares iterative algorithm that is widely applied to the distortion modification. After analyzing the process of iterative optimization, the experiments of measuring the incident angle are carried out and the distortion coefficients are obtained by iterative optimization. The experiments demonstrate the linearity of the incident angle is enhanced greatly through distortion modification with these coefficients. The repetitiveness of the modification effect is also proved well.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-depot Vehicle Scheduling Problem Based on Milk-Run Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: After analyzing the multi-depot vehicle scheduling problem, a mathematical model which takes the shortest single distribution as the target function was built. First of all, the paper make it to be the different single distribution center vehicle scheduling problem by dividing all the suppliers, then use genetic algorithm to solve the single distribution center VSP problem. Finally, verify the effectiveness of the model and the algorithm with examples based on theMaple soft.

articleTitle: The Running Speed Law and Model under Combined the Effect of both Horizontal and Vertical Alignments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Highway alignment design should make alignments continuous and keep the index balance in order to ensure the security and comfort of the vehicles traveling at a high speed. Alignment-index value of Highway in plain area usually relatively higher. The current standard is based on the method of design-speed from the theory of alignment design which the index is usually given a much looser value scope. This design method has some defects itself. Based on the field survey to collect the value of Running Speed in the highway, this paper has summarized the characteristic of the Running Speed of Highway in plain area and provides the scope of Running Speed in different conditions such as the segment of straight line and curvous line. Based on the statistic-value of the Running Speed, this article has contributed the Running Speed model by the conditions in single alignment of horizontal and vertical and also including their composition.

articleTitle: The Research on Coordinated Development of the Integration of Railway and Highway Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: According to the development of regional economy from traffic, the paper analyzes the railway and highway transportation structure characteristics, and establishes the evaluation with two modes of transportation, the coordinated development of the index system of partial quantitative and qualitative evaluation index attribute value calculation method are studied.

articleTitle: Design for a New Type Automobile MRF Absorber
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A new type automobile MRF absorber's mechanism is presented based on MRF principle in this paper, magnetic path design and mechanical design are optimized using FEM, and verifies correctness of it. This kind of absorber is of simple structure, real time control, and has wide application prospect.

articleTitle: Influence of the Curved Surface on Surface Roughness Measurement Using Dichromatic Speckle Pattens
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To study the influence of curved surface on the method of dichromatic speckle autocorrelation measuring surface roughness, curvature radius of surface is introduced. In this paper, the rough surface and the dichromatic speckle patterns are simulated, and the effects of different radius of curved surface on speckle patterns and speckle elongation ratio are discussed. The results show that the factor of surface radius is valid in dichromatic speckle autocorrelation measurement. Moreover, the larger curvature radius is, the larger speckle elongation becomes, and the smaller the deviation of measured surface roughness is. Therefore, influence of curvature of rough surface on measurement precision should be taken into consideration during measuring process.

articleTitle: Stream Curve and Numerical Modeling for High-Speed Train
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: On the basis of analyzing streamline characteristics in potential flow field, expressing stream function by a surface and finding out the relationship between stream function surface and its borders, the concept of stream curve, a kind of function curve used for curve modeling with definite hydromechanical meanings in the joint field between Computer Graphics and Hydrodynamics, was advanced and its definition was given. Modeling methodology of stream curve by means of Ψ surface and numerical solution for the first boundary value inverse problem of Laplace's Equation was presented and an instance was given. The result shows that the definition and the modeling method of stream curve can be used for flow-related plane curve modeling; stream curve contains physical information of flow field and the hydromechanical performance of stream curve can be approximately assessed.

articleTitle: The Advancement of Niche Concepts and Their Modellings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, we briefly review the development of niche concept at first. In the later part, we fill the details of research working at a broad range of ecological modelling level. Because the literal description of concept is still a rough sketch and highly abstract, we pay more attention to connect it to the work of the modeling which set the stage for quantitative measurement. This will lead us move beyond the ideological abstractions, and get more explicit comprehension of concept.

articleTitle: Prediction of Hairiness of Polyester/Viscose/Cotton Blended Ring Spinning Yarn
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The objective of this research is to predict the hairiness of polyester/viscose/cotton yarn by means of two modeling methods (multiple regression model and artificial neural network model). The hairiness of ring spun yarn is influenced by processing parameters (front roller speed, spindle speed, nip gauge, back draft zone time, and roving twist). Excellent agreement is obtained between these two approaches. The results show that the artificial neural network (ANN) gave reliable results than that of multiple regression models, which is an excellent method for predictors.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis on Sound Sources of Calibrating Acoustic Emission Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the application of acoustic emission (AE) technology, operating frequency and sensitivity of sensor has a decisive role in the results of AE test, and AE Calibration serves as the basis for the calibration of quantitative research. In this paper, three different sound sources of experiment are designed according to secondary calibration of acoustic emission sensors: falling balls, pressuring off pencils and breaking the glass capillary. Through repeated experiments, we firstly measure the pulse sound source signal generated by the three different experiments with different conditions, analyze and compare the real-time features and spectral characteristics (peak value, rise time). Then we determine the most suitable pulse source in the emission sensor sensitivity calibration, and summarize the method of optimizing operation, so as to provide a basis for the evaluation of sound source signals in AE sensor calibration, Finally, the error during the experiment of acoustic emission sensors calibration is also addressed.

articleTitle: Operation Mode for Multilane Freeway and Its Effects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Operation is important for multilane freeway to receive safety and high service level. This thesis excavate the essential meaning of operation through systemic view, analysis objects and factors in operation, look for suitable variables to record operation process, list the operation mode, and study a case to conclude some effects under operation.

articleTitle: Trimaran Total Resistance Prediction Based on a Nonlinear Free Surface Potential Flow Solver and a RANS Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A quicker RANS method incorporated with the nonlinear potential panel method for trimaran total resistance prediction was developed. The wave profile, sinkage and trim were predicted by the nonlinear potential panel method, which then were used as the preconditions of RANS method. The viscous free surface flow solved this way avoided the time-consuming RANS iteration to determine the free surface profile, sinkage and trim. The total calculated results agreed well with the experimental data.

articleTitle: Research on the Burst-tire Car of Direction Instability of Dynamic Model Based on Load Transfer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the paper, by analyzing burst-tire car of the main factors, and simplified to a linear system, the establishment of two degrees of freedom burst-tire vehicle dynamic instability model. This paper research the rolling radius of the burst-tire wheel of the burst-tire after the impact of the direction instability, and then analyzes the changes in driving posture as a burst-tire caused by load transfer, and as a result of load transfer on the side of each wheel lateral force. Finally, build burst-tire car of the two-dimension direction instability dynamic model.

articleTitle: Model Based Torque Control and Estimation for Common Rail Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A rapid control prototyping based on torque control algorithm using V-cycle mode for common rail diesel engine was developed, and a torque prediction model was present which including a feed-forward mean value engine model and a feedback correction of error caused by the feed forward model. Finally, experiments were carried out on test bench to verify the control feasibility and reliability of the strategies and optimize the emissions, Experimental results showed that the anticipated control effects were achieved and the engine reached the EURO-III exhaust emission standard.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Methods for Mass Excavation and Embankment in Silt
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: When road construction crosses low lying swamp land or pond, it must dig or fill in silt. Because the slit is running and its bearing capacity is very small, constructing road in silt is very difficult. Against the characteristic of digging and filling in silt, this paper proposes many principles. When digging in silt, take best efforts to reduce the perturbance and destruction of adjacent soil body, and persist in digging silt near the excavating machine and unloading silt far from excavating machine. When filling in silt, take best efforts to extrude silt entirety. At last, the paper introduces several useful methods of digging and filling in silt on a large scale. They are the method of placement in layers, the method of road bank extruding silt, the method of rib slab filling and the method enclosed filling, directly digging, enclosed digging and semienclosed digging. Analyzing and comparing these methods from their technics, useness bound and notice proceeding, providing evidence for construction.

articleTitle: Study on Traffic Signal Control Base on Radial Basis Function
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Traffic signal is a measure of traffic command, which distributes right of way to the traffic flow in time domain. Through comparative study between RBF network and BP network, this paper has selected RBF network to control the traffic single. Green Light Interval is decided by the measurement parameters of detector in the actuated signal control. In the usually, the time phase number of the system is set beforehand. When there is not demand for the vehicles passing in the direction of red light, the green light phase works continually. The system starts the control model until there is demand for the vehicles passing in the direction of builds the model base on radial basis function, simulates in MATLAB and make an analysis of the simulated results.

articleTitle: Efficiency Analysis of Multi-Functional Lane in Urban Expressway Based on Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the innovations which setting up multi-functional lane (m-fl) in Beijing and Tianjin city expressway, this paper gives the definition of multi-functional lane and elaborates the three main functions of it. The multi-functional lane can provide lane for vehicle emergency stop, vehicle driving in and out of main road and bus stop. Then taking main road capacity and vehicle delay as assessing index, this paper makes the simulation experiments which are built by the investigation data of Tianjin Southeast Expressway and compares the efficiency of urban expressway with setting multi-functional lane or not from three aspects of functions separately to analyze the setting benefit of multi-functional lane. Finally, this paper gets the conclusion that setting multi-functional lane in urban expressway could increase efficiency of expressway based on existing enough land. The process and result of the research in this paper could provide reference of setting multi-functional lane, and can also give direction for design of urban expressway system in future.

articleTitle: Competitive Location Model of Logistics Node Integrated the Level of Logistics Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Competition, customer demand, logistics service and resource constraints are important factors in the optimization of enterprise's logistics system. On the basis of more than one existing logistics nodes, the location model of new logistics nodes with the objective of maximizing the enterprise's profit are proposed, in which the influence of logistics service level on customer's choice and enterprise's profit, and the influence of competition and customer's choice on the decision of locating logistics nodes are full considered. Furthermore, the decisions of optimal locations and the service level of these new logistics nodes providing to each customer are made simultaneously.

articleTitle: An Equilibrium Analysis of Outsourcing Service Competition with Asymmetric Cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The paper investigates the contest behavior in outsourcing service competition by applying contest theory, and constructs the outsourcing service competition model based on contest model. On the basis of analyzing equilibrium of outsourcing service competition, it studies the equilibrium in light of cost variance of the outsourcing service suppliers and explores the effect of cost variance on the equilibrium. The conclusion shows that the cost variance not only makes the equilibrium service level of the suppliers different, but also almost diminishes both total equilibrium service level of the suppliers and the equilibrium average service level acquired by the purchaser.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis between Airfoil Icing and Icing Cloud Conditions Based on PLS Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Ice shape feature parameters include iced area, icing mass, lower horn angle, upper horn angle, lower icing limit, upper icing limit, lower horn thickness and upper horn thickness, etc. Using the Partial Least Square (PLS) method, regression models for the first four parameters are established, where the first two are presented in this paper and the other two are not due to the limitation of space; while models for the other four ice features parameters are not established successfully and some reasons are given. Variation trends of the first two parameters predicted by PLS regression models built are compared with those obtained byMiller. It shows the two agree quite well. Air Temperature (T) and Liquid Water Content (LWC) has the most effects on iced area. Median Volume Diameter (MVD), T and Freezing Fraction (h ) has the most effects on icing mass. Other icing cloud condition parameters have little effects on them.

articleTitle: Forecast Map Matching Model for Vehicle-borne Navigation Based on Roadway Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Industry of vehicle-borne navigation develops rapidly in recent years. The navigation can be realized only when the positioning information gets in touch with digital navigation map. Map matching technique is the bridge of positioning information and digital navigation map. Map matching technique can determine which road the vehicle runs on by the positioning information, and the vehicle icon can also be displayed on the digital map. To study an efficient, timeliness and high precision algorithm is very important for an excellent navigation product. General map matching method is based on simple point projection. It often appears matching errors in the face of complicated roadways. The article aims at the shortcoming of general map matching, and designs a forecast map matching model based on roadway topology and geometry characteristic. According to the road to roadway topology and geometry characteristic, map matching model divide into three parts, those are initial map matching process (IMP), map matching process at junction (MPJ) and subsequent map matching process (SMP). What's more, the model is validated by practical running tests. The average correct rate is about 96.1% which shows that the practicability and stability of the device are good. Forecast map matching model brings new idea in order to resolve the difficult problem of matching on complicated roadways.

articleTitle: The Research of Guangxi's Logistics Based on the System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: According to the principle of system dynamics theory, a logistics system dynamics model is established to show the relationship between regional economy and regional logistics in Guangxi. A simulation software Vensim PLE is used to obtain a conclusion that there are a large gap between the big logistics demand and the poor logistics supply in Guangxi. And this gap becomes a constraints to Guangxi's economics.

articleTitle: Parameters Calibration for Car-Following Model Based Desired Safety Margin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Parameters calibration constitutes the base of car following simulation by Desired Safety Margin(short for DSM model) . In the paper, the DSM model is introduced firstly. Then, the calibration method of the key parameters, including desired safety margin, acceleration and deceleration sensitivities, is proposed. Subsequently, based on driving performances of eight different drivers, with the statistical calculation and analysis, the calibrated parameters, upper and lower limits of desired safety margin, acceleration and deceleration sensitivities, are obtained. After that, with the calibrated DSM model, the application and simulation of a practical car following case are showed. Finally, the main research results are concluded.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment Research of Wheel Brake System Based on CPN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Safety analysis is an important method of compliance demonstration for airworthiness regulation. It describes the foundation and application of CPN. Some features of CPN model are introduced and the future of CPN is predicted. The article sets up a CPN model based on WBS(Wheel Brake System), and make a contrast of CPN and FTA. It uses CPN model in the safety analysis process, which overcomes the shortcomings of the static analysis features of the FTA.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm for Vehicle Routing Problems with Capacity Limited Based on Minimum Spanning Tree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: An optimized strategy is proposed to investigate the vehicle routing problems. We build here a Conversion of the Complex road network with minimum spanning trees and decision to search the nearest approach. An algorithm is developed to obtain min-spanning from spanning trees. By tagging the min-spanning tree, we obtain the optimized route such that the cycle capacity keeps minimum value. The corresponding algorithm is realized with the Development tool of Jbuilder 9, which shows that our algorithm proposed here is valid and concise, and simplifies the complexity of previous results.

articleTitle: Research on the Streamlined Head Structure of High-Speed Train
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: If traditional design method were adopted to design the head structure of high-speed train, lots of time would be taken and a large amount of workload be done and machining precision not be assured. After analyzing the characters of the design and the manufacturing of the head structure of highspeed train, the bend sheet-beam design software of the streamlined head structure of high-speed train was developed on the ARX of AutoCAD software and the Open I-deas of Ideas software flat roof, which is mainly based on the intersection theory between two Non Uniform Rational BSpline surfaces and 3-dimensional geometric modeling technique of solid. Grid structure made up of the bend sheetbeam ensures that the head structure design is carried through by the way of the loading structure tied in with the streamline shape, that the twisted beam is avoided to build, and the structure is provided with well technological characters of manufacture and assembly at the same time. Because the main edge of the bend sheet-beam is free-form curve, it can not been processed using NC machining tool directly. For every NC machining tool has its respectively character and its machining program is different from each other, according to the line approximation form of Non Uniform Rational B-Spline and the technique preferences of the NC machining tool, the numerical control machining software of the bend sheet-beam of the high-speed train head was presented based on the ARX of AutoCAD software flat roof. The machining problem of the bend sheet-beam is settled down. At present the both software are used to design the streamlined head structure of highspeed train in our country.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Agent Based Computing for Military Vehicle Scheduling and Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Under the warfare and other emergent environment, military vehicle scheduling and planning is subject to complex sets of objectives and constraints and thus is difficult to achieve high-quality solutions. The paper proposes a distributed computing framework to support effective military vehicle scheduling, in which asynchronous teams of intelligent agents cooperate with each other to produce a set of nondominated solutions that show the tradeoffs between objectives, and evolve a population of solutions towards a Pareto-optimal frontier. Experimental results demonstrate the capability and effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Relationship Between China's Current Account and Capital Account An Empirical Analysis Based on 1982-2009
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Balance of payments is one of the main economic goals for an open economy. This paper uses the unit root test, co-integration test and VAR model to make an empirical analysis on the relationship between China’s current account, capital account and GDP from 1982 to 2009. The results showed that the co-integration relationship between the current account and GDP, GDP does Granger cause current account and current account does Granger cause capital account. The policy implication is that through the capital controls on macroeconomic variables to effectively improve the current account of balance of payments.

articleTitle: Morphological Modified Global Thresholding and 8 Adjacent Neighborhood Labeling for SWIR Image Mosaic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Due to the proper structure and the nonuniformity of the imager detectors, the mosaic algorithms for SWIR (Short-Wave InfRared) remote sensing images slightly differentiate from common mosaic techniques. A detailed description of a novel mosaic method has been proposed in the paper. Firstly, pixels re-arranging and nonuniformity verifying have been done with the images during the pre-processing step. Scene-based statistical method is applied to remove most of the nonuniformity noise. Secondly, a novel feature-based image registration algorithm is studied in the registration step. The morphological modified global thresholding algorithm is proposed to segment the two images. Then region features are extracted by 8- adjacent neighborhood labeling method. The area of the regions and the slope between their central points are used in feature matching. Thirdly, the affine transformation between the images is determined by the matched features and the information from the two images is fused to make a larger format image by the weighted-averaging method. At last, two pairs of images after pre-processing are used for registration experiment while a pair of images is registered before noise removing. The registration results are tested to be insensitive to noise and be excellent and reliable even though the images are slightly twisted. The fusion experiment is done for non-twisted images and the mosaic result shows that our method is efficient in the procedure and can meet the requirement of remote sensing image process.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Aerodynamic Performance of Train at Transitional Zone Between Cut and Wind-Break Walls
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this thesis, The numerical simulation calculation was carried out to the aerodynamic characteristics of the train under wind-break wall, high cut or at the transition under cross wind with three-dimension incompressible viscous N-S equation and the k-epsilon turbulence model. In addition, this paper focused on analysis and optimization of the various transitions. Analysis by calculating, the important conclusions were as follows: (1)Under cross wind, the side force and overturning moment suffered by the train at the open transition, are much bigger than those under the wind-break wall or cut, aerodynamic characteristics of trains at transition are worst. (2)Under cross wind, the resistance suffered by the train will be mainly unchanging with the transitional angle, while the lift force will be bigger and bigger with the angle's increase. The side force will be in the opposite direction after the angle is 45°, and the overturning moment will be smaller and smaller until the angle arrives at 30°, and then it will increase with the angle. (3)The best optimization for transition is to connect wind-break wall and cut with the transitional angle of 30°, which has good wind-proof effect but smaller consumption, and is applicable to transitions between many different types of wind-break walls and cut.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-scale Wavelet Kernel in Traffic Flow Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Accurate traffic flow forecasting is crucial to the development of intelligent transportation systems (ITS). Based on statistical learning theory, support vector machine (SVM) has better generalization performance and can guarantee global minima for given training data. However, the good generalization performance of SVM highly depends on the construction of kernel function. An effective multi-scale Marr wavelet kernel which we combine the wavelet theory with SVM is presented in this paper. The forecasting performance is evaluated by real-time traffic flow data of highway in Los Angeles, USA and a variety of experiments are carried out. Compared to wavelet kernel function and RBF kernel function, the multi-scale wavelet kernel function has much more precise forecasting rate and higher efficiency, especially for boundary approximation.

articleTitle: Traffic Safety Analysis of Overloaded Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Serious overloaded transportation phenomenon exists generally in China. It causes tremendous threat to road traffic safety. Current situation of overloaded and its influence on traffic safety are analyzed in Yu-Chang expressway. Proposals are presented about how to reduce traffic accidents caused by overloaded transportation.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordination Relationship of Yangtze River Waterway Construction and Basin Economy Development Based on Principal Components Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Yangtze River waterway is an important basic infrastructure of logistics and shipping development for Yangtze River Basin, which is helpful to Yangtze River Basin economy. This paper applies principal components analysis to turn multiple indicators into a single comprehensive indicator and make comparison between them. And draw conclusions: Yangtze River waterway and basin economy is in a state of basic coordination.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Flow of Representative Section on Urban Arterial Street
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper analyzes the time, lane and direction distribution characteristics of volume and speed, based on data survey, aimed at the section on urban arterial street near the school in Huhhot. The research results show that there is a peak traffic which begins school close time and continues 15 minutes at noon. Near the primary school, the main factors causing traffic congestion are parking on driveway, pedestrian crossing the street and non-motor vehicle occupying motor vehicle lane. Near the high school, the main factors are pedestrian crossing the street and non-motor vehicle occupying motor vehicle lane. Finally, the paper suggests that reasonably construct the flyovers and parking spaces, and improve sidewalks and non-motor vehicle lanes near the school. It is very significant to ease traffic congestion and enhance traffic efficiency by analyzing the traffic flow characteristics of section on urban arterial streets in different function regions and different times.

articleTitle: A Statistical Method of Energy Consumption Based on Energy-Tree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Combined with the national energy policy and the actual project requirements, the author studies a statistical method of energy consumption based on energy-tree, in order to reduce corporate energy consumption, improve enterprise efficiency and optimize enterprise direction. Firstly, the author establishes energy-tree model that includes an entity tree that solid parent-child relationship between entities and a table that solid many-to-many relationship between entities and energies. Secondly, the author studies energy-tree recursive statistics. Finally, the author applies the research result to actual projects. Practice shows that the statistical method of energy consumption based on energy-tree is an efficient and reliable method of energy consumption.

articleTitle: GPU Based Spot Noise Parallel Algorithm for 2D Vector Field Visualization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Graphic Processing Unit (GPU) has involved into a parallel computation for it's massively multi threaded architecture. Due to its high computational power, GPU has been used to deal with many problems that can be easily parallelized. This paper will present a GPU based spot noise parallel algorithm for 2D vector field visualization. It uses spot noise method with GPU resources and compute unified device architecture (CUDA) to visualize 2D vector field. Vector field are partitioned to multiple thread so that a large number of data are processed simultaneously. Fast on-chip shared memory is used on GPU to optimize the performance and a data transformation mechanism between host and device is presented. The parallel algorithm applies these strategies to a 2D velocity field and obtains up to 16X speedup compared with conventional sequential computation. It is suitable for interactive applications and in-time remote visualization of vector fields.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Simulation Maintenance Training System for a Certain Type of Command and Control System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A certain type command and control system is hightech electronic information equipment with complicated structure and high manufacturing cost. A semiphysical simulation maintenance training system is developed for an efficient way of maintenance staff training for this equipment. From the realization experiments, this training system performs well in maintenance simulation for staff training.

articleTitle: Study on the Methods for Passenger Flow Forecast Between Central City and Satellite City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to forecast the passenger flow demand between central city and Satellite city exactly, a boundary model based on the time and cost is constructed to identify the attractive area of the transportation corridor by analyzing the traffic characteristic of corridor; then, thinking of the differences between urban trip and country trip, a double-deck method is put forward to divide traffic zones for the influence area along the each side of corridor, and the traffic zones in central city and satellite city are divided according to the function and access point of each route. Furthermore a `route-mode' integrated forecasting method is established and the relative parameters are demarcated. The method presented in this paper can be used in the passenger flow forecasting between central city and satellite city effectively.

articleTitle: Impact Elastic Wave Based Highway Guard Rail Post Embedding Depth Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Due to its high cost and destructive nature, the pull-out testing is not suitable for the embedding depth of guard rail posts to ensure the safety of highway traffic. The primary goal of this study is to develop a fast and reliable alternative testing method, impact elastic wave based measurement technology, which is normally considered not suitable for testing hallow piles due to rapid attenuation, excessive noise and free vibration. In this study, the authors developed a number of innovative techniques including automated agitation, free vibration elimination software, reflection wave extraction, enhancement and analysis method, high-precision spectral analysis, and an intelligent post length evaluation system. This new technology has been successfully verified in multiple highway construction projects in China. The pilot testing program concluded that both the efficiency and accuracy of the new method are satisfactory for engineering practice purposes.

articleTitle: Modeling of Passenger Evacuation Model in Transfer Hub Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Transfer hub platform gather much people in one small place. when emergency event happen, Transfer hub platform well become the very dangerous palace. So building a suited passenger evacuation model in Transfer hub platform to simulation crowd and group evacuation in the emergency situation is very importation. The goal of the paper is create a framework of passenger evacuation concept model to help building the passenger evacuation model in Transfer hub platform firstly. Than build the model of passenger evacuation. Lastly, give a small case to validate model by datum Fuxin Men Transfer hub platform in subway the line 2 in Beijing.

articleTitle: A Rule of Updating Position in Microscopic Pedestrian Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The rule of updating pedestrian position in a microscopic pedestrian model is substituted by a proposed new rule. In the new rule, the step size of a pedestrian moving in a selected direction at each update is in inverse proportion to repulsive actions imposed by other ones in the direction at an exponential rate, and also pedestrian positions are updated at each very small time interval. In this way, "a barrier" between pedestrians can be generated, and after update their position, they do not overlap each other. The modified model is compared with the original model through simulating the evacuation process of pedestrians in a closed area. Simulation results indicate that the modified model can be used to formulate the degree of pedestrian overlapping in crowd through adjusting model parameters, and the distributions of distances between each pedestrian and the one closest to him or her, obtained by either the original model or the modified model, can be fitted by the t location-scale distribution.

articleTitle: Research of Control and Simulation of 1:5 Tilting Bogie Based on Neural Network Prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The mechanical power system model of 1:5 trial tilting bogie is established in the ADAMS, and it's considered to predict the filtered acceleration (velocity or displacement) from the frame using neural network, and the tilting actuation systems is controlled in accordance with the signal and research will be proceeded on the effect of according control algorithms imposed on the performance of swing bolsters. The research results shows that: under a certain satisfaction, the reference input of 1:5 trial tilting bogie control system established by predictive signal can not only guarantee the accuracy of controlling the start and stop, but also ensure the real time of control, and realize the compensation of filter delay.

articleTitle: A Fluorescence Optic Fiber Temperature Sensor Using Visible Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The optic-fiber temperature measurement probe based on ruby is developed. This system is particularly adapt to the temperature measurement in the rang of 0??? to130???The calibration graph was shown to be highly reproducible when the probe is temperature cycled. A change in drive current from 5 to 30mA yields a spectral shift of the peak emission of only a few nanometers. The drive current to the LED can easily be kept within the required narrowly defined bounds through the control circuitry.

articleTitle: Model Design and Test Study of a New Type Space-Combined Tied Arch Bridge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper, based on Zhongshan Bridge, which is a new type space-combined tied arch bridge composed of one middle arch rib, two side arch ribs and two seat arch ribs. The structure of the bridge is innovative and special and almost no similar design can be found at present. Considering the complexity of loading condition and loading transfer characteristics of the detail constructions of the bridge, based on a 1/10-scalemodel study the structural loading transfer behavior; carried out. A 3D shell finite element model of the model bridge was developed and finite element analysis was performed to obtain the theoretic results, then to predict the structural behavior and guide the test loading. By comparison of the test results with the theoretical ones, the values were in good agreement, and the maximum stress under the extreme load were all far below the allowable values. From experimental and theoretical results indicated that the structure design of the bridge is proved to be reasonable and safe.

Author Keywords: Space-combined tied arch bridge Test model

articleTitle: An Integrated Analysis Approach for Dynamic Energy Distribution of Off-Road Vehicle Powertrain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A transient model of off-road vehicle powertrain has been established according to the basic laws of thermodynamics and heat transfer. With the utilization of distributed simulation system based on high level architecture (HLA), the transient simulation of powertrain has been executed. A cycle experiment on a off-road vehicle has been designed and conducted, and the models have been verified by the experiment data. Using the method founded, the conditions of energy distribution and engine heat statistics have been discussed. Other additional mechanical loads (i.e. fan, pump etc.) were taken into account in this model as well. The analyzed results show that the model can reflect the dynamic characteristic of the powertrain more accurately. Furthermore, it is approved that the integrated approach is available for off-road vehicle powertrain simulation.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation and Spatial Distribution Analysis of Logistic Development in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Using principal component analysis, according to brief and feasible principle, a comprehensive index system of logistic development evaluation which has eighteen indexes is established. This system has three core logistic systems including transportation flow, commercial and trade flow, information flow and some subsidiary systems of social and economic development etc. In the past thirty years, logistic development in Xinjiang has achieved significant achievements. Especially after 1990s, logistic industry got rapid development. But the regional differences of logistic development among different part of Xinjiang became more and more great. logistic sdevelopment level of northern Xinjiang is higher than southern and eastern Xinjiang. Polarization of comprehensive scores is serious. Analyzing the spatial differentiation, there are different spatial performance in north and south Xinjiang.

articleTitle: Passenger Transfer Predict of Comprehensive Transportation Hub
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: On the basis of the basic theory of the SUE Logit path choice model and the known OD matrix of the urban public transport district, establish a comprehensive transportation hub passenger transfer network and the transfer path selection model. This paper is focused on the roads on which there is multiple traffic-modes overlap and derives the formula of the total impedance of such road. As a result, transform the comprehensive transportation transfer network into a common path choice model. Then calculates the flow of the each road which is in the comprehensive transportation transfer network by making use of the Dail algorithm, and predict the passenger transfer of the target hub which is from the known OD. At last, show the process and the validity of the model prediction with an example.

articleTitle: Applying Safety Audit and Speed Management Concept in Freeway Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Road safety audit and speed management concepts have been accepted as valuable tools for traffic safety. These two new concepts have been separately applied successfully in some projects in recent years in China. Form the aspect of traffic safety, the two concepts coincide as in nature. But few projects have been integrated with the two concepts to improve safety. The paper will describe how to combine safety audit with speed management in detail design stage and in pre-opening and trial operation stage for QL Freeway. The objective of the paper is to present how to introduce speed management in safety audit process, to discuss the problems of typical technique and successful experience during application of the two concepts.

articleTitle: Modeling of Fuel Injection Process under Two-Phase Condition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Pressure changes in the diesel injection system result in the growth and collapse of gas bubbles. In order to analyze the injection characteristic of fuel injection system under gas-liquid two-phase conditions, and predict the influence of bubble for injection characteristic, a mathematical model of gas bubble is studied based on the physical processes of gas bubble resolving and releasing. The model is applied to the simulation of diesel injection system. According to the simulation and experiment results, the feasibility of gas bubble model is verified.

articleTitle: The Development and Problems of Land Use Along Urban Rail Transit in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: For a long time, the theory and practice of urban land and urban transit planning only pay attention to the demand on urban rail transit from land, but not sufficiently consider the reaction of traffic on the site. Recently, the relationship between urban land use and urban transit becomes more and more attention by the scholars. During the process of the modification of urban space layout, it is very necessary that the industry layout and the layout of public facilities will be adjusted synchronously. That is to say that housing and working position will be matched on the aspects of scale, distribution, structure, etc, by the mode of mix-use land. To achieve the goal, the character of land use and urban land development intensity along urban rail transit, as two key elements, should be planned and controlled.

articleTitle: Analysis on Beam Over-deflection Affecting the Bearing Performance of Continuous Rigid Frame Bridge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The continuous rigid frame bridge has been applied widely in our country. But in recent years, over-deflection of beam in this bridge has become an serious problem. This may cause the redistribution of displacement and internal force of the whole structure, especially in dynamic load status. A twodimensional pile-soil-bridge model is built up in ANSYS based on a factual bridge. The over-deflection is considered as the decrease of beam elastic modulus. The displacement and internal force of key parts are analysed in static and dynamic vehicle load. The study shows that over-deflection will reduce the first three natural vibration frequency, weaken the sensitivity of bridge to dynamic load. In dynamic load status, the displacement and internal force will be influenced by rigidity of beam.

articleTitle: Road Feature Based Data Model for Multi-scale Transportation Applications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: GIS-T Data Model is the base of the applications of ITS. Road feature is the basic unit to express, store and organize road networks. Comprehending the different user requirement at different representation scales, the featurebased multi-level data model for road network is proposed. The data model consists of three levels. The Level-1 expresses the topology structure of road network. The Level-2 describes all the linear features in road network, and establishes the topological relationship between roads. The Level-3 takes a lane as a feature, establishes the topological relations between lanes, to describe the traffic regulation in intersections and in lanes. Corresponding relations between features of different levels are established. The experiments prove that the proposedmodel is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Realization of Auto-focusing Model in FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: By the preprocessing method of the integration with the median filter and the linear transform of gray value, and the evaluation function based on power spectrum, an auto-focusing model is built. From the character of the image focusing algorithm based on power spectrum, the paper has designed the structural frame and algorithm flow of the image processing module, and proposed the pipelining structure, the `Ping-Pong' operating mode, the double butterfly-shaped processor multiplex, the base 2 FFT transform. Those increase the speed of the computations and responses in image auto-focus.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Stripping from Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Logistics stripping from industrial enterprises is an inevitable trend of refined social division of labor, also to enhance the core competitiveness of industrial enterprises; furthermore, it is the basic way to satisfy logistics demand and promote the development of the logistics industry. However, there is relatively little theoretical research on logistics stripping and this paper defines the concept of logistics stripping from industrial companies, exploring stripping modes, analyzing stripping ideas and the related problems.

articleTitle: The Application Research on Mountain Highway Speed-Control Hump
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The research group relying on the Luofu Highway safety renovation project of Yunnan province, around the plan of control large vehicle under effective speed when crossing the long downhill slope. Firstly, we set up the “HumanBodyworkwheels” system vibration model, studied the influence of different fracture surface of speedcontrol hump on automobile ride theoretically, and designed appropriation speedcontrol hump with characteristics for use of expressway. According to the design scheme we produced the samples and carried out road test on Luofu highway(LuocunkouFuning) in Yunnan province,so as to optimize the scheme to the greatest extent. Finally the designers proposed a scientific plan for the speedcontrol hump layout, for the sake of realizing the target of control large vehicles’ speed effectively and improve long downhill stretch driving safety. Practice has proved that: the operational safety of long downhill slope can be greatly improved by using hump on mountain highway.

articleTitle: Application of Trigger Point Mechanism in Time Decision-Making of Freeway Reconstruction and Extension
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The adaptation of freeway to economy development is a sustaining and dynamic process, which presents a state from adaptation to no adaptation and to adaptation. The decision on the reconstruction and extension time of freeway is an important macroscopical decision-making matter. On the basis of analyzing the service level of freeway and the principle of trigger point mechanism, this paper has constructed time decision-making model of freeway reconstruction and extension and put forward the application method of the model. Besides, taking the Shui Guan freeway reconstruction and extension project in Shenzhen as example, an empirical analysis has been made to check the feasibility and efficiency of the model, which provides decision basis to determine reconstruction and extension time.

articleTitle: Natural Frequency Analysis of Simple Supported Box Beam
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A calculation model for simply supported box beam is established in the paper, and its natural frequency and vibration mode are analyzed through theoretical analysis and numerical simulation. The influence of elastic support to the beam frequency is also discussed, which showed that the elastic has great effect on beam frequency. Lastly, it can be concluded that the beam frequency can satisfied technical requirement by comparing the calculation values with the values commended in relevant code.

articleTitle: Evaluation for the Risk of Virtual Enterprise Based on Entropy-Weighted Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The indices system of risk review and a multi-level fuzzy synthetic evaluation model of virtual enterprise based on entropy-weighted were established. Not only make full use of the indices information. But also avoided subjective sense of weight-coefficient,and it mends the shortage of traditional synthetic evaluation methods. The practicality and reliability of the method is demonstrated in a example.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis About the Effect of Foundation Pit Excavation Adjacent to the Existing Railway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: During the Beijing-Shanghai Express Railway construction process, the construction of long bridges buttresses foundation pit excavation adjacent to existing Shanghai-Nanjing Railway is one of the most complex problems to be faced with. In this paper, taking one buttress foundation pit excavation engineering as example, a 3D FEM calculation model combined with the train, railway, subgrade, soil body and supporting structure is established to analyze the influence of excavation, including the railway subgrade vibration and deformation. The research result indicates that the subgrade deformation under the two-way train load is larger than the one under one-way train load, but the maximum value is under the limit value of train traffic safety. The foundation pit support method designed is reasonable and effective. At last, some advices are presented to ensure the traffic safety, including speed limited and crossing avoided.

articleTitle: A New Rejuvenation Approach of Software Aging
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to effectively use the resources of software systems, increase the availability and reliability of system, this paper discusses the rational allocation of resources, and studies the software rejuvenation time. For the reasons that the resources are exhausted to result in attenuation of system performance and decline of processing capacity, the existing literature only had analyzed the memory resource, but they all did not discuss the allocation circs of CPU and memory that are the main resources to affect the performance of system, however, this paper will study these problems. The simulation gives the optimal rejuvenation time intervals and change tendency of application server under different allocation of resources and CPU resource thresholds, as well as analyses the boundary conditions of optimal rejuvenation time.

articleTitle: Establishing the Impact Evaluation Indicators System for Rural Road Investment Projects: Evidence from Fujian Province, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Evaluating the impacts of rural road investment projects is a key content in the rural roads post-evaluation. A good rural road investment project impact evaluation provides the basis for sound policy making. However, because of the lacks of impact evaluation activities and methodology, it has been difficult to know how opportunities provided by rural roads actually filter back into beneficiary outcomes and how large the impact is. This paper establishes an impact evaluation indicators system for rural road investment projects according the research approach of “frame structure-methodology-indicators design-indicators system”, using the stakeholder analysis and project effect analysis. Finally, taking the Rural Roads Improvement Projects (RRIP) as a case, establishing an impact evaluation indicators system (IEIS) for RRIP which oriented to accessibility and smooth for rural areas in china.

articleTitle: The Compare-Analysis of the Topology and Control Strategies About the Intelligent Charging System in Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Bases on the comprehensive analysis, about the topology and control strategy of the charging system in vehicle, this paper puts forward a system design plan that has high performance, then carries on the simulation of common control strategy by MATLAB, and makes the comparative analysis of the control effect.

articleTitle: On HC Emission Statistical Features of Passenger Cars Using Large Sample Measuring and Multiple Parameter Data Analyzing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: HC emission statistical features have a great effect on evaluating and controlling the pollution caused by vehicle harmful emission. Using large sample measurement, multiple parameter data analysis and mathematical modeling, the idle HC emission statistical features and statistical laws of three typical type passenger cars have been researched. The distributive parameters of HC emission have been estimated, and the mathematical models, which can exactly describe HC emission statistical features and statistical laws, have been established. The results of checking computation have proved the validity of the research method and results. At the same time, the suggestion have also been proposed to revise the relevant limit values of Chinese national standard about in-use passenger cars exhaust pollutant.

articleTitle: An Improved LIEP Method Utilizing Electrothermal Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Laser Induced Electroless Plating(LIEP) has many advantages such as homogeneous microstructure, relatively low cost, feasibility to be applied on non-metal substrates and operated at room temperature with relative simple equipment, and thus received much attentions in flexible circuit making. But the wide application of LIEP is also limited by poor accuracy, low speed and low repeatability brought by the temperature, concentration, thickness of plating solution. An improved approach is proposed in this paper aiming at enhancing the Laser Induced Electroless plating on the fabric utilizing the AC electrothermal technology. A mathematical model is also established and the simulation is carried out. The results show that it is not only effective and feasible, but also capable of minimizing the pollution greatly, and thus of great convenience for future micro electro mechanical systems and its microfabraction.

articleTitle: Demand Feature Identifying for Emergency Goods under Earthquake Rescue Logistics by Vague Set Based BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: During the preliminary stage of rescue for earthquake disaster, some important information needs to be provided by identifying the key demand features such as quantity, necessary degree and urgent degree for emergency goods. To dispose uncertain information, especially unknown information for identifying above features, vague set is introduced into the conventional BP neural network. The relation among supportive degree, counteractive degree and unknown degree are analyzed. For disposing unknown information for vague set, the method for transforming vague set information into fuzzy set information is proposed. A series of rules for transforming vague values into fuzzy values are presented. Hereby, the fuzzy membership degree function is given. The structure of four-layer multi output VBP neural network is designed, and its implement steps are studied. To validate the validity of VBP neural network, it is applied to identify demand feature for emergency goods under earthquake. The result by VBP neural network is compared with those by conventional BP neural network and the VBP neural network which is based on conventional fuzzy membership degree transforming formula. The result shows that, the test precision by above VBP neural network is higher than those by the other two methods. As a novel learning method, VBP neural network is more suitable for training samples with uncertain information.

articleTitle: B-Mode Relational Degree Analysis in Thermal Process Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Grey theory is applied to predict the temperature of the superheated steam. Through modeling with SIS data, the future superheated steam temperature. By calculating the auxiliary volume and the measured parameters associated with B-Mode relational degree, selected to meet the requirements of the auxiliary variables. The overheating the system model based on LS-SVM has a accurate simulation results, demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The Traffic Capacity Research of the Minor Road on the Unsignalized Intersection with Mixed Traffic Stream Based on the Markov Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper give the disadvantage of the existing ideal model by analysing the derivation, and then build the traffic model of the minor road on the unsignalized intersection with mixed traffic stream by using the theory of Markov stochastic processes and meanwhile revise the capacity model of the minor road for the different vehicle types. Finally, a case is presented to verify it that the model is regarded as the calculation theory of the capacity of the minor road on the unsignalized intersection.

Author Keywords: the traffic capacity of the minor road

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Critical Ventilation Velocity for Vehicle Fire in Large Cross-Section Road Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on CFD method, this paper conducted simulation analysis of lorry and car fires for large cross-section road tunnel. The smoke distribution feature was discussed and the corresponding results of critical ventilation velocity were also compared with the values calculated by related empirical formula. It would be helpful to work out a ventilation system strategy for the road tunnel.

articleTitle: A Study on the Outside Sensitive Damping Valve of Hydro-pneumatic Suspension for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A new outside sensitive damping valve is developed, which doesn't need any electronic control system. The working principle, elements configuration and outside characteristic of the new valve are studied. The mathematical model of the valve is proposed and its damping characteristic is studied mainly depending on the continuity equation, differential equations of motion, Bernoulli equation. The influence of the valve parameters on the damping characteristic is studied by simulation. The effect on ride and tire load of the outside sensitive damping valve and general outside damping valve are compared. The result shows that the developed outside sensitive damping valve can adjust on two stages, which can also meet the requirement of the dynamic characteristic of the vehicle suspension system.

articleTitle: Estimation of Rear-ends Accidents Caused by the Delay of Controlling Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Supposed the perception of traffic information and the controlling decision of vehicles are correct. The delay of controlling actions is researched in the paper, and the function of driver non-response probability is advanced. Based on the function, the timing curve of divers' response is made. Then the risk model of Rear-ends accidents is established to evaluate the probability of Rear-end accident, according to the theory named ANFIS, whose input are the headway distance, velocity of the following vehicle, the difference of the leading and following vehicle and the non-response probability, whose output is the probability of Rear-end accidents. The example shown in the paper could testify that the relationship of the outputs and the inputs got by the model are correct, and the model advanced could assess the risk degree of Rear-end accidence.

articleTitle: System Construction of Earthquake Emergency Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: For large destructive earthquake, quick response to the urgent relief materials right through efficient emergency logistics system is vital to the alleviation of disaster impact in the affected area. So, earthquake emergency logistics system is very important for the emergency rescue. First, this logistics is compared with general logistics. The main characteristics of this system are discussed. Second, operation process of the emergency logistics system is analyzed and its flow chart is given. Finally, the system construction is proposed. The main operation system and guarantee mechanisms are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Pile's Elastic Modulus Influence on Share Load Ratio Between Piles and Soil of Combination-Pile Composite Foundation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Regarding the combination-pile composite foundation made up of flexibility piles and nature soil as the substitute soil among rigid piles and considering cushion effect at the same time, it deduced share load ratio and settlement resolution of combination-pile composite foundation. Then the effect of pile's modulus on the share load ratio is analyzed. It is indicated that the share load of long-pile is raised when the elastic modulus of long-pile enlarged, while the share load of cushion and short-pile decreased, but the influence to share load ratio diminished when the elastic modulus of long-pile was greater than 28000MPa. The pattern of the short-pile and the soil foundation are contrary to the long-pile in the same conditions.

articleTitle: Research on GPS Navigation System of Flight Simulator Based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The Navigation system of flight simulator provides information as position, speed and attitude for aviators when they are training. GPS simulation was used innovatively on flight simulator. Provide a basis for further study on navigation system of flight simulator. Firstly, studied the theory of GPS navigation. Then founded the GPS simulation system using matlab. Commissioning results shown that the simulation system had the same precision with real GPS receivers.

articleTitle: Image Decomposition Model Using Curvelets and Wave Atoms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The aim of this paper is to combine curvelets with wave atoms by using the mixed constraints, namely smoothness of semi-norm of decomposition spaces and sparsity. It fully considers the sparse representation of curvelets and wave atoms. Curvelets are an essentially optimal representation of objects which is C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> away from a C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> edge, while wave atoms have a significantly sparser representation of the warped oscillatory functions or oriented textures than other fixed standard representations like wavelets, Gabor atoms, or curvelets. Moreover, the correlation of piecewise smooth component and textural component is employed as a stopping criterion to control the iterations. Experimental results and comparisons show the efficiency of the proposed models for image decomposition.

articleTitle: Regional Logistics System Orienting Small and Medium-Sized Logistics Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The development of logistics industry is one of the important elements in accelerating economic growth of regions and even a country. With the ever-increasing fierce competition, most logistics enterprises, especially some small & medium-sized ones, have come across more and more difficulties in logistics infrastructure, technicians, industry cluster etc., which greatly hinder the rapid growth of logistics industry. In allusion to the problems above, this paper puts forward the development mode and solution scheme of a regional logistics system orienting small & medium-sized logistics enterprises from regional and systematic perspectives. Meanwhile, the architecture of the system and running mode are established, and some key technologies, such as implementation mode of the system and supporting platform, are analyzed. At last, the elementary application situation of the system is introduced.

articleTitle: Incipient Fault Feature Extraction Using Lifting Scheme Packet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To identify incipient fault feature of gearbox weak signal, a new method to design lifting scheme packet is developed. This method is based on lifting scheme, the decomposition procedure and reconstruction procedure algorithms of lifting scheme packet are constructed, and the signal at each frequency band is reconstructed to identify incipient fault feature in time domain. The lifting scheme packet operators which lock on the local statistics of decomposition signal are calculated. Both lifting scheme packet and traditional wavelet packet are applied to analyze the rub fault vibration signal of a gearbox, lifting scheme packet desirably identifies demodulation waveform and periodic impulses, and the results confirm that lifting scheme packet outperforms traditional wavelet packet method.

articleTitle: Development Strategy of Green Logistics Based on SWOT Matrix--A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Green logistics is an environmentally friendly way of logistics, will be the development direction of urban logistics. Although the economic development in Hangzhou, the ancillary logistics services, particularly the green logistics has been the slow development, urban green development status is not optimistic. In this paper, SWOT analysis on the green logistics status of Hangzhou, the green logistics development strategy is obtained. The results are useful for the improvement of urban environmental management issues, as well as the implementation of green logistics.

articleTitle: Study of Expressway Traffic Simulations System Influence of Accident
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, multiple techniques are applied to expressway traffic simulations system development in order to create accident database for accident detection data foundation. Demand analysis thought based on layering analysis method is put forward on the base of Vehicle Agent property research. Furthermore, the relationships of multiple Vehicle Agent consultation and domains are studied, and the key technical of vehicles generations is discussed. Finally, the AID Simulations is developed on the Windows XP platform by net. Corresponding, an accident database is set up based on the system.

articleTitle: An Idea to Simulate the Environmental Vibration Caused by Urban Rail Traffic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In most studies, the vibration source is modeled as random vibration with a given power spectral density at the nearest point from the rail, and the effect on buildings and human beings is further calculated by a two dimensional calculation. However, from 3 dimensional point of view, it is far away from the fact that the effect is come from many points along the rail while the trains move through rapidly. Two-step is defined to simulate environmental vibration. In the first step, the train-track system is simplified as a series of subsystems. Taking into account the track power irregularity, each subgrade reaction under ballast block was calculated when trains move on the track. All the forces constitute point source array to simulate the source. In the second step, the foundation is simulated as isotropic layered media, combined with artificial boundary conditions in the calculation border region, using the decoupling finite element method to calculate the surface environmental vibration. The simulation result was compared with those from field observation in Beijing, China. The result is quite close to the field observation data, and provides a good foundation for further study on environmental vibration impact to buildings and human beings.

articleTitle: A Research of Image Identification Signal Processing for Longitudinal Rip of the Transport Belt
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Transport belt is the most widely used conveyor device in coal mine, the longitudinal rip of transport belt will bring great losses to coal production, this article design a detection system for longitudinal rip of the belt. The device capture images by CCD camera which is under the belt, and computer is used for analyzing and processing the signal of the collected image, by comparing the characteristics of the processed image, we can accurately detect the occurrence of longitudinal rip.

articleTitle: New Research of Optical Voltage Transducer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The primary theory and design of a dual-mode interferometer all-fiber optical voltage transducer, which is used to measure the high voltage of power system. The transducer is based on the converse piezoelectric effect of quartz. The piezoelectric deformation of the cylinder-shaped transducer crystal induced by an applied ac voltage is sensed by an elliptical-core dual-mode fiber wound onto the circumferential surface. White-light interferometer and active homodyne phase tracking detect the resulting modulation of the differential phase between LP01 mode and LP11 mode in fiber. Based on the measure of signal phase, a new active homodyne phase tracking technology is proposed. An experiment is designed on to validate the feasibility of the high voltage transducer designed in this paper. Therefore, no optical elements, such as couplers, electro-optical crystal, and polarizer are used. In addition. So, the transducer is a system of simple, nicety, safety credibility, price low.

articleTitle: Intuitionistic Fuzzy Evaluation for Supply Chain Coordination Degree Based on TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper use the intuitionistic fuzzy value and intuitionistic fuzzy sets, based on the method of TOPSIS to select and determine the similarity function for intuitionistic fuzzy sets, and use the information entropy to calculate the weight, then use the distances from intuitionistic fuzzy sets to intuitionistic fuzzy positive ideal point (PIS) and negative ideal point (NIS), weighted and composted, finally, got the relative closeness for that need to evaluation program with the ideal point. The relative closeness is the coordination degree of enterprise node of supply chain.

articleTitle: The Study of Supply Chain Coordination with Contracts in “Contract Farming”
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
