abstract: We often consider the multi-level prediction caused by uncertainty in demand in the supply chain coordination with contracts research. However, there will be disaccord between the final products and the plan, because the production process will be subject to temperature and humidity, pests and diseases etc in the “Contract farming” supply chain. We will find a best supply chain with contract which consider the producer motivation and the supply chain interests, through the different value judgments between producers and buyers and comparing producer interests with different forms of contract.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics Outsourcing Model Based on Principal-Agent Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Operating reverse logistics in enterprise better or not is directly related to customers' satisfaction and loyalty. Therefore, many enterprises usually adopt a policy to outsource their reverse logistics in order to strengthen their competence in the market. How to design an incentive mechanism is a key problem in reverse logistics outsourcing management. Through the reputation effects model pursued by the agent and the ratchet effects model caused by the principal increasing the standard, the reverse logistics outsourcing mechanism is analyzed, and a relative performance contrast is put forward to weaken the ratchet effects to design the incentive mechanism which can get two-win between the principal and the agent.

articleTitle: Unified Restoration Method for Different Degraded Images
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Blurred images are caused by many factors such as defocus, motion, and atmospheric turbulence. Due to the unknown various factors that cannot be distinguished in the blurred image, it is necessary to propose a unified method for image restoration. In order to solve this problem, a unified restoration method for different degraded images is presented, in which we use edge information of blurred image to predict the blur mode. It operates by locally predicting a sharp image using edge information of blurred image and establishes a nonlinear and spatial anisotropic regularization function from the prediction sharp image and the blurred image. Then we can estimate the point spread function (PSF) and recover the blurred image quickly. A series of restoration experiments for different blured images have been performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Tunnel Construction Safety Inspection and Polymer Grouting Technology for Tunnel Quick Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this article, the monitoring and measuring of the Xuejiazhuang tunnel of Lingnan freeway is introduced. The fitting regression analysis for the data of curve was done. And the surrounding rock stability is studied with the regression analysis of the convergence displacement data. In order to maintain the existing void between initial lining and surrounding rock, the ground-penetrating radar nondestructive testing technology and polymer grouting technology is presented. The field test results show that the use of polymer grouting technology can repair the tunnel distress and provide an ideal manner for tunnel quick maintenance.

articleTitle: Relational Decision-Making Method for Optimization of Urban Public Transport Network Based on Cumulative Prospect Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To optimize the urban public transport network, the paper systematically researches the multifactor analysis and thought about the urban public transport, proposes six binding indexes together with their threshold on the purpose of minimizing the general cost and maximizing the service, and also establishes the quantitative objective functions for the optimization of transport network on the basis of 5 indexes such as total travel time of passengers according to spatial dimension, time dimension and value dimension for the first time. Secondly, the paper considers the impact on the multi-index decision, establishes the standard index decision-making matrix and positive-negative ideal solution decision-making matrix, and researches the analyzing model for transport network optimization which takes the objective functions as set of indexes and alternatives as set of domain by quantitative analysis according to the TOPSIS. According to the cumulative prospect theory and gray relational analysis, the prospect value function is defined, an optimization model is built, the optimum weight vector is solved, and the order of the program is determined. Finally, the example shows that this method can adjust the public transport network better, and the result was much more reasonable and practical.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Framework for 2D Data Matrix Recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: 2D barcode recognition technique and system play an important role in the industry application. It is extremely challenging to locate and recognize barcodes when the background is cluttered and the illumination is uneven. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical framework for 2D Data Matrix recognition and further introduce the 2D barcode recognition system based on the proposed method. The superiority of this framework lies in three folds: 1) it is robust to unbalancing illumination, geometric deformations and affine transform; 2) barcode region localization is performed to make the system robust to clutter background and to save computation complexity; 3) the floating DSP hardware platform guarantees the decoding accuracy and speed to attain a leading level. The large-scale experiment shows that the proposed framework can achieve high accuracy and robustness for 2D Data Matrix recognition and has been transferred into real production.

articleTitle: Engine Fault Diagnosis Based on Wavelets Packet and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A fault diagnosis system is presented for connecting rod bearings in engine based on wavelet packet energy feature and BP neural network. Four-layer wavelet decomposition is conducted on the vibration signals of connecting rod bearing, and the energy of wavelet packet is extracted as the feature parameter of vibration signal of connecting rod bearing. Then these feature parameters are used to train BP neural network for fault pattern recognition. Test results show that applying wavelet packet energy and BP neural network to fault diagnosis of connecting rod bearing is feasible and effective.

Index Terms: Activation Function Of The Output Layer

articleTitle: The Research for Deployment Strategy Based on Maximization Lifetime in Hierarchical Structure Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A deployment strategy of hierarchical structure wireless sensor network. (HSWSN) is studied, HSWSN are composed basic station (BS), relay devices (RNs) and sensors (SNs). In this paper, the mode of system and energy consumption are proposed, the deployment strategy especial relay devices is proposed, and some important such that energy consumption density (ECD), distribution probability of RN consumption in infinitesimal region, and subarea concept are proposed. Adopting add number of RN in special point to be relay in subarea can decrease ECD, to prolong lifetime for integration HSWSN. The results of simulation experiment show that variance of ECD and relative lifetime is all to lessen. This paper provides a method for random deployment of hierarchical structure wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Network Emergency Evacuation Modeling: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Natural or man-made disasters, such as floods, hurricanes, fires and nuclear leaks, have increased over the past 30 years. Given the potential dangers, it is wise for policy administrators to ensure that appropriate emergency plans are in place that aim to minimize the negative consequences associated with these disasters. Many emergency evacuation models are developed for this reason, including simulation-based models and optimization-based models. This review attempts to describe each of the modeling approaches adopted and critically review the inherent capacities of each approach. In the end, some suggestions about future work are presented.

articleTitle: Energy Supply Strategy for Battery Electric Vehicles in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The energy supply strategy is crucial to promote the application of Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs). This paper analyzes five decisive elements of the energy supply strategy, which include the characteristics of Chinese urban electric network, the technique of battery and charging, the usage pattern of battery electric vehicles, the effect of energy saving and emission reduction, and the constraint of urban land resources. Considering these five decisive elements, this paper argued that the energy supply mode of BEVs should be different from that of traditional petrol vehicles. Energy supply of BEVs is mainly to be dependent on charging at night during the low electric demand period. The modes of quick-charging in the daytime and battery-replacing should act as subsidiary supply methods. Then the service function and layout requirements of the normal-charging station, fast-charging station and battery-replacing station are proposed based on the energy supply strategy. The results of this paper are of great importance to improve the energy supply system and guide the upcoming rigorous construction of energy supply facilities.

articleTitle: The Class-Specific Down-Looking Target Localization Combining Recognition and Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the complex down-looking background, it is difficult to accurately localize various targets because of target deformation and background clutter. In this paper, we develop a target detection algorithm that incorporates bottom-up target segmentation and top-down target recognition. There are two main steps in the algorithm: hypotheses generation (top-down) and hypotheses verification (bottom-up). In the generation step, the study makes an improvement on shape feature, which is more robustness to target deformation. The improved shape feature is used to generate the hypotheses of target locations and figure-ground masks. In the hypotheses verification step, the study firstly computes feasible target segmentation that is consistent with top-down target hypotheses. And then a false positive pruning procedure is proposed. The study also finds the fact that the pruned false positive regions do not align with target segmentation for many down-looking targets. The experimental tasks demonstrate that the algorithm can be high precision and recall with a few positive target-training images and that the algorithm, and be generalized to many target classes.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Risk Pooling to Inventory Management for a Three-Stage Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Due to obscured information and asynchronous actions, the bullwhip effect suggests that the variability of orders increases while moving upstream in supply chain from warehouse to integrated inventory to supplier. Bullwhip effect amplifies the demand, boosts the inventory and increases the total cost of the supply chain. In order to decrease the stock and improve the efficiency of the supply chain, this paper studies the bullwhip effect on the inventory of three-stage supply chain with and without risk pooling respectively. Through derivation it proves that risk pooling can reduce both safety stock and average inventory of three-stage supply chain whether the three warehouses’ demands are correlated or not. Some other characters of risk pooling are also discussed, which are vital to manage inventory by integrating system.

articleTitle: The Teeth Image Recognition Using HDM and the Turn Point
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper presents the image recognition results using the proposed HDM (Hybrid Differential Method) and its turn point. Derivative of HDM results are taken to analyse the point-symmetric feature of the match point. The results are discussed to determine creteria if the pattern match is found or not. The method is applied to search a specific image from a bigger target picture. The results show that HDM has multiple advantages over traditional method when applied to image searching, like considerably less time consumed, better recognition rate when the background or grayscale value changed. The HDM + turn point approach is proved to be useful in occlusal view of a teeth image. An image of a molar was used as an example in the paper, images are deformed to a certain grades to test the adaptability in proposed scenarios. All calculations are done using Matlab toolbox.

articleTitle: Functional Module Design of Virtual Maintenance Training and Testing System for a Certain Type of Command and Control System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To enhance the training manintenance and training level of a certain type command and control system, the online virtual maintenance training system based on fault cases were developed. This system utilizes the modular structure. It is composed of the management modules, training modules, test modules and detection modules. By using the Access databases, the data access operation of users, administrators, papers and the operating procedures realize the data interaction with FlashActionScript.

articleTitle: Simulation on Diesel/DME Mixed Injection System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Dimethyl ether (DME) is a promising and excellent alternative fuel for compression ignition DI diesel engines. In addition to the significant merit of no soot emission, DME would be of better ignition quality, lower auto ignition temperature and better atomization compared with diesel. The paper presents models and simulates fuel injection system of diesel/DME engine. Simulation calculation proven that DME could injected into mixed cavity propitious and mixed rather equality with diesel. Injecting characteristic of fuel system was impacted by blended DME, and the incidence came along with DME proportional.

articleTitle: Vision Based Tel-operation Robot Virtual Reality Circumstance Modeling in Real-Time
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the robot tel-operation, the influence on transparence and performance of real time can be weakened by the reliable reference offered by the VRML VR (virtual reality) circumstance. But the VR circumstance changes frequently, in order to track these changes timely and exactly, a vision based tel-operation robot VR timely modeling technology is brought forward. The result shows that this modeling method can satisfy the precision of collision detection and has a perfect performance in real time.

articleTitle: A SUMO-Based Ontology of Expressway Network for Domain Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper focuses on the domain knowledge management of expressway networks in Intelligent Transport Systems and develops ontology for them by reusing SUMO (Suggested Upper Merge Ontology) as the upper ontology. The approached ontology names SENO (SUMO-based Expressway Network Ontology) and consists of two parts, among which SENO Basic is the set of shared concepts and relations, whereas SENO Core divides key concepts and relations into several categories according to the pattern of semantic organization of information in expressway network. As illustrated in a case study, SENO can be instantiated to form a comprehensive semantic view of the domain knowledge to eliminate ambiguities among heterogeneous systems, and to better promote knowledge management and information sharing for expressway network.

articleTitle: Recognition of Steel Billet Image with Different Orientations in Production Line
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: An automatic recognition method for steel billet images with different orientations is proposed in this paper. A crucial part of this method is to segment the image firstly, and then use the projection features of the segmented image to distinguish the different orientations of the steel billet in production line. After the string is segmented into individual characters, the segmented characters can be recognized by template matching. Experiments on steel billet image recognition demonstrate that the proposed method can distinguish the steel billet image orientation and recognize the characters automatically, which shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Models of Storage Cost Analysis for Warehouse Leasing and Expanding
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Storage cost is in a larger proportion of logistics cost. In order to analyze and compare the storage cost of warehouse leasing and expanding, storage cost models of warehouse leasing and expanding are established, using the reduced number of storage X as the parameters, and the relative parameters in the model are further discussed. Storage cost models built in this paper is practical, reasonable and operational. The cost of warehouse leasing can be calculated reasonably by using this model which also can be used to analyze and compare the cost of warehouse leasing and expanding in order to optimize decision-making.

Author Keywords: Analysis of Warehouse leasing and expansion

articleTitle: Research on Green Packaging of Circular Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The circular economy is the resource recycling economy, is the economy of harmonious development between economy and environment, also a kind of ecological economy. Circular economy demands that enterprises' logistics activities be green logistics packaging. The green packaging aims at improving the packing materials reuse, reducing resource consumption and lowering packaging waste pollution to the environment. Implementing green logistics packaging, we should enhance awareness of the green packaging, utilize the resources of logistics packaging, promote the green packaging design with a new packaging materials, choose the rational mode of green logistics packaging, develop technology of recycling logistics packaging waste.

articleTitle: The Study of Reliability About the Internal Network of Shanghai South Railway Station Based on the Robustness of Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Comprehensive urban passenger transportation hub is the place that passenger flows distribute and transfer. Shanghai south railway station is an important point in Shanghai. In this paper, related to the knowledge of a complex network, making the station as the object of study, the station will be built into the two kinds of networks and their complex characteristic would be analyzed, and test the network survivability. The results show that t degree distribution of the station network is in line with power-law distribution. Then, making the average shortest path and clustering coefficient both for the evaluation criteria, through the network changes its properties by the chosen and randomly attack to make the corresponding discussion of a complex network of fault-tolerance and anti-aggressive, and conclude relationship of the anti-aggressive with the network parameters change.

articleTitle: Researching on Left-Turning Traffic Organization and Control at Urban Signalized Intersections
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Left-turning traffic is a critical and influential factor for urban intersection of traffic operation. As an integrated transportation hub, the railway station of Hohhot assembles so many taxis, buses and pedestrians, which result in traffic capacity reducing and conflicting. Traffic delay phenomenon is very severe. Based on the field investigation on the traffic organization and control, this paper analyzed traffic operation conditions under the present situations. Also, from the perspectives of guaranteeing safe operation of vehicles standpoint and reducing waiting delay to the minimum standpoint, the paper proposed the improving measurements for traffic management and control.

articleTitle: Study of Spatial Accessibility Based on GIS and Value of Time
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Accessibility is taken for the comprehensive and effective method for traffic network evaluation, and gradually is used in diversified domain, such as urban planning, traffic planning, spatial structure and regional economy development. GIS as a kind of new technology, it provides a more simple, accurate and effective tool for the computing of accessibility. Usually, the study of accessibility only considered the Objective Time, distance measurer or the simple transportation expenses, but neglected the difference of time value of various trip modes. This paper has introduced the concept of time value, provided a kind of general method that using GIS in the accessibility evaluation of urban spatial accessibility, and shown result in the GIS platform.

articleTitle: An Improved Edge Preserving Smoothing Method (IEPS)
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Edge preserving smoothing prior to image segmentation is very important, since the image detailed information is mostly in edges, and smoothing uncorrupted pixels can sharply reduce the image quality. Hence, a novel noise detection method is essential to identify the noised pixels and noise-free pixels. In this paper, the noise detection is based on the difference between the pixel of interest value and its eight neighbors. The proposed method uses the mean of the five pixels with minimum difference to distinguish edge pixels from noisy pixels. Then, it is combined with the edge preserving smoothing using nine rotating mask to replace the noised pixel. The results show that the proposed method outperforms other method, with higher Peak Signal to Noise Ratio and reducing noise.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance of Link Travel Time Estimation Based on Floating Car Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Travel time estimation is one of the core problems in Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) and Floating Car Data (FCD) is an important data source used by many cities to estimate it. This paper utilizes the Next Generation Simulation (NGSIM) project dataset to simulate the FCD scenario, to test the accuracy of FCD based link travel time estimation. In the first part, the calculated time from simulated FCD, which is referred as “estimated time” and the average travel time of selected floating cars, which is referred as “sample time”, is compared. In the second part, the “sample time”, and average travel time of all cars on the target link, which is referred as “real time” is distinguished, and a binomial distribution model is proposed to explain the situation. Finally, the robust of time estimation to exceptional cars is discussed.

articleTitle: Decision Analysis to Solve Misplaced Inventory with RFID
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Misplaced inventory will lead to a more cycle inventory quantity and an increasing cost to maintain the inventory. RFID is a promising solution for the problem. But the adoption of RFID needs to invest more in inventory investment. Whether this improves the service level or not after adoption is needed to be considered. We use the newsvendor function with the condition of single cycle and one product, build decision models to find the optimal inventory before and after adopting RFID. Through these models, we also have discussed how the optimal quantity, the optimal income and the fill rate are influenced by the misplaced rate and the unit variable cost of RFID. The results show that the relationship between the misplaced rate and the unit variable cost is the key factor for adopting RFID. We found that when the misplaced rate is lower than a certain limit and the unit cost is higher than a certain limit, there is no need to use RFID; When the misplaced rate is higher than a certain limit and the unit cost is lower than a certain limit, there is necessary to use RFID.

articleTitle: Regional OD Matrix Estimation Based on the Ratio of Intersection Turning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: According to the characteristics of the scope of the traffic impact of special events, this paper put the traffic of border roads in the affected areas as origin (O) and destination (D), researched the regular of the ratio of intersection turning and the traveler route choice behavior, proposed a new regional OD matrix estimation method based on the intersection turning. Examples showed that this method was simple and feasible, and the calculated results have practical value.

articleTitle: A New Approach to GPS Carrier Phase Ambiguity Resolution Using Single Epoch Single Frequency Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The fast ambiguity resolution method, especially that using single epoch single frequency data, has been a challenging issue in the kinematic GPS positioning. In this paper, artificial immune algorithm (AIA) was introduced to search GPS carrier phase integer ambiguities. It is a new optimization method through simulating biological immune systems to search the best solution. AIA can succeed in improving the poor efficiency and stability of the genetic algorithm (GA). If the normal equation is consisted only by single epoch carrier phase, it is always rank deficient. The general method is to combine the C/A code and the L1 carrier phase together, so as to eliminate rank deficiency. In this situation, the normal equation is ill-conditioned. In addition, the pseudo-range is often influenced by high noise, which would result in lower reliability of the float ambiguity solutions. So, the efficiency of kinematic positioning is influenced because the differences are large between the float ambiguity solution and the correct integer ambiguity. To improve the float solution, an unbiased estimation method named Iteration by Modifying Normal Equation (IMNE) is applied. IMNE can efficiently improve the ill-condition of normal equation. By using it, more precise ambiguity float solution can be acquired and the search space of ambiguity can be greatly reduced. The improved float solution increases the success rate of fixing the carrier phase integer ambiguities. After obtaining more accurate ambiguity float solution, AIA was used to search GPS carrier phase integer ambiguity. The results of some examples show that the new approach (INME-AIA) based on the improving float solution is efficient.

articleTitle: Research on High-Resolution Color OLED Display Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, a new OLED(Organic Light Emitting Diode) color display method is introduced. Unlike the most commonly used technique-RGB-polymer emitters, there are four colors. That is in addition to red, green and blue (RGB) tri-color light-emitting materials, there is a white light-emitting materials. First the impact of the brightness stability and life factors of various materials are analyzed, than its drive circuit is discussed in detail. Through the control of the current for each RGB, improved its color and life context, achieved the color balance of high-resolution OLED panels, and reduced the total power consumption.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model in the Risk Assessment for Logistics Park Construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In recent years, a logistics park construction wave has emerged rapidly in China. At the same time, there is a high vacancy rate in the use. There is a high risk because of many uncertainty factors existing in the whole cycle of modern logistics park construction. The failure of logistics park construction can cause large losses, which are difficult to restore. How to properly evaluate the risks in logistics park construction and manage them has become an important issue. The paper builds an index system on risk evaluation for construction of logistics park, presents fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model and evaluates the risk of Aviation Logistics Park in Chengdu using the model. Case shows the effectiveness and feasibility of themethod.

articleTitle: Travel Time Forecasting Based on Phase Space Reconstruction and SVM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Travel time forecasting is an important content of dynamic traffic navigation. Dynamic traffic data collection is the precondition of forecasting. Many traffic data collection methods have been adopted, such as loop inductive vehicle detector, radar detector, video detector, GPS floating car and so on. Due to the widely distribution, GPS floating car has become the most efficient mean to collect instantaneous traffic information. How to take use of the collected GPS floating car data to forecasting the travel time is a popular research topic. In this paper, we develop a travel time forecasting method with the combining phase space reconstruction theory and SVM. Phase space reconstruction theory is used to determine the number of forecasting variable. SVM is used to forecast the future travel time value. The efficiency of the method is illustrated through analyzing Jinan urban traffic data.

articleTitle: The Research for the Strategic Purchase Model of the Home Appliances Enterprises Based on Revenue-Sharing Contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: We research conducted the strategic purchase model of the the home appliances enterprises based on revenue-sharing contract in this paper. Under such a contract, a manufacturer pays a supplier a wholesale price for each unit purchased, plus a percentage of the revenue generated by manufacturer that is determined by manufacturer's purchase quantity and price. Finally, a numerical instance is used to give further analysis.

articleTitle: The Realization of Power Company Comprehensive Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Due to most of the power company's application systems running in different platforms, being with different data formats and incompatibility between systems, a information island is formed one by one. Based on a service-oriented architecture (SOA), a scheme of power information system basis data integration has been proposed. It is an information system integration architecture oriented Internet environment, which can achieve inter-agency business integration by connecting the cross-platform, functional independence and reusable service entity. So, it effectively integrates various major applications in enterprise, makes use of good data structure of XML, establishes a data sharing platform for each heterogeneous data sources, improves the management and production efficiency, also is a trend of future power enterprise information management.

articleTitle: A Simple and Efficient Method for Verification of Vehicle Speed Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A verification method for vehicle speed measuring systems which is comprised of simulating excitation and on-site test is introduced, and the inductive loop system is used as an example for discussion. Repeated simulating excitations in full scale are performed to ensure the correctness of the principle equation with an undetermined coefficient k, and a few times of on-site tests are performed to calculate the coefficient k. This method provides a simple and efficient way to install, adjust and verify vehicle speed measuring systems, and has been recommended in the nationalmetrology verification regulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Individuals' Activity-Travel Behavior Based on a Structural Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Using the activity-travel survey data of Shangyu, a typical medium sized city of China, this paper describes the development, estimation and interpretation of a model relating to socio-demographics, activity participation and travel behavior, A complex set of interrelationships among the variables of interest is estimated simultaneously using the structural equation modeling methodology, with activity participation and travel behavior endogenous to the model. The results show that strong relationships exist between socio-demographic characteristics and activity-travel behavior. Besides, the results reveal trade-offs between in-home and out-of-home activity participation when people are facing decisionmaking. Furthermore, it is also found that socio-demographics not only directly affect travel behavior but also indirectly influence travel behavior through activity participation. The findings contribute to better understanding and analyzing individuals' activity-travel behavior. Furthermore, they are helpful to the formulation of scientific transportation policies and significant to studies on activity-based travel demand forecasting method.

articleTitle: A Study on Coaxial Type DBD Decomposing NO/N2 Mixture Gas by Optical Emission Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Through establishing a test system of coaxial dielectric barrier discharge type non-thermal plasma reactor, using Q-V Lissajous figure method to measure its electrical parameters, optical emission spectrum of NO/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixed gas system was analyzed, and the effects of the applied voltage peak-peak value(V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P-P</sub>) on the optical emission spectrum intensity of NO, N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> excited state species were studied when NO/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture gas passed the reactor's discharge area. The results showed that high-energy electrons produced by non-thermal plasma played an effective role on the NO, N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> molecules and produced a variety of excited states matters, such as NO(A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>Σ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>Π), N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>Π <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</sub>→B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>Π <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub>);
