articleTitle: Research on Influence Extention of Two-Lane Highway Intersections Based on Traffic Accident Database
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Intersections are of great importance to highway network, and it is commonly thought that traffic accidents happen more at intersections than normal segments. Traffic conflicts and traffic flow changes always exist at some extention of intersections. It's extremely crucial to recognize the influence extention of intersections to the network, which can help to indentify the safety status of the intersections and to take corresponding countermeasures. The distribution of traffic accidents along the intersection center of each direction are analyzed based on the traffic accident database using traffic accident index. The distribution line of traffic accident index around intersections is like a Gaussian function, which is more higher at center. The line vividly shows that traffic accidents happen more at intersection centers, and decrease gradually as the space to intersection center increases, while the distribution of traffic accidents seems no change when the space is more than about 400 meters. 325 meters at each direction from intersection center are recognized as the intersection influence extention on two-lane highway after deeper analysis.

articleTitle: Quantitative Research on Vehicle Exhausts Pollution in the City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: On the basis of basic properties, traffic flow and vehicle model ratio of each road in Hohhot, as a result of field investigation, by applying the calculation model of Line Source Emission Rate to get the roads line emission rate in Hohhot, the paper quantificationally provides the total amount of various pollutants emitted by the vehicles on each road of Hohhot, figures out the segment which need to be controlled emphatically and deduces the total amount of various pollutants daily and yearly, which are emitted by the vehicles in the city.

articleTitle: Traffic Information Management and Promulgating System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Traffic information is difficult to manage because of the characteristic of the huge amount of data, space, timeliness, and difficulties to describe. It is inconvenient for the traffic managers and travelers to understand and access the traffic information only depending on the form of promulgating by text or picture. So, the Geographic Information Systems (GIS) is introduced in the traffic management and promulgating system because of the traffic information urgently need by the current information society. The framework of the overall structure, main functions, database design, and system design in traffic information management and promulgating system based on GIS are discussed. The system can be convenient and efficient to extract and display the spatial information and attribute information of various sections of the road or traffic facilities. As well as through processing and analyzing traffic status information and traffic accident information, the road traffic incidents are to be early detected, early identified, early decided and early promulgate. So this system can be convenient for travelers and traffic managers to make decision.

articleTitle: Effect of Common Rail System on Vehicle Engine Combustion Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A test bench is set up based on a CA6106 Direct Injection (DI) diesel engine equipped with ECD-U2. MAP calibration is accomplished using the online calibration software, combustion analysis software and data acquisition software. The precision, feasibility and reliability of software design are verified by the tests. The experiments indicate that Common Rail (CR) injection system has a great potential to decrease the emission and improve the performance of DI diesel engine. The experiments on function matching of CA6DE diesel engine are conducted. The structural parameters of injector, the structural parameters and swirl ratio of combustion chamber are improved and optimized. Using the high pressure CR electronically controlled system and corresponding measurement instruments, the fuel consumption and exhaust parameters are measured. The results show that a higher injection pressure, smaller injector core diameter, as well as a lower swirl ratio, a proper combustion chamber shape, and a delay in injection timing, can improve the mixing and combustion of fuel-air mixture, reduce harmful exhaust, and improve the overall performance of economy, power and exhaust.

articleTitle: A Novel Fiber CAN Hub and Its Networking Schemes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The overall behavior of some twisted-pair CAN systems may be improved by use of optical fiber as physical medium. In this paper, a novel fiber CAN hub and the schemes of constructing CAN network based on it are proposed. The working principle of the hub is discussed in detail. WDM (Wavelength Division Multiplexing) technology is utilized to realize duplex signal transmission on one fiber link. By replacing the “Wired-AND” in twisted-pair CAN bus with the logic “AND” in CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Device) and ensuring each node's bus monitoring function by sending the “ANDed” signal back, the fiber CAN network thus formed is fully compatible with the CAN standard above physical layer. Methods of expanding fiber CAN network are also discussed. An eight-port prototype hub is implemented and tested to prove the feasibility and practicability of the proposed schemes. Features of the fiber CAN network are summarized and future works are pointed out.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Packing by a Tabu Search Algorithm in Military Airlift Loading
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper presents a algorithm for three-dimensional packing in military airlift loading. In this case, the design variables correspond to the sequential order in which the items are considered for packing, thereby zero collision between items is implicitly in the packing procedure, reducing the need for collision detection and overall computation effort. Furthermore, we optimize the layout of items within the cargoholds by taking into account the practical constraints, especially the center of gravity which differs from truck loading. This paper describes the airlift loading optimization model as well as its coding in tabu search. The algorithm is demonstrated on practical loading problems.

articleTitle: A New Vector Method to Diagnose Individual Misfiring Cylinder Based on Crankshaft Angular Vibration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on ICE dynamics and the basic equation about the harmonic angular vibration and corresponding harmonic moment of each cylinder, a new vector method to diagnose individual misfiring cylinder using the measured crankshaft angular vibration was proposed, which needs not establish the diagnostic dynamic model of crankshaft harmonic angular vibration, and is independent of the crankshafts structure parameters and a great deal of experiments. Simulated and experiments results on 4-8 cylinder diesel engines verified the correctness and practicability of the new method.

articleTitle: Research on Distributive Regularity of Vehicle Speedometer Indicated Error and Its Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The traveling speed of vehicle has a very important effect on the occurrence of road traffic accidents and the harmfulness of the accidents. The speedometer indicated error and its distributive regularity would be researched in depth. Based on the combination of speedometer test-bed measurement and statistical analysis, the speedometer indicated error and its distributive regularity of given type passenger cars have been revealed. The research discovers that the error obey normal distribution, which parameters μ and μ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are 38.553 0 km/h and 2.744 0 km2/h2 respectively, and establishes corresponding distributive models. Checking computation shows that the model calculating results are consistent with the sample measuring data, and the model calculating error is only 0.68%. The research has a very important effect on understanding the statistical regularity of speedometer indicated errors, pledging the vehicle traveling safety and improving speedometer design and manufacture.

articleTitle: One New Map Matching Model for Vehicle-Borne Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The technique of vehicle-borne navigation system develops rapidly. Map matching is one of the key techniques of the vehicle-borne navigation. General map matching method is based on simple point projection. It often appears matching errors in the face of complicated roadways. The article aims at the shortcoming of general map matching, and designs a forecast map matching model based on roadway topology and geometry characteristic. What's more, the model is validated by practical running tests. Forecast map matching model brings new idea in order to resolve the difficult problem of matching on complicated roadways.

articleTitle: Research of Information Weapon System Performance Evaluation Based-on DoDAF
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the DoDAF standards, this paper established the information weapon system architecture product models, converted the model to an executable CPN model, and verified the correctness of the logical behavior of the information-based weapon system architecture. Then by CPN model simulation analysis, it evaluated the performance of the information-based weapon system.

articleTitle: Study on Automated Incident Detection Algorithms Based on PCA and SVM for Freeway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: According to the freeway traffic flow characteristics under incidents situation, this paper puts forward a kind of AID algorithm based on PCA & SVM. Above all, PCA has been applied to extract principle components from preselected indexes, to realize dimension reductions, and construct the traffic eigenvectors. And then, validity of the new algorithm proposed in this paper has been tested using various SVM models, and also contrasts with the results of algorithms only based on SVM. The simulation results demonstrate that the new algorithm can detect incidents more effectively and more expeditiously, with the preferable detection performance. Especially, detection effects of the new algorithm based on linear SVM models are the best.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Air-Fuel Ratio Control Strategy for a Hydrogen Internal Combustion Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: One of the most attractive combustive features for hydrogen fuel is its wide range of flammability. The wide flammability limits allow hydrogen engine to be operated at extremely lean air-fuel ratios compared to conventional fuels. Concepts for part-load operation of hydrogen engines have been proposed using quantitative control and qualitative control. This paper summarizes the steady-state test results by quantitative and qualitative air-fuel ratio control modes in a hydrogen internal combustion four-cylinder engine operated on an engine dynamometer. Based on the test results of engine efficiency and NOx emissions, a combinated air-fuel ratio control strategy for hydrogen engine is proposed.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation Indexes System of Barrier-Free Public Transportation System Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Being lack of the evaluation indexes system and evaluating method of domestic normal transit system's barrier-free service quality, there are not enough scientific principles for barrier-free planning, design, management and supervising of normal urban public transportation system. So, in this paper, an initial new evaluation indexes system of that mentioned above is set up, also, the definition and measure methods of this indexes system are discussed, the whole indexes system is composed of covering indexes, convenience indexes, speeding indexes, economy indexes and safety indexes. All indexes are on the basis of corresponding handicapped people's travel demand analysis and each index indicates and describes corresponding barrier between the handicapped and normal transit system. The purpose of this work is to afford some references in making decision of sort and priority of construction project of barrier-free public transportation in order to maximize the effectiveness of limited resource.

articleTitle: The Viscous Resistance Calculation for the Trimarans Based on the Boundary Layer Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The viscous resistance calculation methods for trimarans were presented in this paper, as were developed out based on the thin and thick boundary layer theories, with the integral calculation procedure built in the streamline coordinate system; and the viscous resistance calculation of the monohull and trimaran were performed by present methods as calculation samples, the calculation results having compared with the results from traditional empirical formula to validate the accuracy of present method for ship hulls, especially for trimarans.

articleTitle: Wireless Communication Simulation Experiment on Map Matching Method Between Parallel Roads Based on Mobile Phone Handover
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Two simulation experiment scenes, urban and suburban areas, are built to analyze the efficiency and applicability of map matching method based on mobile phone handover considering influence factors such as base station dense, cell radius and multipath effect. During the simulation test, the handover sequence is recorded when the vehicle with a mobile phone is travelling along each of the two parallel roads by the Matlab software. The parameter, sequence similarity, which is calculated from the two recorded handover sequences of the two parallel roads in every simulation test, is used to evaluate the extent which the two parallel roads have the same continuous handover. The results of two hundreds of simulation tests show that the same continuous handover sequence probability is higher in the suburban simulation experiment scene than in urban one possibly because the larger cell radius in suburban areas covers more roads. The average sequence similarity in suburban simulation experiment scene is 0.17, three times as much as in urban one.

articleTitle: Research on Effectiveness of Freeway Work Zone Speed Reduction Strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Two-lane, one-way freeways compose a large percent of the freeway system nationwide. Preserving, expending, and enhancing these freeways result in many work zones which have caused a safety concern for the traveling public. Aimed at reducing crashes attributed to the existence of these work zones, an evaluation of speed reduction measures was carried out in work zones of the freeway. The speeds before and after three speed reduction strategies were measured. The mean and 85 percentile speed, and the standard deviation of the speed were analyzed statistically. It can be concluded that the effect of the individual warning sign was very limited, which can not achieve the desired results. However, the three dimensional speed markings made sense, which can reduce the mean speed by 10.4 km/h; but in the meantime the standard deviation of the speed increased because many drivers misunderstood it, got confused or braked a vehicle suddenly. Besides, the effect of the speed limit sign with camera graph was very obvious, which made the mean speed slow down by 17.3 km/h, and standard deviation of the speed fell as well. So the speed limit sign with camera graph could be used in the work zones of the freeway to control the speed while the warning sign, and the three dimensional speed markings were not recommended. Keywords-Work zone, Traffic safety, warning sign, Three dimensional speed markings, Speed limit sign with camera graph.

Author Keywords: Speed limit sign with camera graph

articleTitle: Analysis on Quality Control in Food Supply Chain Based on Dynamics Evolutionary Game Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Quality control in food supply chain is a scientific discipline describing handling, preparation, and storage of food in ways that prevent food borne illness. This includes a number of routines that should be followed to avoid potentially severe health hazards. But the game evolutionary mechanism of food quality control in food supply chain is still not clear, and the rise of dynamic evolutionary game theory is a theory combining together with the game theory analysis and dynamic analysis of the evolution process. For the effective implementation of incentive policy to control food quality, the food quality control model based on dynamic evolutionary game theory is built and the evolutionary stable strategy is also studied in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Aircraft Pushback Procedure in Busy Airport
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The aircraft pushback is an important aspect of airport surface management and is one of the key factors affecting operation efficiency of apron. The problem of aircraft pushback in busy airports is studied in this paper. On the basis of the analysis on the process of aircraft pushback, the aircraft pushback procedure is designed to solve the influence of airport blind spot and the conflict of pushback. Mainly using the shortest sliding time as the optimization objectives, a model of gate position combination is set up and a hierarchy iteration algorithm is designed to solve the model. Finally, it is shown through instances that the aircraft pushback procedure can effectively reduce the conflict and increase the level of surface management and operation.

articleTitle: Performance of Dilemma Zone Mitigation System at Signalized Intersections
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A high accident potential exists at high-speed signalized intersections where an area close to an intersection, called a dilemma zone (also known as decision zone). The potentially negative impact of dilemma zones on the operational capacity and safety of signalized intersections, has motivated a great deal of effort to the mitigation of the dilemma zone issue. This mitigation system have been pursued along the three complementary paths of signal timing, vehicle detection, and advanced warning.

articleTitle: Development of a Power Management System for Electric Vehicles with Multiple Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: An electric vehicle can be powered by either a single source or a combination of multiple sources, e.g. lead-acid batteries, solar cells, and fuel cells. Because of energy crisis and environmental protection, coordination of different power sources for an electric vehicle has recently been becoming an important issue. The objective of this paper is to develop a power management system for an electric vehicle powered by the combination of lead-acid batteries and solar cells. The system consists of an intelligent control unit, a switching unit, a sensing unit module, and a DC/DC converter. The control unit processes data and accordingly instructs the switching unit to allocate an adequate power supply to the drive. Experimental results show that the system can coordinate power supplies effectively and suppresses battery current surges to prevent the batteries from deep discharge. Accordingly the longevity of the batteries can be prolonged.

articleTitle: A Road Safety Evaluation Method Based on Clustering Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Traffic accident records data mining is very important to understand why traffic accidents occurred frequently under some driving, environment, and vehicle conditions. There are many reasons can lead to accident, and their relationships are complex, it is very difficult to build a correct evaluation model. To overcome this problem, statistical models such as neural network, fuzzy logic, decision tree etc. have been widely used on such accident data to analyze road crashes. In this paper we present a road safety evaluation method based on the clustering neural network. This method first learn the history data, after it is stable, it can be used to evaluate the road safety. The experimental results prove that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Traffic Accident Black-Spots Formation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Traffic accident black-spots (shorten as black-spots) highly affect the safety level of highways. The most important work must be done firstly is to find out the formation mechanism of black-spots. The secondary infection model of black-spots is set up by taking the driver-vehicle as protoplast and the highway or environment as infection source based on a simplified highway system. And the approximate solution of confidence interval of danger rate is presented by the exact hypothesis testing based on p-value. The reliability of the method is validated based on the black-spots data of a road.

articleTitle: Impact of weather on morning peak congestion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The investigation of weather effects on traffic congestion is important for the traffic information issuance, because traffic intensity is noted as the first and primary traffic information. Therefore the main objective of this study is the identification and comparison of weather effects on traffic congestion. To assess the impact of weather conditions on traffic congestion, the traffic of Shanghai Lupu Bridge are considered. The traffic data originate from minute data coming from loop detectors, collected by the Shanghai City Comprehensive Transportation Plannin Institute. The main method envisaged in this study to identify and quantify weather effects is statistics. Most appealing result of this study is that rain have a clear extend effect on morning peak congestion, while fog have little effect on morning peak congestion.

articleTitle: Study on Space-Time Distribution Characteristics of Floating Car Data Based on Large Samples
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Floating Car Data has been used to evaluate traffic conditions in Real-time Transportation Information Systems. In these systems, taxis are often used as probe cars. Because of the randomicity of taxis when travelling in cities, it is necessary to analyze taxis' distribution characteristics in road networks. In this paper, two indexes named Detecting Intensity and Detecting Rate are designed to analyze the Space-Time Distribution Characteristics. 5,000 taxis in Hangzhou of China are selected as probe cars, and Floating Car Data are continuously collected from these taxis during a week. The conclusions show that Detecting Intensity and Detecting Rate can clearly demonstrate the Space-Time Distribution Characteristics in different time and road types. Urban express ways, arterial roads can usually be detected by probe cars with more dependability. Traffic conditions evaluated through FCD in peak hours on a day is probably more dependable than in off-peak hours. At the same time, the relationship between distribution characteristics and sample size are also analyzed, in order to help find a more reasonable probe car sample size for Real-time Transportation Information Systems.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Optimization of Vertical Section of the Hump Pushing Zone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Design of vertical section of hump pushing zone affects disconnecting capacity of marshalling yard. There are 2 factors being chosen to be the objective function, one is height difference between reception yard and hump crest, the other is the distance between the position of disconnecting the coupler of cars. Multi-objective optimization model is established. Meanwhile, Random weight multi-objective genetic algorithm is proposed. Pareto set method and reserving elite strategy is introduced as well. The model and algorithm are shown by a concrete example. As a result, both of them are reasonable.

Author Keywords: The vertical section of hump pushing zone

articleTitle: A Method of Error Separation for Fiber Optical Gyroscope Based on Star Sensor Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A Star Sensor based Fiber Optical Gyroscope Error Separation method (SSFES) was proposed, which can be applied in the Fiber Optical Gyroscope (FOG) performance evaluation and fault diagnosis for the space-borne Inertial Navigation System (INS) & Celestial Navigation System (CNS) combined navigation system. The method takes the satellite rotational angular rate and the attitude quaternion to separate the long-term drift component from the FOG output and provides the useful information for FOG error compensation and model construction. The output quaternion of the star sensor was utilized to reconstruct the satellite rotational angular rate information, which was then used to separate the error component from the FOG output. Simulations have been carried out to verify the method and have shown that the error component of FOG output can be extracted efficiently by SSFES and the algorithm is easy to be performed by the onboard computers.

articleTitle: A New Horizon Electronic Image Stabilization Algorithm Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, SVM is used in an electronic image stablizing algorithm designed for the sea environment with the horizon feature. First, samples updated mechanism proposed makes SVM an online classifier to distinguish two regions. On this basis, through the binary image processing and the Hough transform, the horizon is detected and the motion compensation values are acquired. Finally, the Affine transform and Bilinear interpolation is adopted to rectify the image sequence. These strategies make the algorithm have advantages in both high accuracy and low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-channel Image Superimposition System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A multi-channel image superimposition system is designed in this paper. It can superimpose white-light image on infrared thermal image to generate mixture image. The system is realized on a FPGA chip and is mainly composed of multi-channel DMA controller and image superimposition module. Multi-channel DMA controller can realize data exchange between image superimpositon module and memory independent of vehicle-loaded CPU. Image superimposition module adopts Alpha channel mixture algrithm to mix two-channel images. Equations of algrithm are modified to forms that can be easily designed on a FPGA chip. Due to using programmable chips and parallel processing technology, the system has high integration, good maintenance, quick image processing speed and strong real-time capability.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Deflagration Characteristics of the Liquid Propellant Spray Electrical Ignition and the Simplified Model Calculation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The liquid propellant atomization experimental apparatus, single pulse discharge device and the AC (alternating current) sequence discharge device have been designed to explore the electrical ignition method of HANbased liquid propellant. By using of high speed camera system, the electrical ignition experiment study of the HAN-based liquid propellant LP1846 under different injection pressure has been conducted. The results indicate that: the spray can be ignited instantly by single pulse discharge method as the Sauter mean diameter of the LP1846 droplets is in the region of 10~20 μm, but there is deflagration ability; stable ignition can be got by alternating current pulse discharge method as SMD of LP1846 droplets is in the region of 40~50 μm . Based on the experiment, the simplified model of LP1846 atomization pulse discharge ignition delay time has been proposed. The numerical results coincide well with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Image Focusing Method and System with Wavelet Filtering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The definition evaluation function of a digital image is structured by combining the wavelet transform with the energy function. The paper studied the image feature extraction using the smallest two-dimensional isotropic wavelet filter, set up the image definition evaluation model based on the wavelet filter by obtaining the edge information directly from the original image through the band-pass wavelet filter G0 and combining the image energy analysis, and proposed the image auto-focusing method based on the smallest isotropic wavelet filter. Applying the experimental platform constructed with a microscope auto-focusing system, the evaluation model based on the wavelet filter is compared with the evaluation based on the Laplacian. The experimental results show that the auto-focusing method and system based on the minimum isotropic wavelet filter has a better integrated focusing performance.

articleTitle: Seismically Induced Rock Slope Instability and the Corresponding Treatment: The Case of Leshan Giant Buddha Scenic Spot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: On May 12, 2008, a magnitude 8.0 earthquake hit Wenchuan Country, Sichuan Province, resulted in abundant landslides and slope failures were triggered. Besides, a lot of slopes were instability and needs corresponding treatment to reinforcement, especially in some important scenic spots in Sichuan. Leshan Giant Buddha scenic spot is one of the best scenic spots in China. Instable rock slope induced by earthquake is on the cliff of Wuyou Mountain near to Wuyou temple in Leshan Giant Buddha scenic spot. Instable rock slope seriously threatened the safety of some important scenery in Leshan Giant Buddha, such as the provincial unit in preservation of cultural relics of “Meander Core”, the “eyelash” of the giant sleeping Buddha, Jingyun pavilion and the words “Mainstay” that is inscribed on the rock slope. So, investigation, surveying and probing technology, combined with stereographic projection were used to study on topographical and geological condition of the site. Base on above results, we analyzed the stability of the rock slope. At last, taking the anchor as the principal project, drainage and inlays as auxiliary project was proposed to stability the rock slope.

articleTitle: A Study on Ripple Effects of Logistics Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper illustrates the input-output relationship of logistics industry and other industries basing on the data of China and analyzes the effect coefficient, sensitivity of dispersion coefficient, output ripple effect and price ripple effect. It reveals the status and role of logistics industry for the development of economic, then makes relevant policy recommendations promote the further development of the logistics industry in China.

articleTitle: Research on Rail Pressure Signal Processing Method of High Pressure Common Rail System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The rail pressure signal of electronic control high pressure common rail fuel injection system for diesel engines is used to the closed loop control for rail pressure and the determination of the energizing time for fuel injection. Traditionally rail pressure signal processing method uses 10 ms filter to get the average rail pressure for control the system. With the rail pressure signals measured from experiments, it is found that traditional method can't provide the sufficient information duration the time of multiple injections and will lead to the inaccurate fuel mass of main injection. According to the characteristics of rail pressure signal, this paper suggests that rail pressure signal can be divided into two stages: steady period and injection period, proposes the classified method for determining the two stages, and the different processing methods aimed at the two stages is presented. The experimental study demonstrates that the methods of the two stages meet the requirement of rail pressure control and injection respectively.

articleTitle: Research for Two-Valve Fuel System in Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To make the control of combustion more flexible the large amount of controllable fuel injection parameters of Diesel engine equipped with high pressure two-valve fuel injection system is used. The two-valve system is descriped which includes: High pressure pump, Rail and pipes, Injector and ECU. The low pressure system connects the High Pressure Injection components to the fuel tank and ensures that the system is supplied with fuel of required quality, quantity, and at the correct pressure and temperature. ECU model and wave map are presented in detail. It gives new method to control engine fuel injection.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Technical Measures for Rural Road Safety Enhancement in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: From 2007, Beijing Mentougou Highway Sub-Bureau invests 13 million RMB on 58 rural roads safety enhancement project that cover 214 kilometers. The features of vehicles, road users, road geometrics, budget, road environment, maintenance responsibility and traffic management are all different from normal highways that have corresponding standards and regulations for road safety. The technical measures of safety enhancement for rural roads cannot copy normal highways. Research must be done to know the vehicles and road users there effectively. New low-cost technical measures must be adopted or invented to fit the limit of the budget and the safety requirements. The paper describes the technology to reduce the cost of the safety enhancement for rural roads. These technologies include: innovate the treatment technology, choose new materials and innovate the structure of the traffic signs. A variety of low-cost technical measures which were used to the safety enhancement of rural roads in Mentougou District are listed. Most the low-cost technical measures are the first time to use on the rural roads in China. The types, principles, methods, specifications, advantages, shortcomings, outcomes and evaluation of the various measures and facilities are introduced and analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Cost Accounting/Control Study on Logistics of Specialized Automobile Enterprise Based on Object-Standard-Activity-Based Costing Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Now cost accounting popularly adopts the activitybased costing (ABC) method, compared with the traditional method, its precision is higher. In allusion to special automobile enterprises, this paper designs four models and two algorithms to the logistics of cost accounting and control(CA/C), which provides a theoretical support for it. And puts forward an object - standard - activity-based costing (OSABC) method in cost accounting, This method provides standard cost as a reference for its cost information, and set object cost in order to achieve the purpose of cost control, Finally proposes the frame diagram of a cost software system, and shows some interfaces.

articleTitle: Predicting Cotton Yarn Hairiness in Rotor Spinning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Yarn hairiness is an important yarn property like yarn evenness and strength. This property is affected by many fiber performances and processing parameters, which makes its prediction difficult also. In this study, we predicted the hairiness of the cotton yarn in rotor spinning using the ANN model. On the basis of the results obtained, with help of ANN analysis, we can predict the hairiness of the cotton easily and accurately. The results show that the ANN model yields more accurate and stable predictions, which indicates that the ANN theory is an effective and viable modeling method.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Spectrum Extraction Based on Fourier Telescopy in the Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Fourier Telescopy (FT) is an active high-resolution imaging technique. In the laboratory, the interference fringes which are essential to spectrum extraction are obtained by changing the position of beams. The theory about spectrum extraction is introduced in this paper, and iterative algorithm of restoring the target spectrum is presented also. A novel method of beam-moving is proposed, and has been compared with other two existed methods. The results show that the novel method can reduce the complexity of light path and simplify the control program and the algorithm about data processing. Given conclusions will be significant for the FT technique.

articleTitle: The Study of Indoor Air Quality in Train Compartment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Indoor air quality (IAQ) is a hot topic that people increasingly pay attention to in recent years. Railways are becoming increasingly market-driven, consequently, it is important that passengers are provided with a comfortable environment that reflects the operator's desired image for the service. It is well known that IAQ is still poor in train compartment and the study of IAQ in train compartment is almost blank. Aimed at the IAQ in train compartment, we have worked out a questionnaire and have investigated IAQ in train compartment with this questionnaire, and we have contrasted the results at different types of train compartment, different train speed and different outdoor environmental parameters. According to the inquisitional results, we come to the conclusion that the quantity of fresh air is the main factor that affects IAQ. At last, we put forward some measures to improve IAQ in train compartment.

articleTitle: Evolution of Knowledge Sharing Model in the Development of Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: There are not only logistics, trade flow and capital flow but also abundant knowledge flow in supply chain. Knowledge complementarity among enterprises is the important basis and prerequisite of supply chain knowledge flowing and knowledge sharing. Based on the perspective of product knowledge complementarity and enterprise interaction in supply chain this paper makes typology for knowledge interaction. According to the three kinds of knowledge interactions: Knowledge One-way Flow, Knowledge Two-way Exchange and Knowledge Linkage, this paper illustrates the evolution process of knowledge sharing model in the development of supply chain management, and divides this process into three stages: Knowledge Chain Transmission Model (KCTM), Network Knowledge Sharing Model (NKSM) and Collaborative Knowledge Sharing Model (CKSM), and finally demonstrates them by related practices in supply chain management.

articleTitle: Fire Risk Analysis of Subway Station Fire on Different Ventilation Modes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The subway fire increases with the development of city development. The subway fire accidents gradually increase, which cause great casualties and property losses. In order to study this problem, the main fire risk source was studied on experiment. Peak temperature of platform roof can reach to 170??? on Y=0 m, and most passengers will die within short time on natural ventilation condition as no any countermeasure is applied. The low visibility is 0.5m, and which can make evacuation speed descend to 0.8m/s. Peak temperature of platform roof only reaches to 40??? on Y=0m when mechanical smoke exhaust system were used to exhaust smoke in fire. The visibility and smoke movement velocity is larger than those on natural ventilation condition. The results show that the mechanical smoke exhaust system is important on subway fire, and which provide an effective method to control smoke.

articleTitle: Application of Contrast Source Inversion Algorithm for Reconstructing Complicated Targets from Experimental Transverse Electric Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper the nonlinear domain integral equation based methods are applied to reconstruct two complicated targets in an anechoic chamber from electromagnetic microwave tomography data. The applied algorithms are the contrast source inversion (CSI) algorithm and the CSI algorithm with extended approaches, for instance, frequency approach and regularization approach. Inversion results from the transverse electric (TE) polarization datasets using the multi-frequency multi-bistatic measurements are presented and compared, which verify the CSI algorithm with extended approaches is a promising method for microwave tomography.

articleTitle: Trimaran Center Hull Optimization for Minimum Wave Resistance under Fixed Outriggers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: An improved linear wave resistance theory tent function method for trimarans is proposed. Given fixed hull form of outriggers, the linear wave resistance was deduced into a quadratic form expressed by the center hull offsets. Then the quadratic programming optimization method could be used to seek the optimal center hull form. The proposed method was used to calculate the wave resistance of a trimaran with mathematical piece hulls and a practical trimaran, and the results accord with those from the model tests. Finally, the method was used to seek the center hull form optimization solution based on the above mentioned practical trimaran. The obtained optimal hull form wave resistance is reduced by about 4%~18%.

articleTitle: A New Approach for Moving Shadow Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the process of traffic video segmentation, the moving shadows have always been wrongly detected as foreground, which will in turn affect the latter processes of detection, analysis and tracing. We propose a method of moving shadow detection based on local texture features integrated with linear characteristics. Firstly, an adaptive background model was built on the basis of RGB color information, and speedy moving target detection was based on the background subtraction. And then, do shadow detection through Hamming distance by using the texture information which described by improved LBP local texture operator. Finally, the judgement of linearity occur via the previous texture information for the further shadow detection. According to the experiment, this method succeeds in detecting shadows robustly and achieves real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Suburbanization on Traffic in Central District
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: It is inevitable that urban is expanding to the suburb inthe process of the urbanization. In this paper, the proposition that the influence of suburbanization on traffic in the central district is put forward. By analyzing the relationship between the selection of residential location and the residential trip generation, a trip generation forecasting model for urban traffic district is established. The influence on traffic is analyzed. Furthermore, some Strategies and suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Traffic Time-Intervals Split Based on the Traffic Flow Variation of Days of Week
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: A majority of urban pretimed traffic signal control systems deploy multiple signal time-intervals to account for traffic demand changes during a day. There have been some mature studies on the algorithms of time-intervals split of TOD. However, these algorithms neglected the variation of traffic flow among days of week. In this research, a Nonparametric Test is applied to reflect the variation of traffic flow among days of week and classify the days of week into different categories, and then each day is divided into several timeintervals by adopting an ordered sample cluster algorithm according to the former categories. This method could eliminate the impact of traffic flow uncertainty on the timeintervals split and will provide more accurate time-intervals split for the urban pretimed traffic signal control systems.

articleTitle: Research on Speed Limit of Work Zones in the Freeway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The aim of the study was to develop a procedure for determining freeway work zone speed limits usable during the construction phase of a roadway maintenance project. The most desirable work zone speed limit should minimize the accident rate as well as ensure the capacity. Research by others showed that accident rates increase with deviation from the mean speed, so the speed limit should minimize the speed standard deviation. To save time, the method of microscopic simulation was utilized. The parameter set of the microscopic simulation model for work zones in the freeway was validated by using the data collected in the work zones by means of orthogonal experimental design. The simulations were run for various traffic volumes and compositions and the model between the speed limit and the speed standard deviation was built as well. The result is that speed limit lowered by 30 km/h downwards in work zones compared to the upper section can decrease the speed standard deviation and the potential accidental rate the most and the capacity can be maintained at the same time.

articleTitle: Design of Motor Driver for a Two-Wheeled Self Balancing Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper gives a design of two-wheeled self balancing electric vehicle referring the theory of inverted pendulum. A motor speed controlling module using MC33035 and PIC18F4580 is designed. After the designing, implementation and testing, the module is proved being have good control performance with a simple structure.

articleTitle: Method for Optimization of Urban Public Transport Network Based on AHP and Entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: To optimize the urban public transport network, the paper systematically researches the multifactor analysis and thought about the urban public transport, proposes six binding indexes together with their threshold on the purpose of minimizing the general cost and maximizing the service, and also establishes the quantitative objective functions for the optimization of transport network on the basis of 5 indexes such as total travel time of passengers according to spatial dimension, time dimension and value dimension firstly. Secondly, the paper establishes the standard index decision-making matrix and positive-negative ideal solution decision-making matrix, and researches the analyzing model for transport network optimization which takes the objective functions as set of indexes and alternatives as set of domain by quantitative analysis according to the TOPSIS. Finally, the weights of decision-making model are determined comprehensively by means of AHP and entropy which takes the experts' knowledge and experience, decision makers' intentions and preferences and information within data itself into consideration. In addition, the optimization degree was judged by calculating the closeness of scheme matrix which runs from the ideal scheme. The example shows that this method can adjust the public transport network better, and the result was much more reasonable and practical.

articleTitle: Investigation of Highway Safety Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: As the traffic accident rate keeps growing in China, more and more attentions have been paid to highway safety especially during highway design phase. This paper focuses on developing a new Highway Safety Evaluation System (HSES). First, the Highway Safety Design Model (IHSDM) software and its structure were introduced and the challenges of applying this tool to the highway design process in China were investigated. And then, the structure and data organization of HSES were introduced, furthermore, the key data transfer tool was completed, that can transfer existing highway geometric design data in China to Land XML 1.0 data for the use of after-then safety evaluation. Thirdly, the modules of HSES were shown and explained. And details of the proposed models development and implementation for operation speed and crash prediction were described. Finally, the advantages, limitations and future expectations of the software system were discussed.

articleTitle: Assessment of Residue Fatigue Life of Crankshaft Based on Theory of Fatigue Damage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Crankshaft is the most important moving part of diesel engine, and bears secular cyclic dynamic loads. In this paper, fatigue life prediction modelling and residue life assessment based on statistics of historical working state (SHWS) is conducted at crankshaft using fatigue damage accumulation (FDA) theory. First, its dynamic response of typical operation performance is analysed with software ANSYS of finite element, and high stress zone is found. Second, via rain-flow cycle counting for stress-time obtained, together with SHOP, fatigue load spectra of key parts are compiled. Finally, FDA model is built up with nominal stress method, and residue life based on SHWS is predicted for crankshaft of diesel engine.

articleTitle: The Parametric Design of Crankshaft
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The crankshaft is one of the most important components of engine, it endures complex and alternate load and it is the key point and difficulty of the engine design. Dynamic characteristics of crankshaft has been abstractly analyzed its kinematics and dynamics. A model of crank-connecting rod mechanism had been built in the software of Pro/E and ADAMS. To get the minimum force acted on mounting base, structural feature, velocity and quality of the mechanism have been parametric and optimal designed. The simulation results show that they conform to the theoretical arithmetic results. The research displayed a convenience and high efficiency method of mechanical design. It will provide some experience for large-scale simulation research in the future.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model for Highway Service Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: At present, the property of traffic industry has been changed from conventional industry to modern service industry. It is essential for managers to investigate the customer satisfaction index for highway service. The evaluation index system with hierarchical structure was established in this paper, according to characteristics of highway service, including the fields of construction, management and maintenance. A satisfaction evaluation model was proposed based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation with analytical hierarchy process and entropy weighting method. An investigation of customer satisfaction index to highway service was carried out in one city. The result indicates that the satisfaction degree obtained by the evaluation model is 3.45, which is at the level between general and more satisfied. On supporting facilities condition, achievements of fast and convenience, road beautification and tree planting, the evaluation was relatively high; on the highway traffic order, construction quality and supervision, the evaluation was relatively low. The indexes with lower satisfaction degree should be the important task in the future.

articleTitle: Integrated Approach to Select Logistics Enterprise Based on Uncertainty Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Since multifarious service will be provided by logistics enterprises, selecting an optimal logistics enterprise is one pivotal purpose of the manufacture enterprises. Considering the important uncertainty factors such as enterprise magnitude, transport capability and stockpile capability, an integrated approach (IA) based on the Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) and Multi-Attribute Decision Making (MADM) was put forward, which could evaluate the logistics efficiency of the enterprises and select the optimal logistics enterprise reliably. At last, an enterprise selecting example was provided, and the result illuminated the approach was effective and feasible to select more optimal logistics enterprise.

articleTitle: The Optimal Quantity Discount Policy from a Supplier's Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Quantity discounts are often used by suppliers to influence the retailers' order quantities. The discounts provided determine for the supplier the decreased revenue from each sale as well as the increased quantity of each order. We develop a Stackelberg game to investigate the optimal quantity discount policy offered by the supplier and its impact on the retailer. It is shown that under certain conditions the optimal quantity discount policy determined from the supplier's perspective can benefit both the supplier and the retailer.

articleTitle: Construction of Underground Transportation Hub Safety Monitoring Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In underground transportation hub, different platforms in the same station belong to different lines. So safety information sharing and linkage control of equipments among platforms become the key link for the safe operation and disaster prevention and reduction in hub. Based on the analysis of present URT (Urban Rail Transit) comprehensive monitoring system, the scheme of establishing a HCC (Hub Control Center) in hub station is proposed in this paper to realize information sharing and linkage in different platforms. Taking transfer station of two different lines as an example, simulation system based on Cybercontrol is constructed in our laboratory software platform, which realizes information exchanges and collaboration linkage between two different platforms in fire situation.

articleTitle: Investigation of Aberration for Optical System in Integral Stereolithography System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Optical imaging system is a key component for dynamic pattern generator in integral Stereolithography (SL) system, and the performance of the optical imaging system influences building accuracy and resolution of the integral SL system. The larger the aberration of the optical imaging system, the larger the dimension errors of objects built with the integral SL system, and larger aberration will make it impossible for the integral SL system to fabricate small objects with micro/meso structures. In order to assure the integral SL system has enough ability to build small object with micro/meso structures, the optical imaging system is established, and the aberration of the optical imaging system is investigated with ZEMAX. The optical imaging system consists of two components. The component 1 consists of 3 positive lenses, and the component 2 is made up of a negative lens, two positive lenses and a aperture. Aberrations analysis results shows that there are some residual spherical aberrations, off-axis spherical aberration and coma, and sagittal coma is larger than the meridional coma. The largest coma value of the optical imaging system is 0.08mm, and the average dispersion spot size is 0.04mm, and. The maximum astigmatism is 0.2 mm and the maximum field curvature is 1.4mm, the maximum distortion is less than 2%. The resolution is 0.05mm. Aberrations analysis results indicate that the performance of the optical imaging system can meet the requirements of the integral SL system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Falsework Foundation Deformation Effect on Existing Highway Safety
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In the new high-speed railway construction, many hidden dangers exist when the plan line across the existing highway. Under the premise of construction safety, how to ensure the traffic safety of existing road is the most important key of success construction. In this paper, combining with an engineering example of a new high-speed railway cross an existing highway, continuous beams falsework protection measures is first introduced in detail, then, three-dimensional finite element method is adopted to analyze the effect of falsework foundation deformation on the existing highway pile and pile cap. Calculation results indicate that the strengthening protection measures proposed can control the deformation of existing pile and pile cap, and the method can be referred by other similar projects.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on the Horseshoe Vortex Formation Around the Hull-Sail Junction of Submarine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The horseshoe vortex is typical flow characteristic around the appendage-body junction. The horseshoe vortex formation around the hull-said junction has important influence on the submarine hydrodynamics performance. The origination process of the submarine horseshoe vertex and its influence on submarine flow is analyzed. The numerical simulation on the horseshoe vortex is carried out using DES method (Detached Eddies Simulation); the influence og model speed on submarine horseshoe vertex is studied. It is shown that the model speed has little influence on the position of the horseshoe vortex center, while has signification influence on the intensity of horseshoe vortex. The attenuation of horseshoe vortex becomes slow with the increase of its distance.

articleTitle: Research on the Screening of the Port Throughput Forecast Index The Ports in North Gulf of Guangxi Taken for a Case
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: How to screen the Logistics forecast indexes is essential to logistics demand forecast. Port throughput and its related indexes have been analyzed in this paper, and a series of screening principles and method have been proposed. The ports in North Gulf of Guangxi are taken as an example in which grey correlation analysis and data processing software tool have been applied to find the correlations between Port Throughput in North Gulf of Guangxi and related forecast indexes based the data from 1990 to 2008. Finally, a group of well-constructed indexes with a high correlation were chosen as the final port throughput forecast indexes.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Autopilot System of Flight Simulator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Focusing on flight simulator Boeing737-300 produced by NASA, this paper analyzes the cruise longitudinal stability of the simulator and designs control law of a pitching stance hold mode and an altitude hold mode for autopilot system based on classical control theory. Parameters of controller are optimized by using Signal Constraint module of MATLAB. This method avoids the complex programming and calculating, allows the system to meet air quality requirements. Results of the study indicate that the system has good stability, dynamic and robust.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimization Model and Solution of Home Appliances Logistic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In this paper, we assumptions of achieving the goal of zero inventory for the environment and allowing the goods delivery of priority to exist between the wholesales, breaking the wholesale market down into: Has stock market and Lack stock market. And base on the VRP research, obtained the Distributed Optimization algorithm mode and the solving method of a large distribution center. Combining the development condition of Home Appliances, determine the reasonable random uncertainty demand, and explaining the application of statistical hypothesis testing.

articleTitle: Impact Evaluation of Rural Road Investment Projects on Household Welfare in Rural Area: Evidence from Fujian Province, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The basic rationale for public investment in rural roads is that households can achieve better transport access which supplies the opportunities to increase the welfare efficiently. But it has been difficult to know how opportunities provided by rural roads actually filter back into household welfare outcomes a, due to methodological constraints and data limitations. This paper examines the impacts Rural Roads Improvement Projects using a quasi-experimental household-level panel data from Fujian Province, China, surveying treatment and control villages before and after project implementation. Rural road investments are found to improve the life quality of treatment villages in income, political life and the relationship with relatives and friends.

articleTitle: Properties of Terahertz Waves Propagation in a Bounded Plasma Slab with High Collision Frequency and High Density
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The reflection, absorption and transmission characteristics of a terahertz waves (T-rays) in a bounded plasma slab with high collision frequency and high plasma density are studied in this paper. The method of impedance transformation with multiple dielectrics is used to describe the propagation of THz waves in the plasma layer. The effect of various plasma parameters such as the plasma number density, sheet thickness, wave frequency and collision frequency on the power transmission, absorption and reflection is investigated. The results of numerical calculation show that a THz wave can transmit though a dense and high collision frequency (THz) plasma with reflectionless and absorptionless power. When the change of plasma density leads the plasma frequency to be in the vicinity of the incident THz wave frequency, the plasma can absorb the most THz wave power. The potential applications of these propagation properties are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Causes of Highway Traffic Black-Spot Based on Rough Set and Fuzzy Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: First, we analysis the factors of leading to the accident black-spots; then, we put forward an algorithm to obtain the weight of each factor in the accident black-spots combining rough set and fuzzy theory; at last, we account for the reasonable and available of this algorithm through an example.

articleTitle: Traffic Route Dynamic Guidance Based on Coupling of Time Recursive and Artificial Neuron Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The relationship of road conditions and time change on the basis of people-machine-environmental coupling is researched. A prediction method of time recursive to confirm the shortest time of route is proposed. This method is as an accumulated experience basing on the idea of supervised learning in artificial neural network, colligating with the difference of road conditions during different time section, the human factors function, and the randomness of the accident in course of driving, thus the guidance of the traffic route is realized. Comparing with the real-time road conditions and accumulated experience, the method of time guidance prediction could offer real-time and effective road information for drivers. This guidance technology assists drivers to judge correctly in time and reduces the time losses because of the lack of the experience and the accidents. The guidance technology can be applied to the vehicles, which are with GPS. The example indicates that the model is effective combined with the real data.

articleTitle: Multiple Path Toll Distribution Problems with Weight Toll on Highway Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: In order to solve multiple path toll distribution problem based on weight toll, actual OD travel time of each mode vehicle between each OD pairs is calculated by using the travel time of every vehicle on highway network. The minimum difference model between actual and estimated OD travel times is presented. Amodified genetic algorithm is presented to obtain the path flow of each mode. Finally, a simple network is used to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Noise Character Study of Excavator Based on Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The spectrums of noise discharged out of excavator diesel, noise exhausted through resistance muffler, noise well radiation of the diesel and the noise in manipulator cell has been analyzed with the corresponding noise signal collected, and the A sound pressure levels have been measured with different diesel rotation respectively. Conclusions have been obtained as following: the noise signal discharged out of excavator diesel covers high, middle and low band widely; all the kinds noise signal have similar spectrum with different amplitude; the vibration is much bigger at idle speed is than the others; the noise strength increases with the diesel rotation rising. Low band frequencies with big spectrum amplitude of noise resource and the other noise signal collected are multiples of diesel rotation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Motorway Fog Information Disseminating Strategies Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: Based on the survey and analysis of current status of VMS systems application in China, this paper makes innovative study on the information disseminating strategies of Intelligent Motorway Fog Information Dissemination System (IMFIDS) via connected VMS, and then brings forward detailed strategies for two conditions: road opening but visibility under 200 meters and road closed down respectively. The strategies have been demonstrated in the pilot project - Huning Motorway Fog Semiautomatic Information Dissemination System.

articleTitle: An Edge Detection Method Brought to Videogrammetric Systems for Micro-platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: This paper presents an edge detection method brought to videogrammetric systems for micro-platform. As the motion precision of platform has a direct impact on the process of precision, so the edge detection in the visual measurement process is also particularly important. The algorithm has a good ability of anti-interference, and the image which been detected is smooth, neat and it always be with good availability. At the last, a platform edge model is received and proved this method.

articleTitle: Routing Optimization of Container Yard Crane
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The operating efficiency of work machines in container yards can significantly affect the operating costs and even the competitiveness level of the port. Therefore, this article studies on the routing optimization problem of gantry cranes from the perspective of the work machines. The routing optimization model of the gantry crane is established with the objective function of the shortest path and the constraints of loading and unloading requirements for quay cranes. Then a practical example is solved by an improved simulated annealing. The feasibility of model and algorithm is proved with the obtained good convergence results.

articleTitle: Study on Heat Transfer Performance of Micro Heat Pipe with Trapezium-grooved Wick
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: As the result of infinite yearning for product performance in microelectronics and chemicals, increasing integration level of microelectronic products has brought about the fatal problem of heat dissipation. In order to meet the challenge of high-power chips' heat dissipation, micro heat pipe with trapezium-grooved wick was first described digitally in this paper, then mathematical models were set up for theoretical analysis, and finally some experiments were carried out on micro heat-pipes of different groove structures manufactured by high speed spinning. The results shows that, first, micro heat-pipe with trapezium-grooved wick has fairly good warm start performance; second, inclination angle has a big influence on its heat transfer performance; third, better heat transfer performances can be obtained when the ratio of the groove's width to its wall thickness is 1:1 and the ratio of the groove's depth to its width is 1.5:1; fourth, thermal conductivity of micro heat-pipes with trapezium-grooved wick can be 100 times that of red copper.

articleTitle: Highway Transport Volume Forecast Based on Changeable Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The forecast of transport volume is the fundamental for transport developments and programming, it is very difficult to forecast transport volume accurately and validly using only one forecast method. The article analyzes the changeable combination forecast model's application on this problem. And future freight volume has been forecasted using this model based on the total highway freight volume and economics of one province. The changeable weight of this method changes with time, it can reflect the change of every forecast method. So this model promotes the forecast accuracy. A practical example shows the effect of this method is objective and valid.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Remote Management System for Electric Public Vehicles' Batteries Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Optoelectronics and Image Processing
abstract: The design methods and functions of the remote management system for electric public vehicles’ batteries data are introduced in this paper. The system mainly consists of the real-time monitor module of batteries data, the statistical analysis module of batteries data and the module of setting parameters. Especially, the implement methods for the real-time monitor module of batteries data and the statistical analysis module of batteries data are emphasized in this paper. Now the system is working in the electric public vehicle recharging station in Beijing public transit company. The long tine experiment’s results show that the system has a good performance, so the design methods of the system are reasonable.
